title.zh: 卷24 本紀二十四 德宗本紀二
title.raw: 卷24 本紀二十四 德宗本紀二

sentences.zh: 二十一年乙未春正月癸酉朔，停筵宴。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, yihai, spring, first month, new moon on day guiyou: court banquets were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxu year 21, spring, month 1, new moon guiyou: levee banquets were halted.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，日兵寇威海。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Japanese troops invaded Weihai.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Japanese forces attacked Weihai.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，我海軍與戰於南岸，敗績。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, our navy fought the Japanese at the southern shore and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the fleet fought Japan off the southern shore and lost.

sentences.zh: 己卯，吳大澂始出關視師。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Wu Dacheng first went beyond the passes to inspect the armies.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Wu Dacheng first marched out to take command.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，威海陷，守將戴宗騫死之。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Weihai fell and Garrison Commander Dai Zongqian died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Weihai fell and Dai Zongqian was killed.

sentences.zh: 改命聶士成統兵入關。

translations.literal: Nie Shicheng was reassigned to command troops entering the passes.
translations.idiomatic: Nie Shicheng was ordered to lead the army back through the passes.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔責李鴻章。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, an edict rebuked Li Hongzhang.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Li Hongzhang was rebuked by edict.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，劉公島陷，水師熸，丁汝昌及總兵劉步蟾死之。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Liugong Island fell, the navy was extinguished, and Ding Ruchang and Brigadier General Liu Buchan died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Liugong Island fell, the fleet was destroyed, and Ding Ruchang and Liu Buchan died.

sentences.zh: 諭張之洞、松椿防海、贛、清江水陸要衝，保清、淮通運。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhidong and Song Song were instructed to defend the coastal, Gan, and Qing River land-and-water key points and to protect Qing and Huai transport routes.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong and Song Song were told to hold the coast, Gan, and Qing River lines and keep Qing-Huai grain moving.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，授李鴻章為頭等全權大臣，使日本。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Li Hongzhang was appointed plenipotentiary minister of the first rank and sent to Japan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Li Hongzhang became chief plenipotentiary to Japan.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，見各國使臣於文華殿。

translations.literal: On day renchen, foreign envoys were received at Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day envoys were received at Wenhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 陶模言喀什噶爾、莎車、和闐等屬戶民，英印度部收買為奴，應由公家贖放，從之。

translations.literal: Tao Mo said that dependent households in Kashgar, Yarkand, Khotan, and other places were bought as slaves by the British India Department and should be redeemed by the public authorities; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Tao Mo reported Kashgar, Yarkand, and Khotan subjects sold into British Indian slavery and asked state redemption; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，葉志超、龔照□興俱論斬。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Ye Zhichao and Gong Zhao□xing were both sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Ye Zhichao and Gong Zhao□xing were condemned to death.

sentences.zh: 己亥，日本陷文登、寧海，偪煙台。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Japan took Wendeng and Ninghai and pressed Yantai.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Japan seized Wendeng and Ninghai and threatened Yantai.

sentences.zh: 宋慶等及日人戰於太平山，敗績，走。

translations.literal: Song Qing and others fought the Japanese at Taiping Mountain, were defeated, and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Song Qing and others lost to Japan at Taiping Mountain and retreated.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，宋慶、吳大澂敗日人於亮甲山，參將劉雲桂、守備趙雲奇戰死。

translations.literal: Second month, day yisi: Song Qing and Wu Dacheng defeated the Japanese at Liangjiashan; Regimental Commander Liu Yungui and Garrison Commander Zhao Yunqi died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, yisi, Song Qing and Wu Dacheng beat Japan at Liangjiashan; Liu Yungui and Zhao Yunqi were killed.

sentences.zh: 賑錦州、寧遠災民。

translations.literal: Famine victims in Jinzhou and Ningyuan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Jinzhou and Ningyuan disaster victims were fed.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命聶士成總統津、沽海口防軍。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Nie Shicheng was ordered to command all defense forces at the Tianjin and Bohai mouths.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Nie Shicheng took the Tianjin-Bohai coastal defenses.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，日兵薄遼陽，長順、唐仁廉擊卻之。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Japanese troops pressed Liaoyang; Chang Shun and Tang Renlian repulsed them.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Japan pressed Liaoyang and Chang Shun and Tang Renlian drove them back.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，日兵陷牛莊，吳大澂退走，日人遂襲營口。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Japanese troops took Niuzhuang; Wu Dacheng retreated, and the Japanese then raided Yingkou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Japan took Niuzhuang, Wu Dacheng fled, and Japan struck Yingkou.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，馬玉昆敗日人於田莊台。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Ma Yugui defeated the Japanese at Tianzhuangtai.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Ma Yugui beat Japan at Tianzhuangtai.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，復戰，敗績。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, they fought again and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day they fought again and lost.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，日兵陷田莊台。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Japanese troops took Tianzhuangtai.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Japan seized Tianzhuangtai.

sentences.zh: 吳大澂奔錦州，宋慶退雙台。

translations.literal: Wu Dacheng fled to Jinzhou and Song Qing retreated to Shuangtai.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Dacheng ran to Jinzhou and Song Qing fell back to Shuangtai.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以吳大澂師徒撓敗，切責之。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, because Wu Dacheng's army had been shaken in defeat, he was severely rebuked.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Wu Dacheng was sharply rebuked for his routed army.

sentences.zh: 戊午，恭親王等奏撤海軍署。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Prince Gong and others memorialized to abolish the Naval Office.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Prince Gong and others asked to abolish the Naval Office.

sentences.zh: 免上元、江寧等處，淮安等衛賦課。

translations.literal: Tax levies were remitted for Shangyuan, Jiangning, and other places and for Huai'an and other guards.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes were forgiven for Shangyuan, Jiangning, and Huai'an guards.

sentences.zh: 賑直隸水災。

translations.literal: Zhili flood victims were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili flood victims were fed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，分神機營兵駐喜峰口。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Shenji Camp troops were stationed at Xifengkou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Shenji Camp soldiers garrisoned Xifengkou.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，命吳大澂解軍務幫辦來京，湘、鄂諸軍以魏光燾領之。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Wu Dacheng was relieved of military duties to assist at the capital; Hunan and Hubei armies were placed under Wei Guangtao.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Wu Dacheng left the front for Beijing and Wei Guangtao took the Hunan-Hubei forces.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，撥庫帑十萬加賑薊州等處災民。

translations.literal: On day yichou, one hundred thousand taels from the treasury were allocated to add relief for disaster victims in Jizhou and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day 100,000 taels were added for Jizhou flood relief.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，知州徐慶璋集民團固守遼陽，命裕祿濟饟械。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Magistrate Xu Qingzhang gathered militia to hold Liaoyang firmly; Yulu was ordered to supply provisions and arms.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Xu Qingzhang's militia held Liaoyang and Yulu was told to send food and arms.

sentences.zh: 己巳，賑玉田、灤州、樂亭水災。

translations.literal: On day jisi, flood victims in Yutian, Luanzhou, and Leting were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Yutian, Luanzhou, and Leting flood victims were fed.

sentences.zh: 日人狙擊李鴻章，彈傷其頰。

translations.literal: Japanese assassins shot Li Hongzhang and wounded his cheek.
translations.idiomatic: Japanese gunmen wounded Li Hongzhang's cheek.

sentences.zh: 庚午，日人犯澎湖。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Japanese troops invaded Penghu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Japan attacked Penghu.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申朔，命吳大澂回湖南巡撫任。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon on day renshen: Wu Dacheng was ordered to return to his post as Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, renshen new moon, Wu Dacheng went back to Hunan as governor.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，濟陽高家紙坊河決。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the river broke at Gaojia Paperworks in Jiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Gaojia Paperworks levee burst at Jiyang.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，日兵陷澎湖。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Japanese troops took Penghu.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Japan seized Penghu.

sentences.zh: 戊子，褫提督蔣希夷職，逮問。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, General Jiang Xiyi was stripped of office and arrested for trial.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Jiang Xiyi was dismissed and arrested.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命郭寶昌隨同劉坤一辦防務。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Guo Baochang was ordered to assist Liu Kunyi in defense affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Guo Baochang was sent to help Liu Kunyi on defense.

sentences.zh: 己亥，李鴻章與日本全權伊籐博文、陸奧宗光馬關會議。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Li Hongzhang met in conference at Shimonoseki with Japan's plenipotentiaries Ito Hirobumi and Mutsu Munemitsu.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Li Hongzhang opened Shimonoseki talks with Ito and Mutsu.

sentences.zh: 和約成，定朝鮮為獨立自主國，割遼南地、台灣、澎湖各島，償軍費二萬萬，增通商口岸，任日本商民從事工藝製造，暫行駐兵威海。

translations.literal: The treaty was concluded: Korea was made an independent state; southern Liaodong, Taiwan, and the Penghu islands were ceded; war indemnity of two hundred million was paid; treaty ports were added; Japanese merchants were allowed to engage in crafts and manufacture; and troops were temporarily stationed at Weihai.
translations.idiomatic: Peace fixed Korea's independence, ceded Liaodong south, Taiwan, and Penghu, set a 200-million indemnity, new ports, Japanese factory rights, and a temporary Weihai garrison.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，撥京倉米石備順天平糶。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wushen: capital granary rice was allocated for fair-price sale in Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: In summer month 4, wushen, Beijing granary rice was set aside for Shuntian fair-price sale.

sentences.zh: 己酉，天津海溢，王文韶自請罷斥，不許。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the Tianjin sea overflowed; Wang Wenshao asked to be dismissed and was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Tianjin's sea flood brought Wang Wenshao's resignation request, which was refused.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「非常災異，我君臣惟當修省惕厲，以弭天災。

translations.literal: An edict said: 「Extraordinary disasters and omens—We ruler and ministers must only cultivate ourselves in vigilance and diligence to avert Heaven's calamities.
translations.idiomatic: The throne said: 「Rare disasters and omens mean ruler and ministers must repent in vigilance to calm Heaven.

sentences.zh: 」甘肅撒回叛，陷循化□，雷正綰剿之。

translations.literal: 」In Gansu the Sala Muslims rebelled, took Xunhua□, and Lei Zhengwan suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: 」Gansu's Sala rebels seized Xunhua□ and Lei Zhengwan crushed them.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，命道員聯芳、伍廷芳赴煙台與日本換約。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Circuit Intendants Lian Fang and Wu Tingfang were sent to Yantai to exchange the treaty with Japan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Lian Fang and Wu Tingfang went to Yantai to exchange ratifications with Japan.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，諭曰：「和約定議，廷臣交章謂地不可棄，費不可償，當仍廢約決戰。

translations.literal: On day yimao, an edict said: 「Now that the treaty has been decided, court officials have submitted memorials in succession saying territory cannot be ceded, indemnity cannot be paid, and the treaty should still be voided and war resumed.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the throne said: 「With peace set, officials keep memorializing that land must not be lost, money must not be paid, and the treaty should be torn up for war.

sentences.zh: 其言固出忠憤，而未悉朝廷苦衷。

translations.literal: Their words indeed spring from loyal indignation, yet they do not grasp the court's bitter circumstances.
translations.idiomatic: That voice is loyal rage, but it does not see the court's bitter straits.

sentences.zh: 自倉卒開釁，戰無一勝。

translations.literal: Since the war began in haste, not one battle was won.
translations.idiomatic: From the hasty opening of hostilities, not one battle was won.

sentences.zh: 近者情事益迫，北可逼遼、瀋，南可犯畿疆。

translations.literal: Recently the situation has grown more urgent: in the north they could press Liaodong and Shenyang; in the south they could threaten the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: Lately danger tightened: the north could take Liaodong and Shenyang, the south could strike the capital approaches.

sentences.zh: 瀋陽為陵寢重地，京師則宗社攸關。

translations.literal: Shenyang is the weighty ground of the imperial tombs; the capital is where the altars of state stand.
translations.idiomatic: Shenyang holds the imperial tombs; Beijing holds the altars of state.

sentences.zh: 況慈闈頤養廿餘年，使徒御有驚，藐躬何堪自問？

translations.literal: Moreover the empress dowager has been nourished in ease for more than twenty years—if her traveling guards were alarmed, how could We bear to ask Ourselves?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the empress dowager has been at ease for twenty years—if her escort were shaken, how could We face Ourselves?

sentences.zh: 加以天心示警，海嘯成災，戰守更難措手。

translations.literal: Added to this, Heaven shows warning and the sea surges into disaster—war and defense are harder still to handle.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven too has warned, and the sea has risen in disaster—war and defense are harder to manage.

sentences.zh: 一和一戰，兩害兼權，而後幡然定計。

translations.literal: Peace and war, weighing both harms together, only then did We turn and fix Our resolve.
translations.idiomatic: Weighing peace and war together, We turned only then and fixed Our mind.

sentences.zh: 其萬難情事，言者所未及詳，而天下臣民皆當共諒者也。

translations.literal: The myriad difficulties—the memorialists did not detail them, yet all officials and people under Heaven should jointly understand.
translations.idiomatic: Countless hardships the memorialists never spelled out—yet all under Heaven should understand together.

sentences.zh: 茲將批準定約，特宣示前後辦理緣由。

translations.literal: Now that the approved treaty is ratified, We specially proclaim the reasons for handling matters before and after.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the ratified treaty stands, We proclaim how matters were handled before and after.

sentences.zh: 我君臣惟期堅苦一心，痛除積弊。

translations.literal: We ruler and ministers must only look to unite in bitter resolve and eliminate accumulated abuses.
translations.idiomatic: Ruler and ministers must stand firm in bitter unity and cut deep-rooted abuses.

sentences.zh: 」戊午，諭軍機大臣及諸臣工，和局已成，勿再論奏。

translations.literal: 」On day wuwu, Grand Councillors and all officials were instructed that the peace settlement was complete and that they should not again submit debate.
translations.idiomatic: 」On wuwu day the Grand Council and officials were told peace was done and debate must stop.

sentences.zh: 留山東運糧十萬石備寧河等處賑。

translations.literal: One hundred thousand piculs of Shandong transport grain were retained to relieve Ninghe and other districts.
translations.idiomatic: 100,000 piculs of Shandong transport grain were held for Ninghe relief.

sentences.zh: 命裕祿接濟寧、錦等屬賑需。

translations.literal: Yulu was ordered to continue relief supplies for Ning, Jin, and other jurisdictions.
translations.idiomatic: Yulu was told to keep feeding Ning, Jin, and the other afflicted districts.

sentences.zh: 己未，賞前宿松縣知縣孫葆田五品卿銜。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, former Susong county magistrate Sun Baotian was rewarded with fifth-rank Qing Office rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day ex-magistrate Sun Baotian received fifth-rank Qing Office rank.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，達賴喇嘛受戒畢，賚哈達、念珠等物。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, after the Dalai Lama completed his ordination, scarfs, prayer beads, and other gifts were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, after the Dalai Lama's ordination, the court gave scarfs and prayer beads.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，撥湖北漕米三萬石，備寧、錦等屬賑。

translations.literal: On day guihai, thirty thousand piculs of Hubei transport grain were allocated for relief in Ning, Jin, and other jurisdictions.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day 30,000 piculs of Hubei transport grain went to Ning and Jin relief.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，京師平糶。

translations.literal: On day yichou, fair-price grain sale was conducted in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Beijing sold grain at fair price.

sentences.zh: 命李經方為台灣交地全權委員。

translations.literal: Li Jingfang was appointed plenipotentiary commissioner for Taiwan handover.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jingfang became plenipotentiary for turning over Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，賜駱成驤等二百八十二人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Luo Chengzhang and two hundred eighty-two others were granted jinshi and other degrees with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Luo Chengzhang and 282 others received jinshi ranks in graded order.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，召唐景崧來京。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Tang Jingsong was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Tang Jingsong was called to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未朔，賑臨漳等縣水災。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on day xinwei: flood victims in Linzhang and other counties were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, xinwei new moon, Linzhang and other flooded counties were fed.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，蔣希夷論斬。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Jiang Xiyi was sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Jiang Xiyi was executed.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，見俄使喀希尼、法使施阿蘭於文華殿。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Russian envoy Keshini and the French envoy Gerard were received at Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Russia's Keshini and France's Gerard were received at Wenhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，日本歸我遼南地。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Japan returned southern Liaodong to Us.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Japan gave back southern Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，免湖南新化，雲南阿迷、保山、昆明上年被災田賦。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, land tax was remitted for Xinhua in Hunan and for Ami, Baoshan, and Kunming in Yunnan, which had suffered disaster the previous year.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day last year's disaster taxes were forgiven for Hunan's Xinhua and Yunnan's Ami, Baoshan, and Kunming.

sentences.zh: 賑長武等縣水災雹災。

translations.literal: Flood and hail victims in Changwu and other counties were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Changwu and other flood and hail counties were fed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，唐景崧休致。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Tang Jingsong retired.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Tang Jingsong left office.

sentences.zh: 閏五月辛丑朔，撥山東庫帑二萬助賑奉天。

translations.literal: Intercalary fifth month, new moon on day xinmao: twenty thousand taels from the Shandong treasury were allocated to aid relief in Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: In intercalary month 5, xinmao new moon, 20,000 Shandong taels went to Fengtian relief.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，撫恤江、浙運漕稽候船戶萬餘人。

translations.literal: On day renyin, more than ten thousand grain-transport boatmen delayed on the Jiangsu and Zhejiang routes were consoled.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day 10,000-odd Jiangsu-Zhejiang transport boatmen held up on the route were paid off.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，大學士福錕致仕。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Grand Secretary Fu Kun retired.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Grand Secretary Fu Kun left office.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，命直隸提督聶士成總統淮軍駐津、沽，江西布政使魏光燾總統浙軍駐山海關，四川提督宋慶總統毅軍駐錦州，俱聽北洋大臣調度。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Zhili Military Governor Nie Shicheng was ordered to command the Huai Army garrisoned at Tianjin and the Bohai mouths; Jiangxi Provincial Administration Commissioner Wei Guangtao was to command the Zhe Army garrisoned at Shanhaiguan; Sichuan Military Governor Song Qing was to command the Yi Army garrisoned at Jinzhou—all under the Beiyang minister's direction.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Nie Shicheng took Huai forces at Tianjin-Bohai, Wei Guangtao Zhe forces at Shanhaiguan, and Song Qing Yi forces at Jinzhou, all under Beiyang command.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，吳大澂罷。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Wu Dacheng was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Wu Dacheng was removed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，予惠潮嘉道裕庚四品京堂，充出使日本大臣。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Huizhou-Chaozhou-Jieyang Circuit Intendant Yu Geng was given fourth-rank Beijing Office rank and appointed minister to Japan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Yu Geng became fourth-rank Beijing officer and envoy to Japan.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，諭曰：「近中外臣工條陳時務，如修鐵路，鑄鈔幣，造機器，開礦產，折南漕，減兵額，創郵政，練陸軍，整海軍，立學堂，大抵以籌餉練兵為急務，以恤商惠工為本源，皆應及時興舉。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, an edict said: 「Recently Chinese and foreign officials have submitted plans on current affairs—such as building railways, minting paper currency, making machines, opening mines, converting southern tribute grain transport, reducing troop quotas, creating postal service, training the land army, reorganizing the navy, and founding schools—most take raising revenue and drilling troops as urgent tasks and cherishing merchants and benefiting crafts as the root; all should be undertaken in timely fashion.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the throne said: 「Officials at home and abroad now press reforms—railways, paper money, machinery, mines, ending southern grain transport, cutting troops, post offices, land drill, sea reorganization, schools—with revenue and armies urgent and commerce the root; all should start at once.

sentences.zh: 至整頓釐金，嚴覈關稅，稽察荒田，汰除冗員，皆於國計民生多所裨補。

translations.literal: As for rectifying likin, strictly auditing customs duties, inspecting abandoned fields, and eliminating redundant posts—all greatly benefit state revenue and the people's livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: Likin reform, customs audit, waste-land survey, and redundant-post cuts all help revenue and livelihood.

sentences.zh: 直省疆吏應各就情勢，籌酌辦法以聞。

translations.literal: Each provincial governor should devise measures suited to local conditions and report.
translations.idiomatic: Each governor should shape local plans and report up.

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict closed.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，孫毓汶以疾免。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiaxu: Sun Yuweng was relieved on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, jiaxu, Sun Yuweng quit for illness.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，賑熱河饑民。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, famine victims in Rehe were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Rehe famine victims were fed.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，軍機大臣徐用儀罷。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Grand Councillor Xu Yongyi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Grand Councillor Xu Yongyi was removed.

sentences.zh: 以麟書為武英殿大學士，昆岡以禮部尚書協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Lin Shu was made Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall; Kun Gang, as Minister of Rites, was made Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Shu became Wuying Grand Secretary and Rites Minister Kun Gang associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 命錢應溥為軍機大臣，翁同龢、李鴻藻均兼總理各國事務衙門行走。

translations.literal: Qian Yingpu was appointed Grand Councillor; Weng Tonghe and Li Hongzao were both made concurrent commissioners of the Zongli Yamen.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Yingpu joined the Grand Council; Weng Tonghe and Li Hongzao also served at the Zongli Yamen.

sentences.zh: 戊子，賑鍾祥等處水災。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, flood victims in Zhongxiang and other places were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Zhongxiang and other flood districts were fed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，沁河決。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiachen: the Qin River broke its banks.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn month 7, jiachen, the Qin River burst.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，滎澤河決。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the Yingze River broke its banks.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the Yingze River burst.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔李鴻章入閣辦事。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, an edict ordered Li Hongzhang to enter the Grand Council for service.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Li Hongzhang was called into the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 授王文韶直隸總督兼北洋大臣。

translations.literal: Wang Wenshao was appointed Zhili governor-general and concurrent Beiyang minister.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wenshao became Zhili governor-general and Beiyang minister.

sentences.zh: 戊申，賑商州、清澗等處水災雹災。

translations.literal: On day wushen, flood and hail victims in Shangzhou, Qingjian, and other places were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Shangzhou, Qingjian, and other flood and hail counties were fed.

sentences.zh: 己酉，予宋儒呂大臨從祀文廟。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the Song Neo-Confucian Lü Dalin was granted secondary sacrifice in the Confucian temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Lü Dalin was added to the Confucian temple.

sentences.zh: 壽張、齊東河決。

translations.literal: The rivers broke at Shouzhang and Qidong.
translations.idiomatic: The Shouzhang and Qidong levees burst.

sentences.zh: 豐升阿遣戍軍台。

translations.literal: Feng Sheng'a was banished to the military garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Sheng'a was sent to frontier garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 戊午，賑鎮安等縣水災。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, flood victims in Zhen'an and other counties were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Zhen'an and other flooded counties were fed.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，江西巡撫德馨有罪褫職。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Jiangxi Governor De Xin was stripped of office for wrongdoing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, De Xin was dismissed as Jiangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 色勒庫爾地震。

translations.literal: An earthquake struck Yarkand.
translations.idiomatic: Yarkand was shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以回眾猖獗，褫總兵湯彥和職，楊昌濬、雷正綰並褫職留任。

translations.literal: On day renxu, because Hui rebels were rampant, Grand Commander Tang Yanhe was stripped of office; Yang Changjun and Lei Zhengqian were also stripped but kept in acting posts.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Tang Yanhe was dismissed while Yang Changjun and Lei Zhengqian were stripped yet retained in acting posts.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，已革提督黃仕林論斬。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the dismissed Regional Commander Huang Shilin was sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Huang Shilin was condemned to death after dismissal.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，賑富川、容縣水災。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renshen: flood victims in Fuchuan and Rong counties were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Month 8, renshen: Fuchuan and Rong flood victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丙子，賑階、文、西寧等州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, flood victims in Jie, Wen, Xining, and other districts were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Jie, Wen, Xining, and other districts received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 己卯，四川總督劉秉璋以不能保護教堂褫職。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Sichuan Governor-General Liu Bingzhang was stripped for failing to protect churches.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Liu Bingzhang was dismissed for not protecting churches.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命工部郎中慶常以五品京堂充出使法國大臣。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Bureau Director Qing Chang was given fifth-rank kuotang status as envoy to France.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Qing Chang became a fifth-rank kuotang envoy to France.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，免雲南威遠被災田賦。

translations.literal: On day guisi, tax on disaster-struck fields at Weiyuan in Yunnan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Weiyuan disaster-field tax in Yunnan was remitted.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子，賑梧州府屬火災。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengzi: fire victims in Wuzhou prefecture were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Month 9, gengzi: Wuzhou fire victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 留山東新漕備瀕河諸縣災賑。

translations.literal: New Shandong grain tribute was retained for disaster relief along the river.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong new tribute grain was kept for riverside disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，留湖北冬漕三萬石備鍾祥等縣賑需。

translations.literal: On day yisi, thirty thousand shi of Hubei's winter tribute grain were retained for relief in Zhongxiang and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, thirty thousand shi of Hubei winter tribute were kept for Zhongxiang relief.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命魏光燾統軍援甘肅。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Wei Guangtao was ordered to command troops to aid Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Wei Guangtao was sent to command relief troops in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 戊申，免望都差徭，及退出圈地額賦五成，著為令。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Wangdu corvée and half the quota levies on surrendered enclosed lands were remitted and made permanent law.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Wangdu corvée and half enclosed-land quota tax were permanently remitted.

sentences.zh: 己酉，免陝西前歲民欠，暨華州開渠佔地錢糧。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Shaanxi's prior-year arrears and Huazhou canal-land tax were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Shaanxi arrear taxes and Huazhou canal-land tax were remitted.

sentences.zh: 壬子，見英使歐格訥於文華殿。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the British envoy O'Conor was received at the Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the British envoy O'Conor was received at Wenhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賑甘肅被擾各地難民。

translations.literal: On day yimao, refugees in Gansu's disturbed districts were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Gansu refugees in disturbed areas were relieved.

sentences.zh: 戊午，賑臨湘蛟災。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, flood-dragon victims at Linxiang were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Linxiang flood-dragon victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 撥帑三萬購倉穀，備常德、衡州旱災。

translations.literal: Thirty thousand taels were allocated to buy granary grain against drought at Changde and Hengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty thousand taels were set aside to buy grain for Changde and Hengzhou drought relief.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，見和使克羅伯於文華殿。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Dutch envoy Kroebel was received at the Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, the Dutch envoy Kroebel was received at Wenhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，命宗人府府丞吳廷芬兼總理各國事務衙門行走。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Subdirector of the Imperial Clan Wu Tingfen was also appointed to serve at the Office for the General Management of Affairs with Foreign Countries.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Wu Tingfen was also made an officer of the Foreign Affairs Office.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，後藏班禪額爾德尼來京謁陵，進方物。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the Tashi Lama from Tibet came to the capital to attend the tombs and presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Tibet's Tashi Lama came to the capital for tomb rites and sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 揭陽、潮陽、普寧等縣地震。

translations.literal: Jieyang, Chaoyang, Puning, and other counties were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Jieyang, Chaoyang, Puning, and other counties had an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十月辛未，楊昌濬罷，以陶模署陝甘總督。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day xinwei: Yang Changjun was dismissed and Tao Mo was made acting governor-general of Shaanxi-Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Month 10, xinwei: Yang Changjun was dismissed and Tao Mo became acting Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，李鴻章與日使互換歸遼條約。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Li Hongzhang exchanged with the Japanese envoy the treaty for the return of Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Li Hongzhang exchanged the Liaodong restoration treaty with Japan.

sentences.zh: 甲申，長麟、汪鳴鑾並以召對妄言褫職。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Chang Lin and Wang Mingluan were stripped for reckless speech at imperial audience.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Chang Lin and Wang Mingluan were dismissed for rash words at audience.

sentences.zh: 己丑，初設新建陸軍，命溫處道袁世凱督練。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the new army was first established and Yuan Shikai at Wenzhou Circuit was ordered to drill it.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the new army was created with Yuan Shikai ordered to train it at Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，免江川被災田賦二年。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Jiangchuan's disaster field tax was remitted for two years.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Jiangchuan disaster-field tax was remitted for two years.

sentences.zh: 賑鶴慶等州縣水旱災。

translations.literal: Water and drought victims in Heqing and other districts were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Heqing and other districts received flood and drought relief.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉朔，山東趙家口合龍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yiyou, first day: the breach at Zhao Jiakou in Shandong was closed.
translations.idiomatic: Month 11, yiyou: Shandong's Zhao Jiakou breach was closed.

sentences.zh: 丁未，免盛京被淹官莊額賦。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, quota levies on flooded official estates at Shengjing were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Shengjing flooded official-estate quota tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 戊申，留河南漕折八萬備內黃等縣工賑。

translations.literal: On day wushen, eighty thousand shi of Henan's tribute grain conversion were retained for works and relief in Neihuang and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, eighty thousand shi of Henan tribute conversion were kept for Neihuang works and relief.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以湖北布政使王之春充俄皇加冕賀使。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Hubei Provincial Treasurer Wang Zhichun was appointed congratulatory envoy for the Russian emperor's coronation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Wang Zhichun was sent as envoy to congratulate the Russian coronation.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，免奉天被兵各屬旗民兩年田賦，並積年逋賦。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, two years of field tax for banner folk in war-struck Fengtian districts were remitted, along with accumulated arrears.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Fengtian banner folk in war districts had two years of field tax and arrears remitted.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，劉永福免。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Liu Yongfu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Liu Yongfu was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，甘肅提督李培榮以赴援西寧逗留褫職。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Gansu Regional Commander Li Peirong was stripped for lingering on the way to aid Xining.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Li Peirong was dismissed for delay en route to aid Xining.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，調董福祥為甘肅提督，仍總統甘軍，前敵諸將均歸節制。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Dong Fuxiang was made Gansu regional commander and still commanded the Gansu Army; all former front-line generals were placed under him.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Dong Fuxiang became Gansu regional commander, still commanding the Gansu Army and all former front generals.

sentences.zh: 賑保山蛟災。

translations.literal: Flood-dragon victims at Baoshan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Baoshan flood-dragon victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，壽張決口合龍。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuyin: the breach at Shouzhang was closed.
translations.idiomatic: Month 12, wuyin: the Shouzhang breach was closed.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，撥庫帑六萬備湖北春賑。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, sixty thousand taels from the treasury were set aside for Hubei's spring relief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, sixty thousand taels were allocated for Hubei spring relief.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，改命李鴻章使俄，邵友濂副之。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Li Hongzhang was reassigned as envoy to Russia with Shao Youlian as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Li Hongzhang was made envoy to Russia with Shao Youlian as deputy.

sentences.zh: 是月，免陝西前歲逋賦、奉天上年葦稅及官莊稅糧。

translations.literal: This month, Shaanxi's prior-year arrears, Fengtian's prior-year reed tax, and official-estate grain taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: This month, Shaanxi arrear taxes, Fengtian reed tax, and official-estate grain tax were remitted.

sentences.zh: 賑盛京、萍鄉災。

translations.literal: Victims at Shengjing and Pingxiang were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Shengjing and Pingxiang disaster victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 發帑各十萬，賑湖南、雲南、陝西各屬災。

translations.literal: One hundred thousand taels each were sent to relieve disaster in Hunan, Yunnan, and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred thousand taels each went to Hunan, Yunnan, and Shaanxi disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 二十二年丙申春正月丙申朔，停筵宴。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, bingchen, spring, first month, day bingchen, first day: banquets were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Year 22, spring 1, bingchen: court banquets were suspended.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以特遣李鴻章使俄，諭止邵友濂、王之春毋往。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, because Li Hongzhang was specially sent as envoy to Russia, Shao Youlian and Wang Zhichun were told not to go.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Shao Youlian and Wang Zhichun were told not to go since Li Hongzhang was sent to Russia.

sentences.zh: 己亥，賑長沙各府水旱災。

translations.literal: On day jihai, victims of flood and drought in Changsha and other prefectures were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Changsha and other prefectures received flood and drought relief.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，見各國公使於文華殿。

translations.literal: On day yimao, envoys of all nations were received at the Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, foreign envoys were received at Wenhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命馮子材仍回廣東，督辦欽、廉防務。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Feng Zicai was ordered back to Guangdong to oversee defenses at Qin and Lian.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Feng Zicai returned to Guangdong to oversee Qin and Lian defenses.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午，移塔爾巴哈台額魯特領隊大臣駐布倫布拉克，伊犁察哈爾營領隊大臣駐博羅塔拉。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengwu: the Oirat commandant at Tarbagatai was moved to Brunbrak and the Chahar commandant at Ili to Borotala.
translations.idiomatic: Month 2, gengwu: the Tarbagatai Oirat commandant moved to Brunbrak and the Ili Chahar commandant to Borotala.

sentences.zh: 壬申，始議郵政與各國聯會。

translations.literal: On day renshen, postal union with foreign states was first discussed.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, union with foreign postal systems was first discussed.

sentences.zh: 開龍州鐵路。

translations.literal: The Longzhou railway was opened.
translations.idiomatic: The Longzhou railway opened.

sentences.zh: 劉銘傳卒。

translations.literal: Liu Mingchuan died.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Mingchuan died.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，戶部火。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Ministry of Revenue burned.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the Ministry of Revenue burned.

sentences.zh: 三月戊戌，額勒和布致仕。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuxu: E Le He Bu retired.
translations.idiomatic: Month 3, wuxu: E Le He Bu retired.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，開杭州商埠。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the commercial port at Hangzhou was opened.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Hangzhou commercial port opened.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命王文韶、張之洞督辦蘆漢鐵路。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Wang Wenshao and Zhang Zhidong were ordered to oversee the Lu-Han Railway.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Wang Wenshao and Zhang Zhidong were ordered to oversee the Lu-Han Railway.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，回匪窺珠勒都斯。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Hui bandits menaced Zhuludos.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Hui bandits threatened Zhuludos.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，命董福祥駐西寧，專任剿撫，魏光燾還駐河州，尋命回陝西巡撫任。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Dong Fuxiang was stationed at Xining to suppress and pacify exclusively; Wei Guangtao returned to station at Hezhou and was soon told to resume as Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Dong Fuxiang was posted to Xining for suppression while Wei Guangtao returned to Hezhou and soon resumed as Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申，五台山菩薩頂災。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renshen: fire at the Bodhisattva Peak on Wutai Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Month 4, renshen: Wutai Mountain's Bodhisattva Peak burned.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，免昆明、丘北被災夏糧。

translations.literal: On day yihai, summer grain at Kunming and Qiubei was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Kunming and Qiubei summer grain tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命榮祿往天津閱新建陸軍。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Rong Lu was sent to Tianjin to review the new army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Rong Lu went to Tianjin to inspect the new army.

sentences.zh: 戊子，授昆岡體仁閣大學士，榮祿以兵部尚書協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Kun Gang was made a titular Grand Secretary; Rong Lu became an associate grand secretary while retaining his post as Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Kun Gang became titular grand secretary and Rong Lu associate grand secretary while remaining Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉，諭李秉衡查州縣糧賦，浮收者覈減之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingyou: an edict told Li Bingheng to audit county grain levies and reduce excess collection.
translations.idiomatic: Month 5, dingyou: Li Bingheng was told to audit county grain levies and cut excess collection.

sentences.zh: 免恩安被災額賦。

translations.literal: Disaster levies at En'an were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: En'an disaster levies were remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，鄭州文廟災。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the Confucian temple at Zhengzhou burned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Zhengzhou's Confucian temple burned.

sentences.zh: 是月，上數奉皇太后臨醇王邸視福晉疾。

translations.literal: This month, the emperor repeatedly accompanied the empress dowager to the mansion of the Prince Regent Chun to visit the prince's consort, who was ill.
translations.idiomatic: This month, the emperor repeatedly went with the empress dowager to Prince Chun's mansion to visit his ill consort.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，醇賢親王福晉葉赫那拉氏薨，輟朝十一日，上奉皇太后臨邸視殮，越日復往奠祭。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the consort of Prince Chun the Esteemed, of the Yehe Nara clan, died; court was suspended eleven days; the emperor and empress dowager went to the mansion for encoffining and returned the next day for mourning sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Prince Chun the Esteemed's Yehe Nara consort died; court halted eleven days; the emperor and empress dowager encoffined her and mourned again next day.

sentences.zh: 懿旨，醇賢親王福晉薨逝，應稱曰「皇帝本生妣」。

translations.literal: An empress dowager's rescript said that with the death of the consort of Prince Chun the Esteemed she should be styled "the emperor's biological mother."
translations.idiomatic: A rescript styled Prince Chun the Esteemed's late consort "the emperor's biological mother."

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上成服。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the emperor left mourning dress.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the emperor ended mourning dress.

sentences.zh: 壬子，免安徽歷年逋賦。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Anhui's accumulated arrear taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Anhui accumulated arrear taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲子，緩鄂倫春牲丁進貂貢。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Oroqen tribute of sable pelts was postponed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Oroqen sable tribute was postponed.

sentences.zh: 六月丙寅，諭奎順撫恤青海蒙民。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingyin: an edict told Kui Shun to comfort Qinghai Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: Month 6, bingyin: Kui Shun was told to comfort Qinghai Mongols.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，河決利津。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Yellow River broke at Lijin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the Yellow River broke at Lijin.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，免浙江歷年各場積欠灶課鹽課。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Zhejiang's accumulated salt-works and salt-tax arrears were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Zhejiang salt-works and salt-tax arrears were remitted.

sentences.zh: 庚午，賑浙江風災。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, victims of Zhejiang's wind disaster were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Zhejiang wind-disaster victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 壬申，醇賢親王福晉金棺奉移，上躬詣臨送。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the golden coffin of the prince's consort was moved; the emperor went in person to see it off.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the prince's consort's golden coffin was moved and the emperor saw it off in person.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，上奉皇太后如醇王園寓臨奠福晉金棺。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, the emperor and empress dowager went to the Prince Chun's garden residence to mourn before the golden coffin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the emperor and empress dowager mourned before the consort's golden coffin at Prince Chun's garden.

sentences.zh: 己卯，諭整頓長江水師。

translations.literal: On day jimao, an edict ordered the Yangtze naval forces reorganized.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Yangtze naval forces were ordered reorganized.

sentences.zh: 壬午，命裕祿兼充船政大臣。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Yu Lu was additionally appointed Superintendent of the Navy.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Yu Lu was also made Superintendent of the Navy.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，松潘番亂，官軍剿平之。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Songpan tribes rebelled and government troops pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Songpan tribes rebelled and were pacified.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，允王大臣請，神機營練兵處仿西制練兵。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, at the princes' request, the Shenji Battalion drill office was allowed to train troops in Western style.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the Shenji drill office was allowed Western-style training at princes' request.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，永定河溢。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the Yongding River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the Yongding River overflowed.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑大東溝海溢災，安徽、湖北蛟災。

translations.literal: This month, victims of the Great East Ditch sea flood and flood-dragon disasters in Anhui and Hubei were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: This month, Great East Ditch sea-flood and Anhui-Hubei flood-dragon victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiawu, first day: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Month 7, jiawu: a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，順天東南各屬水，命孫家鼐等速籌賑需。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, water in southeastern Zhili; Sun Jia'nai and others were ordered to prepare relief quickly.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, southeastern Zhili flooded and Sun Jia'nai was told to prepare relief quickly.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，留南漕十萬石於天津備賑。

translations.literal: On day yisi, one hundred thousand shi of southern tribute grain were kept at Tianjin for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, one hundred thousand shi of southern tribute grain were kept at Tianjin for relief.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑，以關內外回匪漸平，諭陶模、董福祥安輯降眾，搜捕餘匪。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yichou: as Hui bandits inside and outside the passes were gradually pacified, Tao Mo and Dong Fuxiang were told to settle those who surrendered and hunt down remnants.
translations.idiomatic: Month 8, yichou: as Hui bandits were pacified, Tao Mo and Dong Fuxiang were told to settle surrenders and hunt remnants.

sentences.zh: 己巳，川軍剿瞻對，疊克要隘，進逼中瞻。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Sichuan troops campaigning in Drayag took successive passes and advanced on central Drayag.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Sichuan troops in Drayag took passes and advanced on central Drayag.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，諭鹿傳霖：「瞻對用兵，乃暫時辦法。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, an edict to Lu Chuanlin said: "Using troops in Drayag is only a temporary measure.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Lu Chuanlin was told: "Drayag campaigning is only temporary.

sentences.zh: 事定後仍設番官否，當再審詳。

translations.literal: After affairs are settled, whether Tibetan officials should still be appointed must be reconsidered.
translations.idiomatic: Whether Tibetan officials should remain must be reconsidered after settlement.

sentences.zh: 不得因此苛責喇嘛，轉生他釁，慎勿鹵莽而行。

translations.literal: Do not on that account harshly blame the lamas and provoke new trouble; do not act rashly."
translations.idiomatic: Do not harshly blame lamas and provoke new trouble; do not act rashly."

sentences.zh: 」己丑，諭刑部訊獄應速結，毋任延宕。

translations.literal: " On day jichou, an edict told the Ministry of Punishments to conclude trials swiftly and not delay.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the Ministry of Punishments was told to conclude trials swiftly without delay.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，禁各省濫用非刑。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the provinces were forbidden to use illegal torture at will.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, provinces were forbidden to use illegal torture at will.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，福錕卒。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingshen: Fu Kun died.
translations.idiomatic: Month 9, bingshen: Fu Kun died.

sentences.zh: 免陝西前歲逋賦。

translations.literal: Shaanxi's prior-year arrear taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi prior-year arrear taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 己亥，東陵蟲災。

translations.literal: On day jihai, insects ravaged the Eastern Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, insects ravaged the Eastern Tombs.

sentences.zh: 丙午，賞盛宣懷四品京堂。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Sheng Xuanhuai was given fourth-rank kuotang status.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Sheng Xuanhuai received fourth-rank kuotang status.

sentences.zh: 先是，王文韶、張之洞請立招商輪船總公司，舉盛宣懷督辦。

translations.literal: Earlier, Wang Wenshao and Zhang Zhidong had asked to establish a China Merchants Steam Navigation Company with Sheng Xuanhuai as superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Wang Wenshao and Zhang Zhidong proposed a China Merchants Steam Navigation Company under Sheng Xuanhuai.

sentences.zh: 至是，旨下，並准專奏。

translations.literal: Now the decree came down, and he was allowed memorials on his own authority.
translations.idiomatic: Now the decree came down, and he was allowed to memorialize on his own authority.

sentences.zh: 大學士張之萬致仕。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Zhang Zhiwan retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhiwan retired as grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 丁未，見德使海靖、比使費葛於文華殿。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the German minister Heyking and the Belgian minister Fige were received at Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Heyking and Fige were received at Wenhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，命李鴻章在總理各國事務衙門行走。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Li Hongzhang was ordered to serve at the Zongli Yamen for Foreign Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Li Hongzhang was assigned to the Zongli Yamen.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，李秉衡言勘明黃河尾閭，擬由舊黃河東岸挑濬新河，仍導歸舊河入海。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Li Bingheng reported that the Yellow River mouth had been surveyed and proposed dredging a new channel from the old Yellow River's east bank to guide the flow back into the old river to reach the sea.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Li Bingheng proposed dredging a new channel off the old Yellow River's east bank to restore the old outlet.

sentences.zh: 諭以大舉興辦，務期一勞永逸，以副委任。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the work undertaken on a large scale so that it would be done once for all and fulfill the commission.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered a full-scale permanent fix.

sentences.zh: 是秋，賑河南、奉天、湖北、安徽、山東、山西、吉林、黑龍江水災，湖南蛟災，及陝、甘水災雹災，新疆蝗災雹災，廣東洋面風災。

translations.literal: That autumn, flood relief was granted in Henan, Fengtian, Hubei, Anhui, Shandong, Shanxi, Jilin, and Heilongjiang; dragon-flood relief in Hunan; flood and hail relief in Shaanxi and Gansu; locust and hail relief in Xinjiang; and wind-disaster relief on Guangdong's coastal waters.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn many provinces received flood, hail, locust, and coastal wind relief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌朔，賑湖北江、漢水災。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, new moon on day renxu: flood relief was granted for disasters on the Yangtze and Han rivers in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In winter month 10, renxu new moon, Hubei Yangtze and Han flood victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，辦河州冬賑。

translations.literal: On day guihai, winter famine relief was organized in Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Hezhou winter relief was arranged.

sentences.zh: 甲子，增設蘇州、杭州、沙市、思茅四關。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, four customs posts were added at Suzhou, Hangzhou, Shashi, and Simao.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day customs were opened at Suzhou, Hangzhou, Shashi, and Simao.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，諭陶模選廉明賢吏，和輯漢、回，偶有爭執，專論是非，准情理以劑其平，並分別撫恤被兵區域。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Tao Mo was instructed to select upright and capable officials, reconcile Han and Hui, judge disputes solely on right and wrong and settle them by reason, and give separate relief to war-stricken areas.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Tao Mo was told to pick honest officials, reconcile Han and Hui, judge fairly, and aid war zones.

sentences.zh: 論平回功，予董福祥騎都尉世職，授陶模陝甘總督，饒應祺新疆巡撫，予奎順、魏光燾優敘，其餘甄敘有差。

translations.literal: For merit in pacifying the Hui, Dong Fuxiang was granted a hereditary Commandant of Cavalry post; Tao Mo was made governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu; Rao Yingqi was made governor of Xinjiang; Kui Shun and Wei Guangtao received preferential commendation; and the rest were rewarded in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Pacifying the Hui, Dong Fuxiang received a hereditary title, Tao Mo became Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general, Rao Yingqi Xinjiang governor, and others were commended.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，永定河決口合龍。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, the Yongding River breach was closed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the Yongding River breach was sealed.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，定朝鮮設領事，不立條約，不遣使，不遞國書，以總領事一人駐其都城。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, it was decided that Korea would have a consul but no treaty, no envoy, and no state letter; one consul-general would be stationed in its capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Korea was to have a consul-general only, without treaty, envoy, or state letter.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命左都御史楊儒充出使俄奧荷大臣，道員羅豐祿充出使英義比大臣，黃遵憲充出使德國大臣，伍廷芳充出使美日祕大臣。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Left Censor-in-Chief Yang Ru was appointed minister to Russia, Austria, and Holland; Director Luo Fenglu minister to Britain, Italy, and Belgium; Huang Zunxian minister to Germany; and Wu Tingfang minister to the United States, Japan, and Peru.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Yang Ru, Luo Fenglu, Huang Zunxian, and Wu Tingfang were named ministers to various Western powers.

sentences.zh: 癸未，免武清等州縣秋賦雜課。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, autumn grain tax and miscellaneous levies were remitted in Wuding and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Wuding and other counties were exempted autumn tax and levies.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賑華州等處水災。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, flood relief was granted in Huazhou and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Huazhou and other flood districts were relieved.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以徐桐為體仁閣大學士，李鴻藻以禮部尚書協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Xu Tong was made Grand Secretary of the Tiren Pavilion and Li Hongzao associate grand secretary while Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Xu Tong became Tiren Pavilion grand secretary and Li Hongzao an associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊申，冬至，祀天於圜丘。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wushen: the winter solstice; Heaven was worshipped at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, wushen day, the winter solstice sacrifice was held at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 己酉，免朝賀。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, court congratulations were waived.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day congratulatory audiences were waived.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，免河、洮等處被災賦課。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, taxes and levies were remitted in flood-stricken He and Tao districts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day He and Tao flood districts were exempted taxes.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命工部侍郎許景澄充出使德國大臣。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Works Vice Minister Xu Jingcheng was appointed minister to Germany.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Xu Jingcheng was made envoy to Germany.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑山東、四川水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood relief was granted in Shandong and Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shandong and Sichuan flood victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，初，鹿傳霖屢奏瞻對宜剿，擬收回後改設漢官。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yichou, at first: Lu Chuanlin had repeatedly memorialized that Dartsedo should be attacked and afterward replaced with Han officials.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, yichou day, Lu Chuanlin had long urged attacking Dartsedo and replacing it with Han officials.

sentences.zh: 上慮失達賴心，命鹿傳霖、文海等詳議。

translations.literal: The emperor, fearing to lose the Dalai Lama's goodwill, ordered Lu Chuanlin, Wen Hai, and others to deliberate in detail.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, fearing to alienate the Dalai, ordered Lu Chuanlin and Wen Hai to study the matter.

sentences.zh: 至是，疏陳瞻民向化，藏番震懾各情。

translations.literal: By now they memorialized that the Dartsedo people were turning toward civilization and the Tibetan tribes were awed.
translations.idiomatic: They now reported Dartsedo people receptive and Tibetans intimidated.

sentences.zh: 因諭剴切勸導達賴，期於保藏、保川兩無窒礙。

translations.literal: Therefore the court earnestly instructed them to persuade the Dalai Lama so that protecting Tibet and protecting Sichuan would both proceed without obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: The court therefore urged earnest persuasion of the Dalai so Tibet and Sichuan could both be secured.

sentences.zh: 賑四川東鄉等屬災。

translations.literal: Disaster relief was granted in Dongxiang and other subordinate districts of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan's Dongxiang and other districts received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 丙子，免遼陽各村屯糧賦，綏德等州縣逋糧。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, grain tax was remitted in Liaoyang village hamlets and overdue grain in Suide and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Liaoyang villages and Suide arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 二十三年丁酉春正月辛卯朔，停筵宴。

translations.literal: Twenty-third year, spring, first month, new moon on day xinmao: banquets were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23, month 1, xinmao new moon, banquets were stopped.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，免山東光緒初年逋賦。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, overdue taxes from the early Guangxu years in Shandong were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Shandong's early Guangxu arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，留湖北漕米充工賑。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Hubei canal grain was retained for work relief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Hubei canal grain was kept for work relief.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，見美、法、英、德、荷、比、俄、義、日本及日、奧諸國公使於文華殿。

translations.literal: On day yimao, envoys of the United States, France, Britain, Germany, Holland, Belgium, Russia, Italy, Japan, and Austria were received at Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day envoys of many Western powers were received at Wenhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌，命戶部侍郎張廕桓使英。

translations.literal: Second month, day renxu: Revenue Vice Minister Zhang Yinhuai was appointed envoy to Britain.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, renxu day, Zhang Yinhuai was made envoy to Britain.

sentences.zh: 庚午，河決歷城、章丘。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Yellow River burst at Licheng and Zhangqiu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Yellow River broke at Licheng and Zhangqiu.

sentences.zh: 己卯，命崇禮、許應騤在總理各國事務衙門行走。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Chongli and Xu Yingkui were ordered to serve at the Zongli Yamen.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Chongli and Xu Yingkui joined the Zongli Yamen.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，詔汰冗兵。

translations.literal: Third month, day guisi: an edict ordered redundant troops cut.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, guisi day, an edict culled redundant troops.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，懿旨發內帑十萬賑四川，五萬賑湖北，並以庫帑十萬加賑四川夔、綏、忠三屬。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, an empress dowager edict released 100,000 taels from the inner treasury for Sichuan relief and 50,000 for Hubei, and 100,000 from the state treasury was added for the Kui, Sui, and Zhong subprefectures of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Cixi allotted inner funds for Sichuan and Hubei and added treasury silver for three Sichuan districts.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，免銅仁、青谿被水田賦。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, land tax on flooded fields in Tongren and Qingxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Tongren and Qingxi flooded land tax was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，初設海參葳委員。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, sea-cucumber commissioners were first established.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day sea-cucumber commissioners were first appointed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙亥，李秉衡奏減山東錢漕。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yihai: Li Bingheng memorialized reducing Shandong money and grain taxes.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month 4, yihai day, Li Bingheng asked to cut Shandong money and grain levies.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申，詔棍噶札拉參胡圖克圖嘉穆巴圖多普准轉世為八音溝承化寺胡圖克圖。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingshen: an edict approved the reincarnation of the Kunka Lama Jambatob as Hutuktu of the Chenghua Monastery at Bayin Gol.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, bingshen day, a Hutuktu reincarnation at Bayin Gol was confirmed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，張之萬卒，贈太保。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Zhang Zhiwan died and was posthumously made Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Zhang Zhiwan died and received the posthumous rank Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上詣本生妣醇賢親王福晉園寢，週年釋服。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the emperor visited the tomb of his biological mother, the consort of Prince Chunxian, and completed the first anniversary mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the emperor observed the first anniversary at his birth mother's tomb.

sentences.zh: 壬子，予呂海寰四品京堂，充出使德荷二國大臣。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Lü Haihuan was given fourth-rank capital official rank and appointed minister to Germany and Holland.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Lü Haihuan was made envoy to Germany and Holland.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，賑崇陽等縣水災。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jimao: flood relief was granted in Chongyang and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, jimao day, Chongyang and other counties were relieved.

sentences.zh: 是夏，見奧使齊幹、俄使烏爾他木斯科、英使竇納樂、日使矢野文雄於文華殿。

translations.literal: That summer, the Austrian envoy Qigan, the Russian envoy Urtamuskov, the British envoy MacDonald, and the Japanese envoy Yano Fumio were received at Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: That summer Austrian, Russian, British, and Japanese envoys were received at Wenhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚寅，李鴻藻卒。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengyin: Li Hongzao died.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, month 7, gengyin day, Li Hongzao died.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命廖壽恆在總理各國事務衙門行走。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Liao Shouheng was ordered to serve at the Zongli Yamen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Liao Shouheng joined the Zongli Yamen.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，復故陝西固原提督雷正綰原官。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, former Shaanxi Guyuan commander Lei Zhengzhuan was restored to his original post.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Lei Zhengzhuan regained his former Guyuan command.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，免岷州衛二十四寺進騾，並展緩馬貢。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, the mule tribute from the twenty-four monasteries of Minzhou Guard was remitted and the horse tribute deadline was extended.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Minzhou's twenty-four monasteries were exempted mule tribute and horse tribute was deferred.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，平遙普洞村山陷入地中。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, a mountain at Putong village in Pingyao sank into the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day a Pingyao mountain collapsed into a pit.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，靖西地震。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jisi: an earthquake struck Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, jisi day, Jingxi was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命翁同龢以戶部尚書協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Weng Tonghe was made associate grand secretary while Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Weng Tonghe became an associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 癸未，弛科布多札哈沁寶爾吉礦禁，許蒙、漢民人開採。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the mining ban at Baerji in Zakhchin of Kobdo was lifted and Mongol and Han subjects were allowed to mine.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Kobdo's Baerji mines were opened to Mongol and Han miners.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以鹿傳霖於德爾格忒土司措理失宜，罷改土歸流議，釋土司昂翁降白仁青暨其家屬，仍回德爾格忒管土司事。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, because Lu Chuanlin had mishandled the Dergete native chieftain, the plan to replace native rule with regular administration was abandoned; the chieftain Angong Jiangbairenjing and his family were released and returned to govern Dergete.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Lu Chuanlin's Dergete errors ended gaitu guiliu; Angong Jiangbairenjing resumed native rule.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，鹿傳霖罷。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuzi: Lu Chuanlin was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, wuzi day, Lu Chuanlin was removed.

sentences.zh: 己丑，命德爾格忒撤兵。

translations.literal: On day jichou, troops were ordered withdrawn from Dergete.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Dergete troops were recalled.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，見挪威使柏固於文華殿。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Norwegian envoy Berg was received at Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the Norwegian envoy Berg was received at Wenhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，達賴喇嘛請還瞻對地。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, the Dalai Lama requested the return of Dartsedo lands.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Dalai asked for Dartsedo back.

sentences.zh: 諭恭壽等會商以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Gong Shou and others to consult and report.
translations.idiomatic: Gong Shou and others were told to consult and report.

sentences.zh: 丙午，利津決口合龍。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Lijin breach was closed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Lijin breach was sealed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，復故陝甘總督楊昌濬官。

translations.literal: On day yimao, former Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general Yang Changjun was restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Yang Changjun regained his former Shaanxi-Gansu post.

sentences.zh: 是秋，賑陝西雹災水災，湖南北、江西、廣東、安徽、雲、貴水災，新疆蝗災。

translations.literal: That autumn, hail and flood relief was granted in Shaanxi; flood relief in Hunan, Hubei, Jiangxi, Guangdong, Anhui, Yunnan, and Guizhou; and locust relief in Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn many provinces received hail, flood, and locust relief.

sentences.zh: 十月戊午，廣西巡撫史念祖坐事褫職。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day wuwu: Guangxi Governor Shi Nianzu was dismissed for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, wuwu day, Shi Nianzu lost the Guangxi governorship.

sentences.zh: 壬申，曹州匪戕害德國教士，命李秉衡察勘之。

translations.literal: On day renshen, bandits in Caozhou killed German missionaries; Li Bingheng was ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Caozhou bandits killed German missionaries and Li Bingheng was sent to investigate.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，德以兵輪入膠澳。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Germany sent warships into Jiaozhou Bay.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day German warships entered Jiaozhou Bay.

sentences.zh: 壬午，免樂亭等州縣被災額賦。

translations.literal: On day renwu, assessed taxes were remitted in Leting and other disaster counties.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Leting and other disaster counties were exempted taxes.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑廣東風災，陝西雹災，湖南、江南水災。

translations.literal: That month, wind-disaster relief was granted in Guangdong, hail relief in Shaanxi, and flood relief in Hunan and Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: That month Guangdong, Shaanxi, Hunan, and Jiangnan disaster victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯，撥江北漕米三萬石，備徐、海各屬賑。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinmao: 30,000 shi of Jiangbei canal grain was allocated for relief in Xu and Hai districts.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, xinmao day, 30,000 shi of Jiangbei grain was set aside for Xu and Hai relief.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔罷三瞻改土歸流議，仍隸達賴喇嘛。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, an edict abolished the plan to replace the three Samsan districts with regular administration; they remained under the Dalai Lama.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Samsan gaitu guiliu was dropped and the lands stayed under the Dalai.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，諭安撫江蘇各屬饑民。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, an edict ordered the starving people of Jiangsu subordinates comforted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Jiangsu famine victims were to be comforted.

sentences.zh: 丁未，英使竇納樂入見。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the British envoy MacDonald had an audience.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day MacDonald was received in audience.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，冬至，祀天於圜丘。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the winter solstice; Heaven was worshipped at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the winter solstice sacrifice was held at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，免朝賀。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, court congratulations were waived.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day congratulatory audiences were waived.

sentences.zh: 昭烏達盟旗匪平。

translations.literal: Bandits in the Zhaowuda League banners were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaowuda league bandits were put down.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，利津河決。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiazi: the Lijin River burst.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, jiazi day, the Lijin River broke.

sentences.zh: 己巳，免安州澇地租。

translations.literal: On day jisi, rent on waterlogged land in Anzhou was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Anzhou flooded land rent was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，三巖野番就撫，改設土千戶，隸巴塘。

translations.literal: On day yihai, wild tribes of Sanyan submitted; a native thousand-household post was established under Batang.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Sanyan tribes submitted and a native chief was set under Batang.

sentences.zh: 罷硃窩、章谷兩土司歸流議。

translations.literal: Plans to replace the Zhuzhuo and Zhanggu native chieftains with regular administration were abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuzhuo and Zhanggu gaitu guiliu plans were dropped.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔各省保護教堂教士。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, an edict ordered every province to protect churches and missionaries.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day provinces were told to protect churches and missionaries.

sentences.zh: 免狄道、巴燕戎格等處額賦。

translations.literal: Assessed taxes were remitted in Didao, Bayan Rongge, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Didao, Bayan Rongge, and other districts were exempted taxes.

sentences.zh: 二十四年戊戌春正月乙酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Twenty-fourth year, spring, first month, new moon on day yiyou: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In year 24, month 1, yiyou new moon, a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 元旦受禮改於乾清宮，停宗親宴。

translations.literal: New Year congratulations were moved to the Qianqing Palace and the clan banquet was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: New Year rites moved to the Qianqing Palace and the clan feast was canceled.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔各省大吏定議籌餉練兵，速覆以聞。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, an edict ordered provincial governors to devise plans for raising funds and drilling troops and report quickly.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day governors were told to plan revenue and training and report soon.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，定經濟特科及歲舉法。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, special economic examinations and an annual recommendation system were established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day special economic exams and annual recommendations were instituted.

sentences.zh: 命中外保薦堪與特科者。

translations.literal: Inside and outside the court were ordered to recommend men fit for the special examination.
translations.idiomatic: Court and provinces were told to recommend candidates for the special exam.

sentences.zh: 乙未，免建水被旱夏糧。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, summer grain tax was remitted in drought-stricken Jianshui.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Jianshui drought districts were exempted summer grain.

sentences.zh: 己酉，見各國公使於文華殿。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, envoys of various countries were received at Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day foreign envoys were received at Wenhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 壬子，免石屏、昆明夏糧。

translations.literal: On day renzi, summer grain tax was remitted in Shiping and Kunming.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Shiping and Kunming summer grain was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子，命廖壽恆在軍機大臣上學習行走。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiazi: Liao Shouheng was ordered to study while serving above the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, jiazi day, Liao Shouheng was told to learn on the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，免清海阿里克番族馬貢銀。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, horse-tribute silver for the Alirik tribes of Qinghai was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Qinghai Alirik horse tribute silver was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，留江北漕米一萬石賑徐州災。

translations.literal: On day yisi, 10,000 shi of Jiangbei canal grain was retained to relieve the disaster in Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day 10,000 shi of Jiangbei grain was kept for Xuzhou relief.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命神機營選練先鋒隊。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Shenji Camp was ordered to select and drill a vanguard corps.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the Shenji Camp was told to train a vanguard unit.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔武科改試槍砲，停默寫武經。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, an edict changed the military examination to firearms and cannon and ended copying military classics from memory.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the military exam tested guns and dropped memorized classics.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥，詔立義倉。

translations.literal: Third month, day dinghai: an edict ordered charity granaries established.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, dinghai day, an edict set up charity granaries.

sentences.zh: 戊子，俄使巴布羅福覲見。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Russian envoy Pavlov was received in audience.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the Russian envoy Pavlov had an audience.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，除新化被水額賦。

translations.literal: On day yisi, assessed taxes were remitted in flood-stricken Xinhua.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Xinhua flood taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 是月，開直隸北戴河至秦王島、湖南岳州、福建三都澳口岸。

translations.literal: That month, treaty ports were opened from Beidaihe in Zhili to Qinhuangdao, Yuezhou in Hunan, and Sandu Ao in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: That month Beidaihe-Qinhuangdao, Yuezhou, and Sandu Ao were opened as ports.

sentences.zh: 閏三月乙卯，召張之洞來京。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, day yimao: Zhang Zhidong was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In intercalary month 3, yimao day, Zhang Zhidong was called to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，麟書卒。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Lin Shu died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Lin Shu died.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以德人入即墨文廟，毀聖賢像，下總署察問。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, because Germans entered the Jimo Confucian temple and destroyed images of the sages, the Zongli Yamen was ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Germans destroyed sage images at Jimo temple and the Zongli Yamen was told to inquire.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，臨恭親王邸視疾。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the emperor visited Prince Gong's residence to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, the emperor called at Prince Gong's mansion to see him in illness.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，上侍皇太后幸外火器營教場，閱火器、健銳、神機三營及武勝新隊操，凡三日。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, the emperor attended the empress dowager to the outer Firearms Brigade parade ground, reviewing drills of the Firearms, Vanguard Sharp-shooter, and Divine Engine brigades and the Wusheng new company—for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, with the empress dowager he reviewed three brigades and the Wusheng company at the outer firearms camp for three days.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以湖北沙市焚毀教堂，諭張之洞回任。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, because a church was burned at Shashi in Hubei, Zhang Zhidong was ordered to resume his post.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, after Shashi church was burned, Zhang Zhidong was ordered back to his post.

sentences.zh: 續賑徐、海災。

translations.literal: Relief for Xu and Hai disasters was continued.
translations.idiomatic: Relief for Xu and Hai disasters continued.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，見德親王亨利於玉瀾堂。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, German Prince Henry was received at the Yulan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, German Prince Henry was received at Yulan Hall.

sentences.zh: 己卯，還宮。

translations.literal: On day jimao, the emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 免新興被旱額賦。

translations.literal: The assessed tax quota for Xinxing, stricken by drought, was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Xinxing drought-stricken quota taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，見法使畢勝於文華殿。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, French minister Bertheson was received in the Hall of Literary Glory.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, French minister Bertheson was received at Wenhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 壬午，安徽鳳、穎、泗災。

translations.literal: On day renwu, disasters struck Fengyang, Yingzhou, and Sizhou in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Fengyang, Yingzhou, and Sizhou in Anhui suffered disaster.

sentences.zh: 是春，以膠州灣租借於德意志，旅順口、大連灣、遼東半島租借於俄羅斯。

translations.literal: That spring Jiaozhou Bay was leased to Germany and Lüshunkou, Dalian Bay, and the Liaodong Peninsula to Russia.
translations.idiomatic: That spring Jiaozhou went to Germany and Lüshun, Dalian, and Liaodong to Russia.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬辰，恭親王奕訢薨，輟朝五日，素服十五日，臨邸賜奠。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renchen: Prince Gong Yixin died; court mourning was five days and plain dress fifteen days; the emperor visited the residence to grant funeral offerings.
translations.idiomatic: In summer month 4, renchen, Prince Gong Yixin died; mourning five days; the emperor granted funeral rites at his residence.

sentences.zh: 懿旨特謚曰忠。

translations.literal: An edict from the empress dowager gave the special posthumous title Zhong (Loyal).
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager gave the posthumous title Zhong.

sentences.zh: 守衛園寢增設丁戶，每祭祀官經理之。

translations.literal: For guarding the princely mausoleum, guard households were added; officials managed each sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Mausoleum guard households were added; officials managed sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 孫貝勒溥偉襲。

translations.literal: His grandson, Beile Puyu, succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Beile Puyu succeeded.

sentences.zh: 甲午，懿旨，恭忠親王功在社稷，應配饗太廟。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, an imperial edict: Prince Gong the Loyal's merit to the altars of state warranted joint sacrifice in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Prince Gong Loyal was ordered enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 詔中外臣工當法恭忠親王，各攄忠悃，共濟時艱。

translations.literal: An edict told officials at court and throughout the empire to take Prince Gong Loyal as their model, each lay forth loyal purpose, and jointly meet the day's hardship.
translations.idiomatic: An edict told all officials to emulate Prince Gong Loyal and serve the state loyally.

sentences.zh: 己亥，授榮祿為文淵閣大學士，剛毅為兵部尚書協辦大學士。
