translations.literal: On day jihai, Ronglu was made Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion; Gang Yi, Minister of War, was to assist as Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Ronglu became Wenyuan Grand Secretary; Gang Yi assisted as Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔定國是，諭：「中外大小諸臣，自王公至於士庶，各宜發憤為雄。

translations.literal: On day yisi, an edict fixed the national policy, instructing: "Officials great and small at court and abroad, from princes and dukes down to commoners, should each resolve to exert themselves.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, an edict fixed national policy: all ranks should resolve to strive.

sentences.zh: 以聖賢義理之學植其根本，兼博採西學之切時勢者，實力講求，以成通達濟變之才。

translations.literal: Plant your roots in the learning of the sages' righteous principles, and also broadly gather Western learning suited to the times, studying it in earnest, to form talent able to grasp change and meet needs.
translations.idiomatic: Root in sage learning and earnestly study timely Western learning to form adaptable talent.

sentences.zh: 京師大學堂為行省倡，尤應首先舉辦。

translations.literal: The Capital University should lead the provinces and above all be founded first.
translations.idiomatic: The Capital University should lead provinces and be founded first.

sentences.zh: 軍機大臣、王大臣妥速會議以聞。

translations.literal: Grand Councillors and princely ministers should promptly convene, deliberate fitting measures, and memorialize.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Councillors and princes should promptly deliberate and report.

sentences.zh: 」丙午，詔各省立商務局。

translations.literal: " On day bingwu, an edict ordered each province to establish a Bureau of Commerce.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, each province was ordered to set up a commerce bureau.

sentences.zh: 賜夏同龢等三百四十二人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: Xia Tonghe and 341 others were granted jinshi with passing grades in differing ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Tonghe and 341 others received jinshi degrees in varying ranks.

sentences.zh: 己酉，翁同龢罷。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Weng Tonghe was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Weng Tonghe was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 選派宗室王公出洋遊歷。

translations.literal: Imperial clansmen and princes were selected to travel abroad.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial princes were chosen to travel abroad.

sentences.zh: 近支王、貝勒等，上親察之；

translations.literal: For close collateral kings and beiles, the emperor inspected them personally;
translations.idiomatic: Close-branch kings and beiles were personally inspected by the emperor;

sentences.zh: 公以下及閒散人員，由宗人府保薦。

translations.literal: for dukes and below and idle personnel, the Imperial Clan Court recommended.
translations.idiomatic: dukes and below and idle clansmen were recommended by the Imperial Clan Court.

sentences.zh: 召王文韶來京。

translations.literal: Wang Wenshao was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wenshao was summoned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 裁督辦軍務處。

translations.literal: The office for supervising military affairs was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The military affairs supervision office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，召見工部主事康有為，命充總理各國事務衙門章京。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Kang Youwei, secretary in the Board of Works, was summoned; he was appointed a clerk of the Zongli Yamen.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Kang Youwei was summoned and made a Zongli Yamen clerk.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，前藏達賴喇嘛貢方物。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the former Dalai Lama of Tibet presented tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, the former Dalai Lama presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑朔，詔陸軍改練洋操，令營弁學成者教練，於北由新建陸軍，於南由自強軍派往。

translations.literal: Fifth month, guichou new moon: the army was ordered to drill Western tactics; officers who had mastered them would instruct; in the north from the new army, in the south from the Self-Strengthening Army were dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: Month 5, guichou new moon: troops were ordered to drill Western tactics; northern instructors from the new army, southern from the Self-Strengthening Army.

sentences.zh: 各疆臣限六閱月，舉並餉練兵及分駐地，妥議以聞。

translations.literal: Each governor-general had six months to report on merged pay, drilled troops, and garrison posts.
translations.idiomatic: Each governor-general had six months to report on pay, training, and garrisons.

sentences.zh: 其軍械槍砲，各省機器局酌定格式，精求製造。

translations.literal: For arms and cannon each provincial arsenal should set models and seek fine manufacture.
translations.idiomatic: Each provincial arsenal was to set arms standards and improve manufacture.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，賑棲霞火災。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Qixia fire victims were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Qixia fire victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔自下科始，鄉、會、歲、科各試，向用四書文者，改試策論。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, from the next examination cycle provincial, metropolitan, annual, and biennial tests that had used Eight-legged Essays were changed to policy essays.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, civil exams from the next cycle switched from eight-legged essays to policy essays.

sentences.zh: 命孫家鼐以吏部尚書協辦大學士，王文韶以戶部尚書為軍機大臣兼總理各國事務衙門行走。

translations.literal: Sun Jianai was made assisting Grand Secretary as Minister of Personnel; Wang Wenshao, Minister of Revenue, Grand Councillor and Zongli Yamen commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Jianai became assisting Grand Secretary; Wang Wenshao became Grand Councillor and Zongli Yamen commissioner.

sentences.zh: 授榮祿直隸總督兼北洋大臣。

translations.literal: Ronglu was made governor-general of Zhili and concurrently commissioner for the Northern Seas.
translations.idiomatic: Ronglu became Zhili governor-general and Northern Seas commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚申，趣盛宣懷蘆漢鐵路刻日興工，並開辦粵漢、寧滬各路。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Sheng Xuanhuai was urged to start the Lu-Han Railway at once and also open the Yue-Han and Ning-Hu lines.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Sheng Xuanhuai was urged to start the Lu-Han Railway and open Yue-Han and Ning-Hu lines.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔以經濟歲舉歸並正科，歲、科試悉改策論，毋待來年。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the economic special triennial intake was merged with the regular examination; annual and biennial tests all switched to policy essays without waiting until next year.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, the economic special exam merged with the regular cycle; all tests switched to policy essays at once.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔立京師大學堂，命孫家鼐管理。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Capital University was ordered founded; Sun Jianai was placed in charge.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the Capital University was founded under Sun Jianai.

sentences.zh: 賞舉人梁啟超六品銜，辦理譯書局。

translations.literal: Juren Liang Qichao was given rank six pin and put in charge of the Translation Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Juren Liang Qichao received sixth rank and headed the Translation Bureau.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔興農學。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, agriculture and industry were ordered promoted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, agriculture and industry were ordered promoted.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「振興庶務，首在鼓勵人材。

translations.literal: An instruction said: "To revive all affairs, first encourage talent.
translations.idiomatic: An instruction said: to revive affairs, first encourage talent.

sentences.zh: 各省士民著有新書，及創新法，成新器，堪資實用者，宜懸賞以勸。

translations.literal: Scholars and commoners in each province who wrote useful new books, devised new methods, or made new devices should receive bounty to encourage them.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial scholars and people with useful books, methods, or devices should receive bounty.

sentences.zh: 或試之實職，或錫之章服。

translations.literal: Some might be tried in real posts, others granted insignia and robes.
translations.idiomatic: Some might get real posts, others robes and insignia.

sentences.zh: 所制器給券，限年專利售賣。

translations.literal: For devices invented, certificates were given with term-limited exclusive sale.
translations.idiomatic: Inventors received certificates for term-limited exclusive sale.

sentences.zh: 其有獨力創建學堂，開闢地利，興造槍砲廠者，並照軍功例賞勵之。

translations.literal: Those who alone founded schools, opened land advantage, or built gun factories would be rewarded by the military merit precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Solo founders of schools, land projects, or gun factories would be rewarded like military merit.

sentences.zh: 」辛未，免祿勸被水田糧。

translations.literal: " On day xinwei, flooded-field grain tax in Luquan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Luquan flooded-field grain tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔八旗兩翼諸營，均以其半改習洋槍、抬槍。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, both wings of the Eight Banners were ordered to convert half to Western rifles and wall guns.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, half of each Eight Banner wing was ordered to drill Western rifles and wall guns.

sentences.zh: 以奕劻等管理驍騎營，崇禮等管理護軍營。

translations.literal: Yikuang and others managed the Vanguard Cavalry; Chongli and others the Guard Corps.
translations.idiomatic: Yikuang managed the Vanguard Cavalry; Chongli the Guard Corps.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔改直省各屬書院為兼習中西學校，以省書院為高等學，郡書院為中等學，州、縣書院為小學。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, provincial academies were made schools teaching Chinese and Western learning: provincial academy as higher, prefectural as middle, district as primary.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, academies became Chinese-Western schools: provincial higher, prefectural middle, district primary.

sentences.zh: 其地方義學、社學亦如之。

translations.literal: Local charity and community schools likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Local charity and community schools followed suit.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命裕祿為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Yulu was made Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Yulu became Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 丙子，諭各省州縣實力保護教堂。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, provinces were told to protect churches in earnest.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, provinces were told to protect churches earnestly.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命三品以上京堂及各省督撫、學政舉堪與經濟特科者。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, capital officials rank three and above and governors and education commissioners were ordered to recommend candidates for the economic special examination.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, senior capital officials and governors were told to recommend economic special exam candidates.

sentences.zh: 頒士民著書，制器暨創興新政獎勵章程。

translations.literal: Regulations were promulgated for rewards to scholars and people for books, devices, and new policies.
translations.idiomatic: Reward rules were issued for books, devices, and new policies.

sentences.zh: 命中外舉製造、駕駛、聲光化電人材。

translations.literal: Court and provinces were ordered to recommend talent in manufacture, navigation, and sound-light-chemistry-electricity.
translations.idiomatic: Court and provinces were told to recommend talent in manufacture, navigation, and science.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔各省保護商務。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, provinces were ordered to protect commerce.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, provinces were ordered to protect commerce.

sentences.zh: 免海康、遂谿上年被災額賦。

translations.literal: Assessed taxes for Haikang and Suixi last year, disaster-stricken, were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Last year's quota taxes for disaster-hit Haikang and Suixi were remitted.

sentences.zh: 賑長安等州縣水災雹災。

translations.literal: Chang'an and other districts received flood and hail relief.
translations.idiomatic: Chang'an and other districts received flood and hail relief.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未朔，詔改定科舉新章。

translations.literal: Sixth month, guiwei new moon: new civil service examination rules were ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Month 6, guiwei new moon: new examination rules were ordered.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，賑徐、海災。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Xu and Hai disaster victims were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Xu and Hai disaster victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔頒張之洞著勸學篇，令直省刊布。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Zhang Zhidong's Exhortation to Learning was ordered published in each province.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Zhang Zhidong's Exhortation to Learning was ordered published province-wide.

sentences.zh: 命康有為督辦官報。

translations.literal: Kang Youwei was ordered to supervise the official gazette.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Youwei was ordered to supervise the official gazette.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，命榮祿會同張之洞督辦蘆漢鐵路。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Ronglu with Zhang Zhidong were ordered to supervise the Lu-Han Railway.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Ronglu and Zhang Zhidong were ordered to supervise the Lu-Han Railway.

sentences.zh: 鬱林、梧州土匪、會匪相結為亂，陷容、興業、陸川三縣，官軍剿平之。

translations.literal: In Yulin and Wuzhou bandits and secret-society men joined in revolt, seized Rong, Xingye, and Luchuan; government troops suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: Yulin and Wuzhou bandits and secret societies seized three counties; government troops suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 丙申，饒應祺進回部貢金。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Rao Yingqi presented golden tribute from the Muslim west.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Rao Yingqi presented Muslim-west golden tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命翰詹、科道輪班召對。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Hanlin and censorate officials were ordered to take turns in imperial audience.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Hanlin and censorate officials were ordered to rotate in audience.

sentences.zh: 部院司員條列時事，堂官代陳。

translations.literal: Department clerks were to list current affairs; department heads present them.
translations.idiomatic: Department clerks listed current affairs; heads presented them.

sentences.zh: 士民得上書言事。

translations.literal: Scholars and commoners might submit memorials on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars and commoners might submit memorials.

sentences.zh: 設礦務鐵路總局於京師，王文韶、張廕桓專理之。

translations.literal: A General Bureau for Mines and Railways was set up in the capital; Wang Wenshao and Zhang Yinhuan managed it.
translations.idiomatic: A mines and railways bureau was set up in the capital under Wang Wenshao and Zhang Yinhuan.

sentences.zh: 庚子，湖南設製造槍砲兩廠。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Hunan set up two factories for guns and cannon.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Hunan set up two gun and cannon factories.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，賑寧羌火災，洵陽等縣水災雹災。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Ningqiang fire and Xunyang flood and hail victims were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Ningqiang fire and Xunyang flood and hail victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命伍廷芳賑古巴華民。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Wu Tingfang was ordered to relieve overseas Chinese in Cuba.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Wu Tingfang was ordered to relieve Chinese in Cuba.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，諭曰：「時局艱難，亟須圖自強之策。

translations.literal: On day yisi, an instruction said: "The situation is hard; self-strengthening policy is urgently needed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, an instruction said: the times are hard and self-strengthening is urgent.

sentences.zh: 中外臣工墨守舊章，前經諭令講求時務，勿蹈宋、明積習，訓誡諄諄。

translations.literal: Officials cling to old forms; earlier orders to study current affairs and not repeat Song-Ming habits were earnest.
translations.idiomatic: Officials clung to old forms despite earnest orders to study current affairs.

sentences.zh: 惟是更新要務，造端宏大，條目繁多，不得不廣集眾長，折衷一是。

translations.literal: Yet renewal is vast in scope with many items; wide counsel and one settled plan are needed.
translations.idiomatic: Yet renewal was vast and needed wide counsel and one settled plan.

sentences.zh: 諸臣於交議之事，當周諮博訪，詳細討論。

translations.literal: In matters referred for debate ministers should inquire widely and discuss fully.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers debating referred matters should inquire widely and discuss fully.

sentences.zh: 毋緣飾經術，附會古義，毋膠執成見，隱便身圖。

translations.literal: Do not dress up classics or force ancient parallels; do not cling to fixed views for private ease.
translations.idiomatic: Do not dress up classics or cling to fixed views for private ease.

sentences.zh: 倘面從心違，致失朝廷實事求是本旨，非朕所望也。

translations.literal: If you agree outwardly but resist inwardly, missing the court's pragmatic aim—that is not what We expect.
translations.idiomatic: Outward agreement with inward resistance was not what the throne expected.

sentences.zh: 朕深惟窮變通久之義，創建一切，實具萬不得已之苦衷。

translations.literal: We deeply weigh change and endurance; all these creations spring from utmost necessity.
translations.idiomatic: The throne weighed change and endurance; reforms sprang from utmost necessity.

sentences.zh: 用申諭爾諸臣，其各精白乃心，力除壅蔽，上下一誠相感，庶國是以定，而治道蒸蒸矣。

translations.literal: We thus repeat this to you: each clarify your heart, remove obstruction, let upper and lower respond in sincerity—then the empire may be settled and governance flourish.
translations.idiomatic: Each should clarify his heart, remove obstruction, and let upper and lower respond in sincerity.

sentences.zh: 」諭南北洋大臣籌辦水師及路礦學堂。

translations.literal: " Ministers of the northern and southern seas were told to plan naval forces and schools for railways and mines.
translations.idiomatic: Northern and southern sea commissioners were told to plan navies and railway-mine schools.

sentences.zh: 諭各省廣開通商口岸。

translations.literal: Provinces were told to widen treaty ports.
translations.idiomatic: Provinces were told to widen treaty ports.

sentences.zh: 命黃遵憲以三品京堂充駐朝鮮大臣。

translations.literal: Huang Zunxian, rank-three capital official, was made resident minister in Korea.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Zunxian, a third-rank capital official, became resident minister in Korea.

sentences.zh: 是夏，廣東九龍半島、山東威海衛俱租借於英吉利。

translations.literal: That summer the Kowloon Peninsula in Guangdong and Weihaiwei in Shandong were leased to Britain.
translations.idiomatic: That summer Kowloon and Weihaiwei were leased to Britain.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲寅，詔停新進士朝考，並罷試詩賦。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiayin: new jinshi palace examination was halted and poetry and fu format ended.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn month 7, jiayin: new jinshi palace exam stopped and poetry-fu ended.

sentences.zh: 賑奉天被賊各□縣災。

translations.literal: Fengtian districts ravaged by bandits received disaster relief.
translations.idiomatic: Fengtian bandit-stricken districts received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔於京師設農工商總局，以端方、徐建寅、吳懋鼎督理，並加三品卿銜。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, an Agricultural, Industrial, and Commercial General Bureau was set up in the capital; Duanfang, Xu Jianyin, and Wu Maoding supervised it with third-rank noble titles.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, an agricultural-industrial-commercial bureau was set up under Duanfang, Xu Jianyin, and Wu Maoding.

sentences.zh: 命出使大臣設僑民學堂於英、美、日本各國。

translations.literal: Envoys were ordered to establish schools for overseas Chinese in Britain, America, and Japan.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were ordered to set up schools for overseas Chinese in Britain, America, and Japan.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，河決山東上中游，濟陽等六縣同時並溢。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Yellow River burst in upper and middle Shandong; six counties including Jiyang flooded together.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, the Yellow River burst in Shandong and six counties including Jiyang flooded.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔定於九月十五日奉皇太后幸天津閱兵。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the empress dowager's inspection of troops at Tianjin on the fifteenth of the ninth month was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, the empress dowager's Tianjin troop review on the 15th of month 9 was fixed.

sentences.zh: 移沙市關監督、荊宜施道、江陵縣並駐沙市鎮。

translations.literal: The Shashi customs superintendent, Jing-Yi circuit intendant, and Jiangling magistrate were all moved to garrison Shashi town.
translations.idiomatic: The Shashi customs chief, Jing-Yi intendant, and Jiangling magistrate all moved to Shashi.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，賑南陽水災。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Nanyang flood victims were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Nanyang flood victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔裁詹事府，通政司，大理、光祿、太僕、鴻臚諸寺，歸並其事於內閣、禮、兵、刑部兼理之。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the Household of the Heir Apparent, the Transmission Office, and the courts of review, rites, revenue, works, and protocol were abolished; their duties merged under the Grand Secretariat and Boards of Rites, War, and Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, the heir-apparent household, transmission office, and several courts were cut and merged into the Grand Secretariat and Rites, War, and Punishments.

sentences.zh: 裁湖北、廣東、雲南巡撫，以總督兼管之。

translations.literal: Governors of Hubei, Guangdong, and Yunnan were cut; governor-generals took charge.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei, Guangdong, and Yunnan governors were cut; governor-generals took over.

sentences.zh: 河東河道總督並於河南巡撫。

translations.literal: The eastern Yellow River commissioner was merged into the Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern Yellow River commissioner was merged into the Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 兼裁各省糧道、鹽道。

translations.literal: Grain and salt intendants in each province were also abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial grain and salt intendants were also abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以抑格言路，首違詔旨，奪禮部尚書懷塔布、許應騤，侍郎坤岫、徐會灃、溥頲、曾廣漢等職。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, for suppressing memorials on reform and being first to violate the edict, Minister of Rites Huaitabu, Xu Yingqi, Vice Ministers Kunxiu, Xu Huifeng, Pu'e, Zeng Guanghan, and others were stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Huaitabu, Xu Yingqi, Kunxiu, Xu Huifeng, Pu'e, Zeng Guanghan, and other Rites officials lost their posts for blocking reform memorials.

sentences.zh: 賞上書主事王照四品京堂。

translations.literal: Palace memorial clerk Wang Zhao was rewarded with a fourth-rank metropolitan office.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhao, memorial clerk, was given fourth-rank metropolitan rank.

sentences.zh: 辛未，頒曾國籓州縣清訟事宜及功過章程於各省，並增道府功過。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Zeng Guofan's county regulations on clearing lawsuits and merit-and-demerit rules were issued to all provinces, with circuit and prefect merit-and-demerit added.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Zeng Guofan's county lawsuit and merit rules went to every province, with added circuit and prefect scoring.

sentences.zh: 諭疏導京師河道溝渠，平治道塗。

translations.literal: An edict ordered dredging of Beijing canals and ditches and leveling the roads.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered Beijing waterways dredged and streets leveled.

sentences.zh: 諭各省實行團練。

translations.literal: An edict ordered all provinces to implement militia training.
translations.idiomatic: Provinces were told to carry out tuanlian militia.

sentences.zh: 賞內閣侍讀楊銳、中書林旭、刑部主事劉光第、江蘇知府譚嗣同並加四品卿銜，參預新政。

translations.literal: Hanlin Reader Yang Rui, Attendant Secretary Lin Xu, Punishments clerk Liu Guangdi, and Jiangsu prefect Tan Sitong were all given concurrent fourth-rank minister titles to take part in the New Policies.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Rui, Lin Xu, Liu Guangdi, and Tan Sitong received fourth-rank minister titles to join the New Policies.

sentences.zh: 賑建水水災。

translations.literal: Jianshui flood victims were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Jianshui flood relief was ordered.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，罷李鴻章總理各國事務衙門行走。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Li Hongzhang was removed from service at the Zongli Yamen.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Li Hongzhang left the Zongli Yamen.

sentences.zh: 以裕祿為禮部尚書，在總理各國事務衙門行走。

translations.literal: Yulu was made Minister of Rites, serving at the Zongli Yamen.
translations.idiomatic: Yulu became Minister of Rites at the Zongli Yamen.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，置三、四、五品卿，三、四、五、六品學士。

translations.literal: On day yihai, third-, fourth-, and fifth-rank ministers and third- through sixth-rank academicians were established.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, new minister and academician ranks were created.

sentences.zh: 丙子，賑泰和水災。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Taihe flood victims were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Taihe received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，召袁世凱來京。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Yuan Shikai was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Yuan Shikai was called to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「國家振興庶政，兼采西法，誠以為民立政，中西所同，而西法可補我所未及。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The state is reviving many policies and also adopting Western methods, truly because governing for the people is the same in China and the West, and Western methods can supply what we lack.
translations.idiomatic: By edict: "The state revives government and adopts Western ways because both East and West govern for the people, and the West can fill our gaps.

sentences.zh: 今士大夫昧於域外之觀，輒謂彼中全無條教。

translations.literal: Today scholars-officials are blind to conditions abroad and readily say that there are no regulations at all in those countries.
translations.idiomatic: Officials ignorant of foreign affairs claim the West has no real institutions.

sentences.zh: 不知西政萬端，大率主於為民開智慧，裕身家。

translations.literal: They do not know that Western government has ten thousand branches, most of which aim to open the people's wisdom and enrich their households.
translations.idiomatic: Western government is vast, but mostly it enlightens minds and enriches families.

sentences.zh: 其精者乃能淑性延壽。

translations.literal: At its finest it can refine character and prolong life.
translations.idiomatic: At best it refines character and extends life.

sentences.zh: 生人利益，推擴無遺。

translations.literal: Benefit to living men is extended without omission.
translations.idiomatic: Human welfare is pursued to the full.

sentences.zh: 朕夙夜孜孜，改圖百度，豈為崇尚新奇。

translations.literal: I work diligently day and night, reforming a hundred measures—this is not to esteem novelty for its own sake.
translations.idiomatic: I labor day and night on reform, not from love of novelty.

sentences.zh: 乃眷懷赤子，皆上天所畀，祖宗所遺，非悉使之康樂和親，未為盡職。

translations.literal: It is because I cherish the people, all bestowed by Heaven and bequeathed by the ancestors; unless I make them all secure, happy, and united, I have not fulfilled my duty.
translations.idiomatic: I cherish the people Heaven and the ancestors gave me; unless they live in peace and unity, I fail my charge.

sentences.zh: 加以各國環相陵逼，非取人之所長，不能全我之所有。

translations.literal: Moreover, every country presses and encroaches upon us; unless we take others' strengths, we cannot preserve all that is ours.
translations.idiomatic: Nations press on us from every side; we must learn their strengths to keep what is ours.

sentences.zh: 朕用心至苦，而黎庶猶有未知。

translations.literal: My purpose is extremely painful, yet the common people still do not know it.
translations.idiomatic: My purpose is arduous, yet the people still do not understand.

sentences.zh: 職由不肖官吏與守舊士夫不能廣宣朕意。

translations.literal: The fault lies with unworthy officials and conservative scholars who cannot broadly proclaim my intent.
translations.idiomatic: Unworthy officials and conservative gentry have failed to explain my intent.

sentences.zh: 乃至胥動浮言，小民搖惑驚恐，山谷扶杖之民，有不獲聞新政者，朕實為歎恨。

translations.literal: So that even clerks stir up loose talk, small folk are shaken with fear, and among mountain villagers leaning on staffs there are those who have not heard of the New Policies—I truly sigh with regret.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks spread rumors, commoners panic, and remote villagers never hear of reform—I grieve at this.

sentences.zh: 今將變法之意，佈告天下，使百姓鹹喻朕心，共知其君之可恃。

translations.literal: Now I will publish the meaning of the reforms throughout the empire, so that the people all understand my heart and together know that their ruler can be relied upon.
translations.idiomatic: I now proclaim reform throughout the realm so all may trust their ruler.

sentences.zh: 上下同心，以成新政，以強中國，朕不勝厚望焉。

translations.literal: Above and below in one mind, to complete the New Policies and strengthen China—this is my earnest hope.
translations.idiomatic: With one heart above and below, we shall finish the New Policies and strengthen China.

sentences.zh: 」諭各省撤驛站，設郵政。

translations.literal: " Provinces were ordered to abolish courier stations and establish postal service.
translations.idiomatic: " Provinces were told to end courier posts and set up mail.

sentences.zh: 嚴米糧出口禁。

translations.literal: Strict prohibition on exporting grain was enforced.
translations.idiomatic: Grain export was strictly banned.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午朔，命戶部編定歲出入表頒行之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, renwu new moon: the Board of Revenue was ordered to compile tables of annual income and expenditure and issue them.
translations.idiomatic: Month 8, renwu new moon: Revenue was to publish annual budget tables.

sentences.zh: 諭出使大臣徵送僑民歸國備任使。

translations.literal: An edict ordered envoys abroad to summon overseas Chinese home for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were told to bring overseas Chinese home for service.

sentences.zh: 命袁世凱以侍郎候補，專任練兵事宜。

translations.literal: Yuan Shikai was ordered to await appointment as vice minister, exclusively in charge of troop training.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shikai awaited vice-minister rank to train troops exclusively.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，見日本侯爵伊籐博文、署使林權助於勤政殿。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Japanese marquis Ito Hirobumi and Acting Envoy Hayashi Gonsuke were received at the Hall of Diligent Government.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Ito Hirobumi and Hayashi Gonsuke were received at the Hall of Diligent Government.

sentences.zh: 賑射洪等縣水災，略陽等縣水災雹災。

translations.literal: Shehong and other counties received flood relief; Lueyang and other counties received flood and hail relief.
translations.idiomatic: Shehong and other counties, and Lueyang and other counties, received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，皇太后復垂簾於便殿訓政。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Empress Dowager again held court from behind the curtain at the side hall to instruct in government.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the Empress Dowager resumed regency from behind the curtain.

sentences.zh: 詔以康有為結黨營私，莠言亂政，褫其職，與其弟廣仁皆逮下獄。

translations.literal: An edict said Kang Youwei had formed factions for private gain and used wicked words to disorder government; his office was stripped and he and his brother Guangren were both arrested and imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Youwei was stripped for faction and sedition; he and Guangren were jailed.

sentences.zh: 有為走免。

translations.literal: Youwei escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Youwei fled.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔捕康有為與梁啟超。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, an edict ordered the arrest of Kang Youwei and Liang Qichao.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Kang Youwei and Liang Qichao were ordered seized.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，戶部侍郎張廕桓、翰林院侍讀學士徐致靖、御史楊深秀暨楊銳、林旭、劉光第、譚嗣同並坐康有為黨逮下獄。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Vice Minister of Revenue Zhang Yin-huan, Hanlin Reader Xu Zhijing, Censor Yang Shenxiu, and Yang Rui, Lin Xu, Liu Guangdi, and Tan Sitong were all arrested as Kang Youwei's faction and imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Zhang Yin-huan, Xu Zhijing, Yang Shenxiu, Yang Rui, Lin Xu, Liu Guangdi, and Tan Sitong were jailed as Kang's party.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上稱疾，徵醫天下。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the Emperor claimed illness and physicians were summoned from throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the Emperor feigned illness and doctors were sought empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 召榮祿來京。

translations.literal: Ronglu was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Ronglu was called to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 命逮文廷式，捕孫文。

translations.literal: An order was issued to arrest Wen Tingshi and seize Sun Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Tingshi was to be seized and Sun Wen captured.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔復設詹事府，通政司，大理、光祿、太僕、鴻臚諸寺。

translations.literal: On day renchen, an edict restored the Household of the Heir Apparent, the Office of Transmission, and the Courts of the Censorate, Ceremonial, Imperial Stud, and Imperial Banquets.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, the Heir Apparent's Household, Transmission Office, and several courts were restored.

sentences.zh: 禁官民擅遞封章。

translations.literal: Officials and commoners were forbidden to submit memorials on their own.
translations.idiomatic: Private submission of memorials was banned.

sentences.zh: 罷時務官報。

translations.literal: The Current Affairs Gazette was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Current Affairs Gazette was shut down.

sentences.zh: 各省祠廟毋改學堂。

translations.literal: Provincial temples were not to be converted into schools.
translations.idiomatic: Provinces were forbidden to turn temples into schools.

sentences.zh: 命吏部侍郎徐用儀在總理各國事務衙門行走。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Personnel Xu Yongyi was ordered to serve at the Zongli Yamen.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Yongyi was posted to the Zongli Yamen.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，撥江漕八萬石改折，備徐、海賑。

translations.literal: On day guisi, eighty thousand shi of Jiangsu tribute grain was diverted to commutation for Xu and Hai relief.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, eighty thousand shi of Jiangsu grain was commuted for Xu and Hai relief.

sentences.zh: 賑高州水災。

translations.literal: Gaozhou flood victims were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozhou received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 甲午，楊深秀、楊銳、林旭、劉光第、譚嗣同、康廣仁俱處斬。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Yang Shenxiu, Yang Rui, Lin Xu, Liu Guangdi, Tan Sitong, and Kang Guangren were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, the Six Gentlemen and Kang Guangren were executed.

sentences.zh: 謫張廕桓新疆。

translations.literal: Zhang Yin-huan was banished to Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yin-huan was sent to Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 徐致靖禁錮。

translations.literal: Xu Zhijing was placed under house arrest.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Zhijing was confined.

sentences.zh: 命榮祿為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: Ronglu was made Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Ronglu joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 以裕祿為直隸總督兼北洋大臣。

translations.literal: Yulu was made Governor-General of Zhili and concurrently Beiyang Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Yulu became Zhili governor-general and Beiyang minister.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以康有為大逆不道，構煽陰謀，頒硃諭宣示臣下。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, because Kang Youwei was utterly disloyal and had fomented secret plots, an imperial rescript in vermilion ink was issued to declare this to the officials.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Kang Youwei was denounced in a vermilion rescript for treason and conspiracy.

sentences.zh: 罷巡幸天津閱操。

translations.literal: The tour to Tianjin to review troops was canceled.
translations.idiomatic: The Tianjin troop review tour was called off.

sentences.zh: 命榮祿管兵部事，兼節制北洋諸軍及宋慶軍。

translations.literal: Ronglu was ordered to manage Board of War affairs and also command Beiyang forces and Song Qing's army.
translations.idiomatic: Ronglu took War Board affairs and command of Beiyang and Song Qing's troops.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，籍康有為、梁啟超家。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the property of Kang Youwei and Liang Qichao was confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Kang Youwei's and Liang Qichao's estates were seized.

sentences.zh: 命趙舒翹會同王文韶督辦礦路總局。

translations.literal: Zhao Shuqiao was ordered to join Wang Wenshao in supervising the General Bureau of Mines and Railways.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shuqiao and Wang Wenshao were to run the mines and railways bureau.

sentences.zh: 諭蘇、浙新漕運京，罷改折議。

translations.literal: An edict ordered new Jiangsu and Zhejiang tribute grain transported to the capital; the plan for commutation was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: New Jiangsu and Zhejiang grain was to reach the capital; commutation was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 留山東新漕米石備賑。

translations.literal: Shandong's new tribute grain was retained for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong new grain was kept for relief.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，賞袁昶三品京堂，在總理各國事務衙門行走。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Yuan Chang was rewarded with third-rank metropolitan office, serving at the Zongli Yamen.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Yuan Chang received third-rank rank at the Zongli Yamen.

sentences.zh: 庚子，李端棻以濫保褫職，戍新疆。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Li Duanfen was stripped for reckless recommendation and banished to Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Li Duanfen lost office for reckless nomination and went to Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 褫王照職，籍其家，逮捕。

translations.literal: Wang Zhao was stripped of office, his property confiscated, and he was arrested.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhao was dismissed, his home seized, and he was arrested.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，賞前御史文悌知府。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, former Censor Wen Ti was rewarded with a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, ex-Censor Wen Ti received a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，黃遵憲以疾免，賞李盛鐸四品京堂充出使日本大臣。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Huang Zunxian was excused for illness; Li Shengduo was rewarded with fourth-rank metropolitan office as envoy to Japan.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Huang Zunxian retired ill; Li Shengduo became envoy to Japan.

sentences.zh: 陳寶箴以濫保奪湖南巡撫任。

translations.literal: Chen Baozhen was stripped of the Hunan governorship for reckless recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Baozhen lost Hunan for reckless nomination.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔疆臣飭吏治，培人才，開財源，修武備，舉劾牧令，整齊營規。

translations.literal: On day guimao, an edict ordered frontier governors to discipline officials, cultivate talent, open revenue sources, repair armaments, impeach and reward magistrates, and put camp regulations in order.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, governors were told to reform officials, talent, revenue, arms, magistrates, and camps.

sentences.zh: 詔言責諸臣指陳國計得失，其淆亂是非事攻訐者罪之。

translations.literal: An edict told all officials to point out gains and losses in national policy; those who confused right and wrong and attacked others were to be punished.
translations.idiomatic: Officials might criticize policy, but partisan attacks were criminal.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，懿旨復鄉、會試及歲、科考舊制，罷經濟特科，罷農工商局。

translations.literal: On day yisi, an imperial directive restored the old system of provincial and metropolitan examinations and annual and triennial tests, abolished the special economic examination, and abolished the Agriculture, Industry, and Commerce bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, civil exams and the economic special exam were restored; agriculture and commerce bureaus ended.

sentences.zh: 丙午，端方進所編勸善歌，詔頒行。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Duan Fang presented songs he had compiled to encourage virtue; an edict ordered their distribution.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Duan Fang's moral songs were ordered published.

sentences.zh: 懿旨命疆臣保衛民生，慎選循良，整飭保甲團練。

translations.literal: An imperial directive ordered frontier governors to protect the people's livelihood, choose upright officials carefully, and put baojia and militia in order.
translations.idiomatic: Governors were to guard livelihoods, pick good magistrates, and organize baojia and militia.

sentences.zh: 凡水利蠶桑，及製造販運，資民間利賴者，以時教導之。

translations.literal: Whatever in waterworks, sericulture, manufacture, transport, and sale benefited the people was to be taught in season.
translations.idiomatic: Irrigation, sericulture, manufacture, and trade useful to the people were to be taught in season.

sentences.zh: 申聯名結會之禁。

translations.literal: The ban on forming societies under joint names was reiterated.
translations.idiomatic: Joint-name societies were again forbidden.

sentences.zh: 授榮祿為欽差大臣。

translations.literal: Ronglu was appointed Imperial Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Ronglu became Imperial Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命裕祿會辦蘆漢等處鐵路。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Yulu was ordered to jointly supervise the Lu-Han and other railways.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Yulu was to oversee the Lu-Han railway and others.

sentences.zh: 設上海、漢口水利局。

translations.literal: Shanghai and Hankou waterworks bureaus were established.
translations.idiomatic: Shanghai and Hankou water bureaus were set up.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥朔，懿旨，一切政治關國計民生者，無論新舊，仍次第推行。

translations.literal: Ninth month, xinhai new moon: an imperial directive said that all government touching national welfare, whether new or old, was still to be carried forward step by step.
translations.idiomatic: Month 9, xinhai new moon: state policies old and new were still to advance in order.

sentences.zh: 建言諸臣章奏務裨時局，毋妄意揣摩。

translations.literal: Memorialists were to make their memorials truly benefit the times and not guess at motives.
translations.idiomatic: Memorials had to aid the times, not flatter by guesswork.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，發內帑二十萬賑山東水災。

translations.literal: On day guichou, two hundred thousand taels from the privy purse were issued for Shandong flood relief.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, two hundred thousand taels from the privy purse went to Shandong floods.

sentences.zh: 甘肅、新疆地震。

translations.literal: Gansu and Xinjiang were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Earthquakes struck Gansu and Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，廣西匪平。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Guangxi bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Guangxi bandits were subdued.

sentences.zh: 己未，命軍機大臣會大學士及部院議治河之策。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Grand Councilors were ordered to meet with Grand Secretaries and ministry heads to discuss Yellow River policy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, the council and ministries debated Yellow River policy.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，初，強劫盜案，不分首從。

translations.literal: At first, in cases of armed robbery, no distinction was made between principal and accomplice.
translations.idiomatic: Armed robbery had once been punished without distinguishing roles.

sentences.zh: 至是，命樞臣暨法司詳議區別。

translations.literal: Now the Grand Council and the law offices were ordered to deliberate distinctions in detail.
translations.idiomatic: Now councilors and the law offices were to define distinctions.

sentences.zh: 代州地震。

translations.literal: Daizhou was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Daizhou had an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，免陝西咸寧等處逋課。

translations.literal: On day renxu, overdue taxes were remitted in Xianning and other districts of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Shaanxi Xianning and other districts had overdue taxes forgiven.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，復武鄉、會試及童試舊制，惟營用武進士及投標武舉令習槍砲。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the old military examination system for provincial, metropolitan, and child tests was restored; only military jinshi for camp use and military juren selected by lot were ordered to practice firearms.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, military exams were restored; camp military jinshi and selected juren had to train with guns.

sentences.zh: 復置湖北、廣東、雲南巡撫，河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Governors of Hubei, Guangdong, and Yunnan and the Director-General of the Hedong waterways were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei, Guangdong, and Yunnan governors and the Hedong waterways director were restored.

sentences.zh: 免裁糧道等缺。

translations.literal: Abolition of grain intendant and other posts was canceled.
translations.idiomatic: Planned cuts to grain intendant posts were dropped.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命許景澄在總理各國事務衙門行走。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Xu Jingcheng was ordered to serve at the Zongli Yamen.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Xu Jingcheng joined the Zongli Yamen.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，復刑名解勘舊制，除軍務省分及情事重大者，仍就地正法，餘不準行。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, the old system of capital review of criminal cases was restored; except in military provinces and grave cases, which might still be executed on the spot, the rest were not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, capital case review was restored; local execution was limited to military provinces and grave cases.

sentences.zh: 丙子，命胡燏棻在總理各國事務衙門行走。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Hu Yixin was ordered to serve at the Zongli Yamen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Hu Yixin joined the Zongli Yamen.

sentences.zh: 己卯，權停福州船廠製造。

translations.literal: On day jimao, manufacture at the Fuzhou Navy Yard was temporarily suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Fuzhou Navy Yard production was halted.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命李鴻章往勘山東黃河。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Li Hongzhang was ordered to go inspect the Shandong Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Li Hongzhang was sent to inspect Shandong's Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑直、陝、川、鄂、蘇、滇、晉、新等各省災。

translations.literal: That month, Zhili, Shaanxi, Sichuan, Hubei, Jiangsu, Yunnan, Shanxi, Xinjiang, and other provinces received disaster relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month, many provinces received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳朔，享太廟，禮親王世鐸攝行，是後郊廟祀典皆遣代，至辛丑冬自西安還京，始親詣。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, xinsi new moon: the Imperial Ancestral Temple was served; Prince Shide acted in proxy; thereafter suburban and temple rites were all delegated until winter of xinchou, when the court returned from Xi'an to the capital and the Emperor went in person.
translations.idiomatic: Month 10, xinsi new moon: Prince Shide offered at the Ancestral Temple; the Emperor did not attend suburban rites until returning from Xi'an in xinchou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命道員張翼督辦直隸暨熱河礦務，立公司。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Circuit Intendant Zhang Yi was ordered to supervise mining in Zhili and Rehe and establish a company.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Zhang Yi was to run Zhili and Rehe mines under a company.

sentences.zh: 賑順天各屬災。

translations.literal: Shuntian dependencies received disaster relief.
translations.idiomatic: Shuntian received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 丙申，賑韓城等縣災。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Hancheng and other counties received disaster relief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Hancheng and other counties were relieved.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命戶部撥帑八萬備安徽賑。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Board of Revenue was ordered to allocate eighty thousand taels for Anhui relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Revenue allocated eighty thousand taels for Anhui.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，追奪翁同龢職。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Weng Tonghe's office was posthumously stripped.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Weng Tonghe was posthumously disgraced.

sentences.zh: 前湖南巡撫吳大澂坐事褫職。

translations.literal: The former governor of Hunan, Wu Dacheng, was stripped of office for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: Former Hunan governor Wu Dacheng was dismissed for misconduct.

sentences.zh: 濟陽決口合龍。

translations.literal: The Jiyang River breach was closed.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiyang breach was sealed.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，懸賞購捕康有為、梁啟超、王照。

translations.literal: On day renyin, rewards were posted for the capture of Kang Youwei, Liang Qichao, and Wang Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, bounties were offered for Kang Youwei, Liang Qichao, and Wang Zhao.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，允榮祿請，以宋慶、聶士成、袁世凱、董福祥所部分立四軍，別募萬人為中軍。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Ronglu's request was approved: the forces under Song Qing, Nie Shicheng, Yuan Shikai, and Dong Fuxiang were each organized as a separate army, and ten thousand men were additionally recruited as a central army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Ronglu's plan was approved: Song Qing, Nie Shicheng, Yuan Shikai, and Dong Fuxiang each got an army, plus ten thousand central troops.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，見俄使格爾思於勤政殿。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the Russian envoy Giers was received at the Hall of Diligent Government.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Russian envoy Giers was received at the Hall of Diligent Government.

sentences.zh: 命胡燏棻督辦津鎮鐵路，以張翼副之。

translations.literal: Hu Yufen was ordered to supervise the Tianjin-Zhen railway; Zhang Yi was appointed his assistant.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Yufen was put in charge of the Tianjin-Zhen railway with Zhang Yi as deputy.

sentences.zh: 丁未，賑羅平水災雹災。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, relief was given for flood and hail disasters at Luoping.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Luoping flood and hail victims received relief.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，諭張汝梅辦山東災賑。

translations.literal: Month 11, guichou: Zhang Rumei was ordered to handle Shandong disaster relief.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, guichou, Zhang Rumei was told to run Shandong disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 賞桂春三品京堂，命在總理各國事務衙門行走。

translations.literal: Gui Chun was granted third-rank capital official status and assigned to serve at the Yamen for General Management of Foreign Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Chun was made a third-rank capital official at the foreign affairs yamen.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，命啟秀為軍機大臣，趙舒翹、聯元並在總理各國事務衙門行走。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Qi Xiu was appointed Grand Councilor; Zhao Shuqiao and Lian Yuan were also assigned to serve at the foreign affairs yamen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Qi Xiu joined the Grand Council; Zhao Shuqiao and Lian Yuan also served at the foreign affairs yamen.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，留河南漕折於滑縣備賑。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Henan transport-grain deductions were retained at Huaxian for relief reserves.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Henan transport deductions were kept at Huaxian for relief.

sentences.zh: 撥庫帑二十萬於江蘇備賑。

translations.literal: Two hundred thousand taels from the treasury were allocated to Jiangsu for relief reserves.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred thousand treasury taels went to Jiangsu for relief.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命溥良察山東賑。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Pubu was ordered to inspect Shandong relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Pubu was sent to inspect Shandong relief.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命裕庚在總理各國事務衙門行走。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Yugeng was assigned to serve at the foreign affairs yamen.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Yugeng was assigned to the foreign affairs yamen.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命疆臣均兼總理各國事務大臣銜。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, frontier officials were all additionally given the title of minister of foreign affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, all frontier governors also received foreign-affairs minister titles.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賑吐魯番等處水災蝗災。

translations.literal: On day renshen, relief was given for flood and locust disasters in Turfan and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Turfan and other districts received flood and locust relief.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以稱疾停年節升殿筵宴。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the New Year ascent-of-the-hall banquet was suspended on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, the New Year hall banquet was canceled because of illness.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，罷直隸練軍。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Zhili training army was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Zhili training army was disbanded.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，湖北巡撫曾鉌坐事免。

translations.literal: Month 12, bingxu: Hubei governor Zeng Yi was dismissed for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, bingxu, Hubei governor Zeng Yi was removed for misconduct.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命馬玉昆往河南辦理防剿。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Ma Yukun was ordered to go to Henan to supervise defense and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Ma Yukun was sent to Henan for defense and suppression.

sentences.zh: 罷胡燏棻津蘆路督辦，以許景澄代之。

translations.literal: Hu Yufen was removed as supervisor of the Tianjin-Lu railway and replaced by Xu Jingcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Yufen lost the Tianjin-Lu railway post to Xu Jingcheng.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，免漢陽等州縣被災額賦。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, levies were remitted for disaster-hit districts including Hanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Hanyang and other disaster districts were forgiven levies.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，改湖北漢口同知為夏口撫民同知。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the Hankou subprefect of Hubei was changed to the Xiakou pacification subprefect.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Hubei's Hankou subprefect became the Xiakou pacification subprefect.

sentences.zh: 戊申，發內帑五萬於清、淮備賑。

translations.literal: On day wushen, fifty thousand taels from the imperial treasury were sent to Qing and Huai for relief reserves.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, fifty thousand imperial taels went to Qing and Huai for relief.

sentences.zh: 二十五年己亥春正月庚戌，撫恤豫、皖被賊州縣災民。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, jihai, spring, first month, day gengxu: victims in Henan and Anhui districts ravaged by bandits were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Year 25, spring 1, gengxu: Henan and Anhui bandit-hit districts received relief.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔清庶獄。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, an edict ordered clearing neglected prisons.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the court ordered neglected prisons cleared.

sentences.zh: 庚申，免渦陽等州縣被賊稅糧。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, tax grain was remitted for districts including Woyang that had been ravaged by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Woyang and other bandit-hit districts were forgiven tax grain.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，止各國駐京公使覲賀。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, foreign envoys stationed in the capital were stopped from offering New Year congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, resident foreign envoys were barred from New Year congratulations.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，再撥部帑五萬於安徽備賑。

translations.literal: On day renxu, another fifty thousand taels from the ministry treasury were allocated to Anhui for relief reserves.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, another fifty thousand ministry taels went to Anhui for relief.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，召李秉衡來京。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Li Bingheng was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Li Bingheng was summoned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申，申諭各省辦積穀、清訟、團練、保甲。

translations.literal: Month 2, jiashen: an imperial order again told the provinces to carry out granary storage, clearing lawsuits, militia training, and baojia organization.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, jiashen, provinces were again ordered to store grain, clear suits, drill militia, and run baojia.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命武勝新隊名曰虎神營。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Wusheng new detachment was named the Tiger Spirit Camp.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the Wusheng new unit was renamed the Tiger Spirit Camp.

sentences.zh: 舉行京師保甲。

translations.literal: Baojia organization was carried out in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Beijing carried out baojia organization.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，膠州灣德兵藉詞護教，入沂州境。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, German troops at Jiaozhou Bay entered Yizhou territory on the pretext of protecting missions.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Jiaozhou Germans entered Yizhou claiming to protect missions.

sentences.zh: 命呂海寰告德國外部，止其進兵。

translations.literal: Lü Haihuan was ordered to inform the German foreign office to halt the advance.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Haihuan was told to ask Berlin to stop the advance.

sentences.zh: 以新建陸軍訓練有效，予袁世凱優敘。

translations.literal: Because the newly formed army's training proved effective, Yuan Shikai received special favorable mention.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shikai was specially commended because his new army drilled well.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命副都統壽山募練十六營，為鎮邊新軍。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Vice Commander-in-chief Shoushan was ordered to recruit and drill sixteen battalions as the new frontier-guard army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Shoushan was told to raise sixteen battalions as the new frontier army.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，德兵至蘭山。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, German troops reached Lanshan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, German troops reached Lanshan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，陷日照城。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Rizhao city fell.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Rizhao fell.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，諭有漕各□州縣，自今冬始，改徵本色運京師。

translations.literal: Month 3, yimao: provinces and counties under the grain-transport system were ordered that from this winter they should collect grain in kind for transport to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, yimao, grain-transport districts were told to collect grain in kind for Beijing from this winter.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，召蘇元春來京。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Su Yuanchun was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Su Yuanchun was summoned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸未，諭曰：「近因時事艱難，朝廷孜孜求治，疊諭疆臣整頓一切。

translations.literal: Summer, month 4, guiwei: an edict said: "Recently, because times are hard, the court has sought good government with tireless care and repeatedly ordered frontier officials to put everything in order.
translations.idiomatic: Summer month 4, guiwei: an edict said hard times made the court urge frontier officials to reform everything.

sentences.zh: 旋據覆陳練兵、籌餉、保甲、團練、積穀各事，雖匪空言，尚虛確效。

translations.literal: Soon reports came back on drilling troops, raising funds, baojia, militia, and granary storage; though not empty words, real results are still lacking.
translations.idiomatic: Reports on troops, funds, baojia, militia, and granaries were not empty talk but still lacked results.

sentences.zh: 用再諭令所籌諸務，速即興辦。

translations.literal: Therefore frontier officials are again ordered to speedily undertake the tasks they have planned.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier officials were again told to start planned work at once.

sentences.zh: 仍將有無成效，據實以聞。

translations.literal: They must still report truthfully whether there are results or not.
translations.idiomatic: They still had to report real results honestly.

sentences.zh: 」申諭疆臣切實校閱營伍。

translations.literal: " An additional order told frontier officials to inspect troops in earnest.
translations.idiomatic: The edict also told frontier officials to inspect troops seriously.

sentences.zh: 又諭察勘荒田，勸導民墾，勿任吏胥訛擾，亦毋遽擬升科。

translations.literal: Another order told them to survey wasteland, encourage cultivation, not let clerks harass the people, and not hastily propose tax assessment.
translations.idiomatic: Another order told them to survey wasteland and encourage farming without clerk harassment or hasty taxation.

sentences.zh: 義人以兵艦來，圖登三門灣，諭嚴戒備。

translations.literal: Italians came with warships intending to land at Sanmen Bay; strict guard was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Italian warships came to land at Sanmen Bay and strict defense was ordered.

sentences.zh: 己丑，命剛毅往江南諸省覈庫藏出納實數。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Gang Yi was ordered to go to the Jiangnan provinces to verify treasury receipts and disbursements.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Gang Yi was sent to audit Jiangnan treasury accounts.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命聶士成軍馬步四營駐熱河，實邊防。

translations.literal: On day guisi, four infantry and cavalry battalions of Nie Shicheng's army were stationed at Rehe to strengthen the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, four Nie Shicheng battalions garrisoned Rehe for frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 丙申，諭劉坤一等集重兵為備，義兵登陸，即迎擊之。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Liu Kunyi and others were ordered to mass heavy forces in readiness and to attack immediately if Italian troops landed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Liu Kunyi and others were told to mass troops and strike any Italian landing.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命按察使李光久督辦浙江防剿，長順往吉林稽察練兵。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Surveillance Commissioner Li Guangjiu was ordered to supervise Zhejiang defense and suppression, and Changshun was sent to Jilin to inspect troop drilling.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Li Guangjiu supervised Zhejiang defense and Changshun inspected Jilin drilling.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔：「關稅、釐、鹽諸課，歲有常經，疆吏瞻徇，不能力除積弊。

translations.literal: On day yisi, an edict said: "Customs, likin, and salt levies have fixed annual quotas, yet frontier officials indulge favoritism and cannot vigorously remove long-standing abuses.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, an edict said customs, likin, and salt had fixed quotas but frontier officials would not end abuses.

sentences.zh: 大學士、軍機大臣其詳覈會議以聞。

translations.literal: Grand secretaries and Grand Council members are to examine this in detail and report."
translations.idiomatic: Grand secretaries and the Grand Council were to review the matter fully and report.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子，命吳廷棻在總理各國事務衙門行走。

translations.literal: Month 5, renzi: Wu Tingfen was assigned to serve at the foreign affairs yamen.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, renzi, Wu Tingfen joined the foreign affairs yamen.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，神機營兵廠藥庫火。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Shenji Camp arsenal powder magazine caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Shenji Camp arsenal magazine burned.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，命太僕少卿裕庚充出使法國大臣。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Vice Minister of the Imperial Stud Yugeng was made envoy to France.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Yugeng of the Imperial Stud became envoy to France.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，命正定鎮總兵楊玉書統練軍駐熱河。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Zhengding garrison commander Yang Yushu was ordered to command drilled troops stationed at Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Yang Yushu of Zhengding garrison drilled troops at Rehe.

sentences.zh: 除安化、武岡、新寧被水田賦。

translations.literal: Land tax was remitted for flooded fields in Anhua, Wugang, and Xinning.
translations.idiomatic: Anhua, Wugang, and Xinning flooded fields were forgiven land tax.

sentences.zh: 己巳，岳州開商埠，移岳常澧道駐之，兼岳州關監督。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Yuezhou was opened as a treaty port; the Yue-Chang-Li circuit intendant was moved there and also made supervisor of Yuezhou customs.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Yuezhou opened as a treaty port and its intendant moved there as customs supervisor.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，免迪化等屬逋賦。

translations.literal: Month 6, wuzi: overdue taxes were remitted in districts subject to Urumqi and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, wuzi, Urumqi districts and others were forgiven tax arrears.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，諭整飭海軍，除積弊。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the navy was ordered to be rectified and accumulated abuses removed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the navy was ordered reformed and abuses cleared.

sentences.zh: 庚子，賑廬陵等縣水災。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, flood relief was given at Luling and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Luling and other counties received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚戌，以法人租借廣州灣，命蘇元春往會勘。

translations.literal: Autumn, month 7, day gengxu: because France leased Guangzhou Bay, Su Yuanchun was sent to join in the survey.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn month 7, gengxu: Su Yuanchun joined the Guangzhou Bay survey after France leased it.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，訂朝鮮通商條約。

translations.literal: On day yimao, a commercial treaty with Korea was concluded.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, a Korea trade treaty was signed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，開秦皇島商埠。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Qinhuangdao was opened as a treaty port.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Qinhuangdao opened as a treaty port.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命剛毅往廣東清釐財政。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Gang Yi was ordered to go to Guangdong to clear accounts and finances.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Gang Yi was sent to Guangdong to audit finances.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命蘇元春赴淮、徐練兵，聽榮祿節制。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Su Yuanchun was ordered to drill troops at Huai and Xu under Ronglu's command.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Su Yuanchun drilled troops at Huai and Xu under Ronglu.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥，甘肅海城回亂，官軍剿平之。

translations.literal: Month 8, dinghai: Hui rebellion at Haicheng, Gansu, was pacified by government troops.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, dinghai, Gansu Haicheng Hui rebels were suppressed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔各省宣講聖諭廣訓。

translations.literal: On day jihai, provinces were ordered to expound the Sacred Edict for Extensive Instruction.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, provinces were told to expound the Sacred Edict.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，錦州、廣寧匪亂，剿平之。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, bandit disorders at Jinzhou and Guangning were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Jinzhou and Guangning bandits were suppressed.

sentences.zh: 九月丁未，以旱詔求直言。

translations.literal: Month 9, dingwei: because of drought, an edict sought frank counsel.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, dingwei, drought led the court to seek frank counsel.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔清訟獄，緩徵輸。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, an edict ordered clearing lawsuits and deferring tax collection.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the court ordered suits cleared and taxes deferred.

sentences.zh: 諭疆吏整躬率屬，持公道，順輿情。

translations.literal: Frontier officials were told to discipline themselves and their subordinates, uphold fairness, and follow public sentiment.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier officials were told to discipline subordinates, be fair, and heed public feeling.

sentences.zh: 己未，副都統壽長以廢弛營務，褫職謫戍，榮和褫職逮問。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Vice Commander-in-chief Shouchang was stripped and banished for slackness in military duties; Ronghe was stripped and arrested for inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Shouchang was dismissed and banished for slack troops; Ronghe was arrested.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，命李徵庸充督辦四川商礦大臣。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Li Zhengyong was made commissioner for supervising Sichuan commercial mining.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Li Zhengyong supervised Sichuan commercial mining.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，義人兵艦續至，諭直、魯、江、浙嚴防。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Italian warships continued to arrive; Zhili, Shandong, Jiangsu, and Zhejiang were ordered to guard strictly.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, more Italian warships came and Zhili, Shandong, Jiangsu, and Zhejiang were told to guard closely.

sentences.zh: 是秋，賑浙江、湖南、甘肅水災，陝西旱災。

translations.literal: That autumn, flood relief was given in Zhejiang, Hunan, and Gansu; drought relief in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, Zhejiang, Hunan, and Gansu got flood relief and Shaanxi drought relief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚寅，命李秉衡巡閱長江水師。

translations.literal: Winter, month 10, gengyin: Li Bingheng was ordered to inspect the Yangtze naval forces.
translations.idiomatic: Winter month 10, gengyin: Li Bingheng inspected the Yangtze navy.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命李鴻章為通商大臣，考察商埠。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Li Hongzhang was made trade minister and ordered to inspect treaty ports.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Li Hongzhang became trade minister and inspected treaty ports.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，免陝西咸寧等處前歲逋賦。

translations.literal: On day renyin, overdue taxes from the previous year were remitted in Xianning, Shaanxi, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Shaanxi Xianning and others were forgiven last year's arrears.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，命太僕寺卿徐壽朋充出使韓國大臣。

translations.literal: Month 11, guichou: Vice Minister of the Imperial Stud Xu Shoupeng was made envoy to Korea.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, guichou, Xu Shoupeng of the Imperial Stud became envoy to Korea.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，廖壽恆罷軍機大臣，命趙舒翹在軍機大臣上學習行走。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Liao Shouheng was removed as Grand Councilor; Zhao Shuqiao was ordered to study on duty under the Grand Councilors.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Liao Shouheng left the Grand Council and Zhao Shuqiao studied there on duty.

sentences.zh: 免北流被賊上年逋賦。

translations.literal: Overdue taxes from the previous year were remitted for Beiliu, which had been ravaged by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Beiliu was forgiven last year's arrears after bandit raids.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，再暴康有為、梁啟超罪狀，懸賞嚴捕。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the crimes of Kang Youwei and Liang Qichao were again publicized with heavy rewards for capture.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Kang Youwei and Liang Qichao were again outlawed with large bounties.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，孫家鼐以疾免。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Sun Jianai was excused on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Sun Jianai resigned for illness.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以戶部尚書王文韶協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Minister of Revenue Wang Wenshao was made assistant Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Wang Wenshao of Revenue became assistant grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌朔，詔停年節升殿筵宴。

translations.literal: Month 12, jiaxu new moon: an edict suspended the New Year ascent-of-the-hall banquet.
translations.idiomatic: Month 12, jiaxu new moon: the New Year hall banquet was canceled.

sentences.zh: 丙子，舉行察典，敕毋冒濫。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, the merit review was held; an edict forbade improper promotions.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the merit review was held with a ban on improper promotions.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，免榆林等處被災田糧。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, grain taxes were remitted for disaster-hit land in Yulin and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Yulin and other disaster districts were forgiven grain tax.

sentences.zh: 己丑，罷蘇元春江南練兵，回廣西提督任。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Su Yuanchun was removed from Jiangnan troop drilling and returned to his post as Guangxi provincial military commander.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Su Yuanchun left Jiangnan drilling and resumed as Guangxi commander.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命陳澤霖募勇駐江北操練，為武衛先鋒右軍。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Chen Zelin was ordered to recruit braves stationed north of the Yangtze for training as the Vanguard Right Army of the Martial Guards.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Chen Zelin raised braves north of the Yangtze as the Martial Guards Vanguard Right Army.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔以端郡王載漪之子溥俊為穆宗嗣，封皇子。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, an edict made Pujun, son of Prince Duan Zaiyi, heir to the Muzong line and enfeoffed as imperial son.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Zaiyi's son Pujun became Muzong's heir and an imperial son.

sentences.zh: 命崇綺直弘德殿，授皇子溥俊讀。

translations.literal: Chongqi was ordered to attend Hongde Hall and tutor Imperial Son Pujun.
translations.idiomatic: Chongqi was told to tutor Prince Pujun at Hongde Hall.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔來年三旬壽辰，停朝賀筵宴，止文武大吏來京祝嘏。

translations.literal: On day renyin, an edict said that for the three decadal birthdays next year, court congratulations and banquets would be suspended; only civil and military high officials might come to the capital to offer felicitations.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, next year's three decadal birthdays would have no court banquet; only top officials could come to congratulate.

sentences.zh: 特舉恩科，明年庚子鄉試，次年辛丑會試。

translations.literal: A special examination cycle was proclaimed: provincial examinations in the gengzi year next year and metropolitan examinations in xinchou the year after.
translations.idiomatic: A special exam cycle was announced: gengzi provincial exams next year and xinchou metropolitan exams after.

sentences.zh: 其正科鄉、會試，遞推於辛丑、壬寅年舉行。

translations.literal: The regular provincial and metropolitan examinations would be deferred to xinchou and renyin.
translations.idiomatic: Regular provincial and metropolitan exams were postponed to xinchou and renyin.

sentences.zh: 是冬，賑山西、雲南、陝西、甘肅、山東等屬災。

translations.literal: That winter, disaster relief was given in Shanxi, Yunnan, Shaanxi, Gansu, Shandong, and other districts.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, Shanxi, Yunnan, Shaanxi, Gansu, Shandong, and others received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 是歲，廣州灣租借於法郎西，並開滇越鐵路。

translations.literal: That year, Guangzhou Bay was leased to France and the Yunnan-Vietnam railway was opened.
translations.idiomatic: That year France leased Guangzhou Bay and the Yunnan-Vietnam railway opened.

sentences.zh: 二十六年庚子春正月甲辰朔，詔以三旬慶辰，加宗支近臣恩賚。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, gengzi, spring, first month, first day jiachen new moon: an edict ordered added favors for collateral princes and close ministers on the thirty-day birthday celebration.
translations.idiomatic: In year 26, gengzi spring, month 1 day jiachen new moon, the court added favors for princes and close ministers for the thirty-day birthday.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命醇親王載灃直內廷，命侍講寶豐直弘德殿。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Prince Chun Zai Feng was ordered on duty in the inner court, and Hanlin expositor Bao Feng on duty at the Hall of Manifest Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Zai Feng of Prince Chun was posted to the inner court and expositor Bao Feng to Hongde Hall.

sentences.zh: 停本年秋決。

translations.literal: Autumn executions this year were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: This year's autumn executions were halted.

sentences.zh: 壬子，先是，知府經元善聯名上書諫立嗣。

translations.literal: On day renzi, earlier the prefect Jing Yuanshan had joined others in a memorial advising against establishing an heir.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, earlier prefect Jing Yuanshan had memorialized against naming an heir.

sentences.zh: 至是，詔嚴捕治罪，尋籍其家。

translations.literal: Now an edict ordered his strict arrest and punishment, and soon his family property was confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Now he was ordered seized and punished, and his estate was soon confiscated.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔大索康有為、梁啟超，毀所著書，閱其報章者並罪之。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, an edict ordered a great search for Kang Youwei and Liang Qichao, destruction of their writings, and punishment for anyone who read their newspapers.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Kang Youwei and Liang Qichao were hunted, their books destroyed, and readers of their papers punished.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，三嚴夷平，增設巴塘等處土官各職。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Sanyan tribes were pacified and additional native-official posts were set up at Batang and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, the Sanyan tribes submitted and more native officials were appointed at Batang and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，總署與法人議廣州灣租約，訂期九十九年。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Yamen negotiated a lease of Guangzhou Bay with France for ninety-nine years.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the Yamen agreed a ninety-nine-year lease of Guangzhou Bay with France.

sentences.zh: 甲子，留南漕三萬石賑河北災民。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, thirty thousand shi of southern grain tribute were retained to relieve flood victims in Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, thirty thousand shi of southern tribute grain were kept for Hebei flood relief.

sentences.zh: 是月，拳匪起山東，號「義和拳會」，假仇教為名，劫殺相尋，蔓延滋害。

translations.literal: That month Boxer bands rose in Shandong, calling themselves the "Righteous Harmony Fist Society," using hatred of Christianity as a pretext; robbery and killing followed one upon another and harm spread.
translations.idiomatic: That month Boxers rose in Shandong as the "Righteous Harmony Fist Society," using anti-Christianity as a cover for robbery and killing that spread.

sentences.zh: 二月丙子，河決濱州。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingzi: the Yellow River burst at Binzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Month 2, bingzi: the Yellow River broke at Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，免昆明等州縣被災額賦。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, assessed taxes were remitted for Kunming and other flood-stricken districts.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, taxes were remitted for Kunming and other flooded districts.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，定墨國條約。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the treaty with Mexico was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the Mexican treaty was settled.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申，命李盛鐸使日本，賀其太子聯姻；

translations.literal: Third month, day wushen: Li Shengduo was appointed envoy to Japan to congratulate the crown prince on his marriage;
translations.idiomatic: Month 3, wushen: Li Shengduo was sent to Japan to congratulate the crown prince's marriage;

sentences.zh: 呂海寰使德，賀其太子加冠。

translations.literal: Lü Haihuan was appointed envoy to Germany to congratulate the crown prince on coming of age.
translations.idiomatic: and Lü Haihuan to Germany for the crown prince's coming of age.

sentences.zh: 壬子，濱州決口合龍。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the Binzhou breach was closed.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, the Binzhou breach was sealed.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以旱詔中外慮囚。

translations.literal: On day guichou, because of drought an edict ordered consideration of prisoners at home and abroad.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, drought led to orders to review prisoners at home and abroad.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，賞高賡恩四品京堂，直弘德殿。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Gao Geng'en was rewarded with fourth-rank Beijing office and posted to the Hall of Manifest Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Gao Geng'en was given fourth-rank Beijing office and posted to Hongde Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命內閣學士桂春充出使俄國大臣，尋命兼使奧國。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Grand Secretary Guichun was appointed envoy to Russia and soon also envoy to Austria.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Guichun was made envoy to Russia and soon also to Austria.

sentences.zh: 撥部帑十萬賑山東、貴州各屬水災。

translations.literal: One hundred thousand taels from the ministry treasury were allocated to relieve floods in Shandong and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred thousand taels were sent to relieve floods in Shandong and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 己未，靖遠夷就撫，置諸夷土官。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Jingyuan tribes submitted and native-official posts were set for the various tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, the Jingyuan tribes submitted and native officials were appointed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，命袁世凱集新兵二十營，增立一軍，名為武衛右軍先鋒隊。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Yuan Shikai was ordered to gather twenty new battalions, add a new army, named the Vanguard of the Right Division of the Martial Guards.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Yuan Shikai was told to raise twenty new battalions as the Vanguard of the Right Martial Guard Army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉，善聯罷，以許應騤兼管船政大臣。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yiyou: Shanlian was dismissed and Xu Yingkui was put in charge of the shipping administration as well.
translations.idiomatic: Summer month 4, yiyou: Shanlian left office and Xu Yingkui also took charge of shipping.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，義和拳入京師，詔步軍統領等會議防禁以聞。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Boxer Fist entered the capital; an edict ordered the metropolitan infantry commander and others to confer on defense and report.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Boxers entered Beijing and the infantry commander and others were told to plan defense.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，免宣威、嵩明被水秋賦。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, autumn grain tax was remitted for Xuanwei and Songming, which had suffered flood.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, autumn tax was remitted for flood-hit Xuanwei and Songming.

sentences.zh: 丙申，賑重慶等處水旱災。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, flood and drought relief was given for Chongqing and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Chongqing and elsewhere received flood and drought relief.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，總署言拳會造言煽惑，人心浮動，易肇釁端。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the Yamen said the Fist Society spread rumors and stirred people so minds were unsettled and trouble was easy to start.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the Yamen warned that the Boxers spread rumors, unsettled the people, and invited trouble.

sentences.zh: 諭所司妥議。

translations.literal: They were instructed to deliberate properly.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were told to deliberate properly.

sentences.zh: 授李鴻章兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang was appointed governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang became governor-general of the two Guangs.

sentences.zh: 庚子，免新化等州縣被水額賦。
