translations.literal: On day gengzi, assessed taxes were remitted for Xinhua and other flood-stricken districts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, taxes were remitted for flooded Xinhua and other districts.

sentences.zh: 是月，拳匪焚毀保定鐵路，副將楊福同往鎮攝，行及淶水，被戕。

translations.literal: That month Boxer bands burned the Baoding railway; Vice Commander Yang Futong went to suppress them and was killed at Lishui on the way.
translations.idiomatic: That month Boxers burned the Baoding railway; Vice Commander Yang Futong was killed at Lishui while going to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，拳匪毀琉璃河、長辛店車站局廠。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guimao: Boxer bands destroyed the Liulihe and Changxindian stations and works.
translations.idiomatic: Month 5, guimao: Boxers destroyed Liulihe and Changxindian stations and works.

sentences.zh: 命聶士成護蘆保、津蘆兩路，防禦之。

translations.literal: Nie Shicheng was ordered to guard the Lubaoding and Tianjin-Lubaoding routes and defend them.
translations.idiomatic: Nie Shicheng was ordered to guard and defend the Lubaoding and Tianjin-Lubaoding lines.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，命載漪管總理各國事務衙門，啟秀、溥興、那桐同時兼行走，罷廖壽恆。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Zai Yi was put in charge of the Zongli Yamen; Qixiu, Pu Xing, and Natong were also made acting members, and Liao Shouheng was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Zai Yi headed the Zongli Yamen; Qixiu, Pu Xing, and Natong joined as acting members and Liao Shouheng left.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，拳匪殺日本使館書記杉山彬於永定門外。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Boxer bands killed the Japanese legation secretary Sugiyama outside Yongding Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Boxers killed Japanese legation secretary Sugiyama outside Yongding Gate.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，諭令馬玉昆赴京西剿拳匪。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Ma Yugui was ordered to the western capital suburbs to suppress Boxer bands.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Ma Yugui was sent west of the capital to suppress Boxers.

sentences.zh: 大沽戒嚴。

translations.literal: Dagu was placed under martial law.
translations.idiomatic: Dagu went on alert.

sentences.zh: 己未，拳匪擾五城，坊市流血。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Boxer bands disturbed the five wards; markets ran with blood.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Boxers disturbed the five wards and blood flowed in the markets.

sentences.zh: 詔步軍統領神機營、虎神營、武衛中軍會巡，大臣巡察街陌，分駐九門監啟閉。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the metropolitan infantry commander, the Divine Engine Corps, the Tiger God Corps, and the central Martial Guard to patrol jointly; grand ministers to inspect streets; and detachments at the nine gates to supervise opening and closing.
translations.idiomatic: The infantry commander, Divine Engine, Tiger God, and central Martial Guard were ordered to patrol; ministers to inspect streets; and detachments to guard the nine gates.

sentences.zh: 召李鴻章、袁世凱入衛。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang and Yuan Shikai were summoned to guard the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang and Yuan Shikai were called to guard the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚申，榮祿以武衛中軍護各國使館。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Ronglu used the central Martial Guard to protect the legations of all nations.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Ronglu used the central Martial Guard to protect foreign legations.

sentences.zh: 命李端遇、王懿榮為京師團練大臣。

translations.literal: Li Duanyu and Wang Yirong were appointed metropolitan militia grand ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Li Duanyu and Wang Yirong became capital militia grand ministers.

sentences.zh: 召李秉衡及馬玉昆統兵來京。

translations.literal: Li Bingheng and Ma Yugui were summoned with their armies to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Li Bingheng and Ma Yugui were called to the capital with their troops.

sentences.zh: 是夕，拳匪焚正陽門城樓，閭市灰燼。

translations.literal: That evening Boxer bands burned the Zhengyang Gate tower; lanes and markets were ash.
translations.idiomatic: That night Boxers burned Zhengyang Gate tower and lanes and markets to ash.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔剛毅、董福祥募拳民精壯者成軍，自餘遣散。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, an edict ordered Gang Yi and Dong Fuxiang to enlist sturdy Boxer men as troops and disperse the rest.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Gang Yi and Dong Fuxiang were told to enlist sturdy Boxers as troops and disperse the rest.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔各省以兵入衛。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, an edict ordered each province to send troops to guard the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, provinces were told to send troops to guard the capital.

sentences.zh: 外軍攻大沽口，提督羅榮光不能御，走天津，死之，大沽遂陷。

translations.literal: Foreign troops attacked Dagu; Admiral Luo Rongguang could not hold them, fled to Tianjin, and died; Dagu then fell.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign troops took Dagu; Admiral Luo Rongguang could not hold, fled to Tianjin and died, and Dagu fell.

sentences.zh: 裕祿以捷聞，詔發內帑十萬犒師。

translations.literal: Yu Lu reported victory; an edict issued one hundred thousand taels from the privy purse to reward the army.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Lu reported victory and one hundred thousand taels from the privy purse were issued to reward troops.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，命徐桐、崇綺會同奕劻、載濂等商軍務。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Xu Tong and Chongqi were ordered to confer with Prince Qing, Zai Lian, and others on military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Xu Tong and Chongqi were told to confer with Prince Qing, Zai Lian, and others on military affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，命許景澄、那桐往告各國公使速出京。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Xu Jingcheng and Natong were ordered to tell the ministers of all nations to leave the capital quickly.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Xu Jingcheng and Natong were sent to tell foreign ministers to leave Beijing quickly.

sentences.zh: 自庚申至於是日，皇太后連召王大臣等入見，諮眾論。

translations.literal: From gengshen until this day the empress dowager repeatedly summoned princes and grand ministers to consult public opinion.
translations.idiomatic: From gengshen until then the empress dowager repeatedly summoned princes and ministers for counsel.

sentences.zh: 載漪持戰議甚堅。

translations.literal: Zai Yi held firmly to war.
translations.idiomatic: Zai Yi strongly favored war.

sentences.zh: 載勳、載濂、載瀾、徐桐、崇綺、啟秀、溥良、徐承煜等，更相附和。

translations.literal: Zai Xun, Zai Lian, Zai Lan, Xu Tong, Chongqi, Qixiu, Pu Liang, Xu Chengyu, and others echoed one another.
translations.idiomatic: Zai Xun, Zai Lian, Zai Lan, Xu Tong, Chongqi, Qixiu, Pu Liang, Xu Chengyu, and others echoed him.

sentences.zh: 榮祿依違其間。

translations.literal: Ronglu wavered between them.
translations.idiomatic: Ronglu wavered between the factions.

sentences.zh: 獨許景澄、袁昶言匪宜剿，釁不可開，殺使臣，悖公法，辭殊切直。

translations.literal: Only Xu Jingcheng and Yuan Chong said the bands should be suppressed, trouble must not be opened, and killing envoys violated public law; their words were especially blunt.
translations.idiomatic: Only Xu Jingcheng and Yuan Chong said Boxers must be suppressed, war must not start, and killing envoys broke international law, in blunt terms.

sentences.zh: 故有是命。

translations.literal: Hence this order.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the order to envoys to leave.

sentences.zh: 甲子，拳匪戕德使克林德於崇文門內。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Boxer bands killed the German minister von Ketteler inside Chongwen Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Boxers killed German minister von Ketteler inside Chongwen Gate.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔以中外釁啟，飭戰備。

translations.literal: On day yichou, an edict said trouble had begun at home and abroad and ordered war preparations.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, an edict cited trouble at home and abroad and ordered war preparations.

sentences.zh: 罷崇禮步軍統領。

translations.literal: Chongli was dismissed as metropolitan infantry commander.
translations.idiomatic: Chongli left the metropolitan infantry command.

sentences.zh: 以載勳代之。

translations.literal: Zai Xun replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Zai Xun replaced him.

sentences.zh: 發倉米開糶濟民食。

translations.literal: Granary rice was released for sale to relieve the people's food shortage.
translations.idiomatic: Granary rice was sold cheap to feed the people.

sentences.zh: 庚午，召鹿傳霖來京。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Lu Chuanlin was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Lu Chuanlin was summoned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未朔，諭順天府五城平糶，瘞教民暴骸。

translations.literal: Sixth month, first day xinwei new moon: Shuntian and the five wards were told to sell grain cheap and bury the exposed corpses of murdered Christians.
translations.idiomatic: Month 6, xinwei new moon: Shuntian and the five wards were told to sell grain cheap and bury murdered Christians' corpses.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命倉場侍郎劉恩溥往天津募水會強壯者，編立成軍，與通州、武清、東安團民駐直隸，濟之餉械。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Vice Minister of the Granary Liu Enpu was sent to Tianjin to enlist sturdy water-guild men, organize them as troops with militia at Tongzhou, Wuqing, and Dong'an stationed in Zhili, and supply them with pay and arms.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Liu Enpu went to Tianjin to enlist water-guild men as troops with Tongzhou, Wuqing, and Dong'an militia in Zhili, with pay and arms.

sentences.zh: 發倉於通州開糶。

translations.literal: Granaries at Tongzhou were opened for sale.
translations.idiomatic: Tongzhou granaries opened for cheap sale.

sentences.zh: 長萃等言津通道阻，請暫停漕運，不許。

translations.literal: Chang Cui and others said the Tianjin route was blocked and asked to suspend grain transport temporarily; it was not allowed.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Cui and others asked to suspend grain transport because the Tianjin route was blocked; it was refused.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，諭各省護教士回國，教民悔悟自首者許自新。

translations.literal: On day yihai, provinces were instructed to escort missionaries home; Christian converts who repented and surrendered might be pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, provinces were told to send missionaries home and pardon repentant converts.

sentences.zh: 己卯，南漕運阻，命清江浦置局，採買運京。

translations.literal: On day jimao, southern grain transport was blocked; an office was set at Qingjiangpu to purchase grain for the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, southern transport was blocked and Qingjiangpu was told to buy grain for Beijing.

sentences.zh: 壬午，調李鴻章為直隸總督兼北洋大臣，趣兼程來京。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Li Hongzhang was transferred to governor-general of Zhili and Grand Minister for the Northern Ocean and urged to come by forced marches.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Li Hongzhang became Zhili governor-general and Northern Ocean minister and was urged to hurry to the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔展緩本年恩科鄉試，明年三月八日舉行，會試八月八日舉行，庚子正科鄉試及會試以次遞推。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, an edict postponed this year's grace-cycle provincial examinations to the eighth day of the third month next year and the metropolitan examinations to the eighth day of the eighth month; the regular gengzi cycle provincial and metropolitan examinations were deferred in turn.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, this year's grace provincial exams were postponed to month 3 day 8 next year and metropolitan exams to month 8 day 8, with the regular gengzi cycle deferred in turn.

sentences.zh: 外兵襲天津，聶士成戰於八里台，死之。

translations.literal: Foreign troops attacked Tianjin; Nie Shicheng fought at Balitai and died.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign troops attacked Tianjin; Nie Shicheng fought at Balitai and died.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以呂本元為直隸提督。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Lü Benyuan was made Zhili provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Lü Benyuan became Zhili commander.

sentences.zh: 天津陷，裕祿、宋慶、馬玉昆並退守北倉。

translations.literal: Tianjin fell; Yu Lu, Song Qing, and Ma Yugui all withdrew to Beicang.
translations.idiomatic: Tianjin fell and Yu Lu, Song Qing, and Ma Yugui withdrew to Beicang.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，命顧璜、張仁黼會辦河南團防。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Gu Huang and Zhang Renqi were ordered to manage Henan militia defense jointly.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Gu Huang and Zhang Renqi jointly managed Henan militia defense.

sentences.zh: 下戶部尚書立山於獄。

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue Li Shan was imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: Revenue Minister Li Shan was jailed.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔緝戕害德使兇犯。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, an edict ordered pursuit of the murderers of the German minister.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, murderers of the German minister were ordered seized.

sentences.zh: 額勒和布卒。

translations.literal: E-lehebu died.
translations.idiomatic: E-lehebu died.

sentences.zh: 丙申，上三旬萬壽，東華門不啟，群臣朝賀皆自神武門入。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, on the thirty-day birthday the Donghua Gate was not opened; all court congratulations entered by the Divine Might Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, for the thirty-day birthday Donghua Gate stayed shut and congratulations entered by Shenwu Gate.

sentences.zh: 免疏附、拜城被災額賦。

translations.literal: Assessed taxes were remitted for Shufu and Baicheng, which had suffered disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes were remitted for disaster-hit Shufu and Baicheng.

sentences.zh: 賑福建水災。

translations.literal: Fujian flood victims received relief.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian flood victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚子朔，命李秉衡幫辦武衛軍事，張春發、陳澤霖、萬本華、夏辛酉諸軍並聽節制。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, first day gengzi new moon: Li Bingheng was ordered to assist in Martial Guard affairs; Zhang Chunfa, Chen Zelin, Wan Benhua, and Xia Xinyu and their armies were all placed under his command.
translations.idiomatic: Month 7, gengzi new moon: Li Bingheng assisted Martial Guard affairs; Zhang Chunfa, Chen Zelin, Wan Benhua, and Xia Xinyu's armies obeyed him.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，殺吏部侍郎許景澄、太常寺卿袁昶。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Vice Minister of Personnel Xu Jingcheng and Court of Sacrifices Minister Yuan Chong were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Xu Jingcheng and Yuan Chong were executed.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，調馬玉昆為直隸提督。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Ma Yugui was transferred to Zhili provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Ma Yugui became Zhili commander.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命榮祿以兵護各國公使往天津。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Ronglu was ordered to escort the ministers of all nations to Tianjin with troops.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Ronglu was told to escort foreign ministers to Tianjin with troops.

sentences.zh: 己酉，外兵據北倉。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, foreign troops held Beicang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, foreign troops held Beicang.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，陷楊村，直隸總督裕祿自殺。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Yangcun fell; Zhili governor-general Yu Lu killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Yangcun fell and Zhili governor Yu Lu killed himself.

sentences.zh: 壬子，授李鴻章全權大臣，與各國議停戰。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Li Hongzhang was given full powers as plenipotentiary to negotiate a truce with the various nations.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Li Hongzhang was given full powers to negotiate a truce with the powers.

sentences.zh: 外兵襲蔡村。

translations.literal: Foreign troops attacked Caicun.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign troops attacked Caicun.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，李秉衡戰於蔡村，敗績。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Li Bingheng fought at Caicun and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Li Bingheng fought at Caicun and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 外兵進佔河西塢。

translations.literal: Foreign troops advanced and occupied Hexiwu.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign troops took Hexiwu.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，增祺言蓋平、熊岳先後失守。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Zeng Qi reported that Gaiping and Xiongyue had successively fallen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Zeng Qi reported Gaiping and Xiongyue had fallen in turn.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，殺戶部尚書立山、兵部尚書徐用儀、內閣學士聯元。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Revenue Minister Li Shan, War Minister Xu Yongyi, and Grand Secretary Lian Yuan were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Li Shan, Xu Yongyi, and Lian Yuan were executed.

sentences.zh: 李秉衡戰敗於張家灣，死之。

translations.literal: Li Bingheng was defeated at Zhangjiawan and died.
translations.idiomatic: Li Bingheng was defeated at Zhangjiawan and died.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，外兵陷通州。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, foreign troops took Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, foreign troops took Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 命剛毅幫辦武衛軍事。

translations.literal: Gang Yi was ordered to assist in Martial Guard affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Gang Yi was ordered to assist Martial Guard affairs.

sentences.zh: 己未，德、奧、美、法、英、義、日、俄八國聯兵陷京師。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, allied troops of Germany, Austria, America, France, Britain, Italy, Japan, and Russia took the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, the eight-power allied army took Beijing.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上奉皇太后如太原，行在貫市。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the emperor accompanied the empress dowager to Taiyuan; the traveling palace was at Guanshi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, the emperor followed the empress dowager to Taiyuan; the court was at Guanshi.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，次懷來。

translations.literal: On day renxu, they stopped at Huailai.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, they halted at Huailai.

sentences.zh: 命榮祿、徐桐、崇綺留京辦事。

translations.literal: Ronglu, Xu Tong, and Chongqi were ordered to remain in the capital to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Ronglu, Xu Tong, and Chongqi were left in Beijing to handle affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，廣東布政使岑春渲率兵入衛，遂命扈蹕。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Guangdong provincial administration commissioner Cen Chunxuan led troops to guard the court and was then ordered to accompany the imperial procession.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Cen Chunxuan of Guangdong led troops to guard the court and was ordered to join the flight.

sentences.zh: 甲子，次沙城堡。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the court halted at Shacheng Fort.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, the court halted at Shacheng Fort.

sentences.zh: 懿旨命岑春渲督理前路糧台。

translations.literal: By empress dowager decree, Cen Chunxuan was ordered to supervise the forward grain depots.
translations.idiomatic: By empress dowager decree, Cen Chunxuan took charge of forward grain supply.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，次雞鳴驛，下詔罪己，兼誡中外群臣。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the court halted at Jiming Post; an edict confessed fault and admonished officials at home and abroad.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, at Jiming Post, the emperor confessed fault and admonished all officials.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，次宣化。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the court halted at Xuanhua.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, the court halted at Xuanhua.

sentences.zh: 命萬本華、孫萬林、奇克伸布軍聽馬玉昆節制，駐後路。

translations.literal: Wan Benhua, Sun Wanlin, and Qi Kechenbu were placed under Ma Yukun's command and stationed on the rear route.
translations.idiomatic: Wan Benhua, Sun Wanlin, and Qi Kechenbu were assigned to Ma Yukun on the rear line.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔求直言。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, an edict sought forthright counsel.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the court sought frank advice.

sentences.zh: 免蹕路所過宛平、昌平等處錢糧一年。

translations.literal: Land tax and grain levies were remitted for one year in Wanping, Changping, and other districts along the imperial route.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes and grain were remitted one year along the route at Wanping, Changping, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 八月庚午朔，次左衛。

translations.literal: Eighth month, new moon on day gengwu: the court halted at Zuowei.
translations.idiomatic: At the eighth-month new moon, the court halted at Zuowei.

sentences.zh: 辛未，次懷安。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the court halted at Huai'an.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, the court halted at Huai'an.

sentences.zh: 壬申，次天鎮。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the court halted at Tianzhen.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the court halted at Tianzhen.

sentences.zh: 詔奕劻還京，會李鴻章議和。

translations.literal: Yikuang was recalled to the capital to join Li Hongzhang in peace negotiations.
translations.idiomatic: Yikuang was recalled to Beijing to negotiate peace with Li Hongzhang.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，次陽高。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the court halted at Yanggao.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, the court halted at Yanggao.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，次聚樂鎮。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, the court halted at Jule Town.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, the court halted at Jule Town.

sentences.zh: 太監張天順騷擾驛站，處斬。

translations.literal: The eunuch Zhang Tianshun disturbed post stations and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuch Zhang Tianshun was executed for harassing relay stations.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，次大同。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the court halted at Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, the court halted at Datong.

sentences.zh: 命劉坤一、張之洞會議和局。

translations.literal: Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong were ordered to confer on peace terms.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong were told to confer on peace.

sentences.zh: 以載漪為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: Zaiyi was made a Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Zaiyi joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，賞隨扈王公暨大小臣工津貼銀兩。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, traveling stipends in silver were granted to accompanying princes and officials great and small.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, silver stipends were granted to the imperial escort.

sentences.zh: 己卯，次懷仁。

translations.literal: On day jimao, the court halted at Huairen.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, the court halted at Huairen.

sentences.zh: 命京師部、院、卿寺堂官暨內廷行走者，除留京外，均率司員赴行在。

translations.literal: Ministers, directors, and bureau chiefs at the capital, and inner-court attendants except those left in Beijing, were all ordered to lead their subordinates to the traveling court.
translations.idiomatic: Capital department heads and inner-court staff not left in Beijing were ordered to the traveling court with their staffs.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，次廣武鎮。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, the court halted at Guangwu Town.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, the court halted at Guangwu Town.

sentences.zh: 命程文炳統軍駐潼關。

translations.literal: Cheng Wenbing was ordered to command troops stationed at Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Wenbing was posted with troops at Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 壬午，次陽明堡。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the court halted at Yangming Fort.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, the court halted at Yangming Fort.

sentences.zh: 諭榮祿收集整理武衛中軍。

translations.literal: Ronglu was instructed to gather and reorganize the Wuyi Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: Ronglu was told to reorganize the Wuyi Central Army.

sentences.zh: 癸未，次原平鎮。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the court halted at Yuanping Town.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, the court halted at Yuanping Town.

sentences.zh: 諭廷雍督剿直屬拳匪。

translations.literal: Ting Yong was instructed to supervise suppression of Boxers in metropolitan Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Ting Yong was told to suppress Boxers in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 甲申，次忻州。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the court halted at Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, the court halted at Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，次太原，御巡撫署為行宮。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the court halted at Taiyuan and took the governor's yamen as the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the court halted at Taiyuan in the governor's yamen.

sentences.zh: 免蹕路所過天鎮、陽高等州縣今歲額賦。

translations.literal: Quota levies for the current year were remitted in Tianzhen, Yanggao, and other districts along the route.
translations.idiomatic: This year's quota levies were remitted along the route at Tianzhen, Yanggao, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，西安等府旱。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Xi'an and other prefectures suffered drought.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Xi'an prefectures reported drought.

sentences.zh: 戊子，諭榮祿約束武衛中軍。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Ronglu was instructed to restrain the Wuyi Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Ronglu was told to restrain the Wuyi Central Army.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔有司勸教民安業，拳民被脅者令歸農。

translations.literal: On day guisi, an edict told local officials to encourage farming and teach the people peace; Boxers who had been coerced were ordered back to agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, officials were told to restore farming and coerced Boxers were sent back to the fields.

sentences.zh: 乙未，賑四川各屬災。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, disaster relief was given in Sichuan's subordinate districts.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Sichuan disaster districts received relief.

sentences.zh: 閏八月庚子朔，賑麗水等縣水災。

translations.literal: Intercalary eighth month, new moon on day gengzi: flood relief was given in Lishui and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: At the intercalary eighth-month new moon, Lishui and other counties received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，追悼德使克林德，命昆岡往奠之。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the German minister Clemens von Ketteler was mourned; Kun Gang was sent to offer libations.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Envoy Ketteler was mourned and Kun Gang was sent to offer rites.

sentences.zh: 論庇拳啟釁罪，削莊親王載勳、怡親王溥靜、貝勒載濂、載瀅爵。

translations.literal: For shielding Boxers and provoking conflict, Prince Zhuang Zaiqun, Prince Yi Pu Jing, and Beile Zailian and Zaiying were stripped of rank.
translations.idiomatic: For protecting Boxers, Prince Zhuang, Prince Yi, and Beile Zailian and Zaiying lost their titles.

sentences.zh: 罷載漪、載瀾、剛毅、趙舒翹、英年職，並下府部議。

translations.literal: Zaiyi, Zailan, Gangyi, Zhao Shuqiao, and Ying Nian were dismissed and referred to the Boards for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Zaiyi, Zailan, Gangyi, Zhao Shuqiao, and Ying Nian lost office and were sent to the Boards.

sentences.zh: 命鹿傳霖為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: Lu Chuanlin was made a Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Chuanlin joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以日書記杉山彬被戕，遣那桐使日本致祭賻。

translations.literal: On day renyin, because Japanese secretary Sugiyama Akira had been killed, Natong was sent to Japan to offer condolences and gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Natong was sent to Japan after secretary Sugiyama was killed.

sentences.zh: 毓賢罷。

translations.literal: Yu Xian was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Xian lost office.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔幸西安。

translations.literal: On day yisi, an edict announced the journey to Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the court announced travel to Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 丁未，啟蹕。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the imperial procession set out.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the court resumed the journey.

sentences.zh: 是日，次徐溝。

translations.literal: That day the court halted at Xugou.
translations.idiomatic: That day the court halted at Xugou.

sentences.zh: 戊申，次祈縣。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the court halted at Qi County.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the court halted at Qi County.

sentences.zh: 己酉，次平遙。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the court halted at Pingyao.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, the court halted at Pingyao.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，次介休。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the court halted at Jiexiu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the court halted at Jiexiu.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，次靈石。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the court halted at Lingshi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, the court halted at Lingshi.

sentences.zh: 壬子，次霍州。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the court halted at Huo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, the court halted at Huo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 召榮祿赴行在。

translations.literal: Ronglu was summoned to the traveling court.
translations.idiomatic: Ronglu was summoned to the traveling court.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔改陝西巡撫署為行宮。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, an edict made the Shaanxi governor's yamen the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Shaanxi governor's yamen became the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，次平陽。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the court halted at Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, the court halted at Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，次史村驛。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the court halted at Shicun Post.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the court halted at Shicun Post.

sentences.zh: 諭北五省嚴捕自立會黨。

translations.literal: The five northern provinces were instructed strictly to arrest self-styled league factions.
translations.idiomatic: The five northern provinces were told strictly to arrest secret societies.

sentences.zh: 戊午，次聞喜。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, the court halted at Wenxi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, the court halted at Wenxi.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔以西幸，陵寢壇廟久疏對越，命奕劻遴近支王貝勒代享太廟及祭東西陵，太常寺派員祭壇廟。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, because of the western journey, tomb-shrines and altars had long lacked worship; Yikuang was ordered to choose collateral princes and beile to offer at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and sacrifice at the Eastern and Western Mausoleums, and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices was to dispatch officers for altar temples.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Yikuang chose princes to sacrifice at temples and mausoleums while the Court of Imperial Sacrifices sent officers to altars.

sentences.zh: 尋令今歲除夕、來歲元旦祀典，並遣代行。

translations.literal: Soon New Year's Eve and next New Year's rites were also ordered performed by substitutes.
translations.idiomatic: Substitutes were soon appointed for New Year's Eve and New Year's Day rites.

sentences.zh: 趣近省解京餉給在京官弁俸糧。

translations.literal: Nearby provinces were urgently told to remit funds to the capital for salaries and grain of officials and troops in Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: Nearby provinces were urgently told to send funds for Beijing officials' pay and grain.

sentences.zh: 授奕劻全權大臣，會李鴻章議和約，劉坤一、張之洞仍會商。

translations.literal: Yikuang was given plenipotentiary powers to negotiate the peace treaty with Li Hongzhang; Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong continued to confer.
translations.idiomatic: Yikuang was made plenipotentiary with Li Hongzhang; Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong kept conferring.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，次臨晉。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, the court halted at Linjin.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, the court halted at Linjin.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，次蒲州。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the court halted at Pu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the court halted at Pu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 諭江蘇等省解款百萬濟京城俸饟。

translations.literal: Jiangsu and other provinces were instructed to remit one million taels to supply Beijing pay and rations.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu and other provinces were told to send one million taels for Beijing pay and rations.

sentences.zh: 免蹕路所過太原、陽曲等屬今歲額賦。

translations.literal: Quota levies for the current year were remitted in Taiyuan, Yangqu, and other subordinate districts along the route.
translations.idiomatic: This year's quota levies were remitted at Taiyuan, Yangqu, and along the route.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，次潼關。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the court halted at Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, the court halted at Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 賑福州水災。

translations.literal: Flood relief was given in Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Fuzhou received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，次華陰。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the court halted at Huayin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the court halted at Huayin.

sentences.zh: 命敬信、溥興管理虎神營。

translations.literal: Jingxin and Pu Xing were ordered to manage the Tiger Spirit Camp.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxin and Pu Xing took charge of the Tiger Spirit Camp.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，次華州。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the court halted at Hua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, the court halted at Hua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳朔，次渭南。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on day jisi: the court halted at Weinan.
translations.idiomatic: At the ninth-month new moon, the court halted at Weinan.

sentences.zh: 壬申，至西安府，御巡撫署為行宮。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the court reached Xi'an Prefecture and took the governor's yamen as the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the court reached Xi'an and lodged in the governor's yamen.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以裕鋼為駐藏辦事大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Yu Gang was made resident minister in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Yu Gang became resident minister in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 丙子，予殉難祭酒王懿榮世職，並旌其妻謝氏、子婦張氏。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, hereditary rank was granted to the martyred libationer Wang Yirong, and his wife Lady Xie and daughter-in-law Lady Zhang were honored.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Wang Yirong received a hereditary post and his wife and daughter-in-law were honored.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，李鴻章奏誅附匪逞亂道員譚文煥。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Li Hongzhang memorialized the execution of circuit intendant Tan Wenhuan, who had abetted bandits and stirred disorder.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Li Hongzhang reported executing Tan Wenhuan for abetting rebels.

sentences.zh: 壬午，德人陷紫荊關，布政使升允退軍浮圖億。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Germans took Zijing Pass; Provincial Administration Commissioner Sheng Yun withdrew troops to Fotuyu.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Germans took Zijing Pass and Sheng Yun fell back to Fotuyu.

sentences.zh: 尋奏德兵退易州，上以其張皇，切責之。

translations.literal: Soon he reported German troops had withdrawn to Yizhou; the throne rebuked him sharply for alarmism.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Sheng Yun reported German withdrawal; the throne sharply rebuked his alarmism.

sentences.zh: 己丑，罷保德貢黃河冰魚。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the Baode tribute of Yellow River ice fish was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Baode's tribute of Yellow River ice fish ended.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，削載漪爵，與載勳、溥靜、載瀅並交宗人府圈禁。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Zaiyi was stripped of rank; with Zaiqun, Pu Jing, and Zaiying he was handed to the Imperial Clan Court for house arrest.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Zaiyi lost rank and he, Zaiqun, Pu Jing, and Zaiying were confined by the Clan Court.

sentences.zh: 載瀾、英年金雋級。

translations.literal: Zailan and Ying Nian were demoted one rank in the golden tally system.
translations.idiomatic: Zailan and Ying Nian were demoted one tally rank.

sentences.zh: 趙舒翹奪職留任。

translations.literal: Zhao Shuqiao was stripped of office but kept on duty.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shuqiao lost rank but stayed on duty.

sentences.zh: 剛毅病故，免議。

translations.literal: Gangyi died of illness and was exempted from further deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Gangyi died and was spared further punishment.

sentences.zh: 毓賢戍極邊。

translations.literal: Yu Xian was banished to the extreme frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Xian was exiled to the remote frontier.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，予闔家自焚黑龍江將軍延茂、祭酒熙元、侍讀寶豐、崇壽等恤。

translations.literal: On day renchen, posthumous honors were granted to Heilongjiang General Yan Mao, Libationer Xiyuan, Reader Baofeng, Chongshou, and others who burned themselves with their families.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Yan Mao, Xiyuan, Baofeng, Chongshou, and others who immolated with their families were honored.

sentences.zh: 乙未，賑陝西荒。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Shaanxi famine was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Shaanxi famine relief was ordered.

sentences.zh: 丙申，免陝西咸寧等縣逋賦。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, overdue levies were remitted in Xianning and other Shaanxi counties.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, overdue levies were remitted in Shaanxi counties including Xianning.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，免雲南各□州縣暨土司被災逋賦。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, overdue levies were remitted in Yunnan's prefectures and counties and native chieftaincies stricken by disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, overdue levies were remitted in disaster-stricken Yunnan districts and native offices.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，皇太后聖壽節，停筵宴。

translations.literal: Tenth month, winter, day wushen: on the empress dowager's birthday, banquets were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, wushen, the empress dowager's birthday was marked without banquets.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔董福祥不諳外情，遇事鹵莽，奪提督，仍留任。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, an edict said Dong Fuxiang did not understand foreign affairs and acted rashly; his title of regional commander was stripped but he remained on duty.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Dong Fuxiang lost his regional command but stayed on duty for rash conduct.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，發內帑四十萬賑陝西饑民，趣江、鄂轉漕購糧以濟。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, four hundred thousand taels from the inner treasury were sent to relieve Shaanxi famine victims; Jiangsu, Hubei, and the Grand Canal were urged to purchase grain for transport.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, 400,000 taels from the inner treasury went to Shaanxi famine relief and Jiangsu and Hubei were urged to buy grain.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，授王文韶為體仁閣大學士，崇禮、徐郙並協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Wang Wenshao was made Grand Secretary of the Bodies of Harmony; Chongli and Xu Ye were made associate grand secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Wang Wenshao became a grand secretary and Chongli and Xu Ye associate grand secretaries.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，諭廓爾喀、前後藏及各土司暫勿貢獻。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Gurkha, front and rear Tibet, and all native chieftaincies were told temporarily not to send tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Gurkha, Tibet, and native chiefs were told to suspend tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，開秦、晉實官捐例賑旱災。

translations.literal: On day guihai, a substantive-office sale by contribution was opened in Shaanxi and Shanxi to relieve drought disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Shaanxi and Shanxi opened office-sale relief for drought.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，免長安額賦十之五。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renshen: five-tenths of Chang'an's quota levies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, renshen, half of Chang'an's quota levies was remitted.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，清平苗匪王老九等作亂，官軍剿擒之。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Miao bandits led by Wang Laojiu and others rose at Qingping and were suppressed and captured by government troops.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Wang Laojiu and other Miao rebels at Qingping were captured by government troops.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命楊儒為全權大臣，與俄議交收東三省事。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Yang Ru was made plenipotentiary to negotiate with Russia the handover of the three eastern provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Yang Ru was made plenipotentiary to negotiate Manchuria's return with Russia.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以長沙等府旱災，開賑捐事例。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, because Changsha and other prefectures suffered drought, a relief contribution sale was opened.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, a relief contribution sale opened for drought in Changsha and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 壬午，免蹕路所經山西各州縣額賦十之二。

translations.literal: On day renwu, two-tenths of quota levies were remitted in Shanxi prefectures and counties along the imperial route.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, two-tenths of quota levies was remitted in Shanxi along the route.

sentences.zh: 癸未，命盛宣懷為會辦商務大臣。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Sheng Xuanhuai was made associate commissioner for commerce.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Sheng Xuanhuai became associate commissioner for commerce.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，命徐壽朋赴京隨辦商約。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Xu Shoupeng was ordered to the capital to assist in commercial treaties.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Xu Shoupeng was sent to Beijing for commercial treaties.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，安徽開籌餉捐例。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Anhui opened a war-funds contribution sale.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Anhui opened a war-funds contribution sale.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，增祺坐擅與俄人立交還奉天暫行約，予嚴議，尋褫職。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Zeng Qi was sentenced to severe deliberation for concluding a provisional pact with Russians on returning Fengtian without authorization; soon he was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Zeng Qi was severely punished for an unauthorized Fengtian pact with Russia and soon lost office.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰，詔免明年元旦禮節。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiachen: New Year's rites for the coming year were dispensed with.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, jiachen, next year's New Year ceremonies were cancelled.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔議變法，軍機大臣、大學士、六部、九卿、出使大臣、直省督撫參酌中西政要，條舉以聞。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, an edict ordered discussion of reform; Grand Councilors, Grand Secretaries, the Six Ministries, the Nine Chief Courts, envoys abroad, and provincial governors-general and governors were to weigh Chinese and Western policy essentials and report items in turn.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, reform was ordered debated; top ministers and provincial leaders were to weigh East and West and report.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，諭直省大小官吏保護外僑，違者重譴。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, an edict told officials at all levels in the provinces to protect foreigners; violators would be severely punished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, provinces were told to protect foreigners; violators faced heavy punishment.

sentences.zh: 嚴立會仇教之禁，犯者問死刑。

translations.literal: A strict ban on forming anti-Christian societies was proclaimed; offenders faced capital trial.
translations.idiomatic: Anti-Christian societies were strictly banned; offenders faced death.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命左都御史張百熙充專使英國大臣。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Left Censor-in-Chief Zhang Baixi was appointed envoy plenipotentiary to Britain.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Zhang Baixi was made envoy to Britain.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，留京大臣奏京師盜風甚熾，權用重典，允之。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, Beijing ministers still in the capital reported that theft was rampant and asked to use severe law temporarily; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, capital ministers won permission to use harsh law against rampant theft.

sentences.zh: 庚申，賞張佩綸編修，隨李鴻章辦交涉。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Compiler Zhang Peilun was rewarded and ordered to assist Li Hongzhang in negotiations.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Zhang Peilun was rewarded and sent to help Li Hongzhang negotiate.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔復冤陷諸臣立山、徐用儀、許景澄、聯元、袁昶職。

translations.literal: On renxu day, an edict restored the offices of unjustly condemned ministers Lishan, Xu Yongyi, Xu Jingcheng, Lian Yuan, and Yuan Chang.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, wrongly condemned ministers Lishan, Xu Yongyi, Xu Jingcheng, Lian Yuan, and Yuan Chang were restored.

sentences.zh: 再論縱匪肇亂首禍諸臣罪，奪載瀾爵職，與載漪並謫新疆禁錮。

translations.literal: The crimes were again weighed of ministers who let bandits run wild and thereby began the calamity; Zailuan was stripped of title and office and, with Zaiyi, was banished to Xinjiang under guard.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers who unleashed bandits were punished again; Zailuan lost rank and he and Zaiyi were banished to Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 褫剛毅職。

translations.literal: Gangyi was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Gangyi was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 英年、趙舒翹並褫職論斬。

translations.literal: Yingnian and Zhao Shuqiao were both stripped of office and sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: Yingnian and Zhao Shuqiao were dismissed and sentenced to beheading.

sentences.zh: 追褫徐桐、李秉衡職。

translations.literal: Posthumously stripped were Xu Tong and Li Bingheng.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Tong and Li Bingheng were posthumously dismissed.

sentences.zh: 啟秀、徐承煜褫職聽勘。

translations.literal: Qixiu and Xu Chengyu were stripped of office pending investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Qixiu and Xu Chengyu were dismissed pending trial.

sentences.zh: 董福祥褫職解任。

translations.literal: Dong Fuxiang was stripped of office and relieved of his post.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Fuxiang was dismissed and removed from command.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，下詔自責。

translations.literal: On guihai day, an edict of self-reproach was issued.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the throne issued a self-blame edict.

sentences.zh: 以當時委曲苦衷示天下。

translations.literal: The painful expedients of the time were shown to all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The court explained its painful compromises to the empire.

sentences.zh: 並誡中外諸臣激發忠誠，去私心，破積習，力圖振作。

translations.literal: All officials at home and abroad were also admonished to stir up loyalty, cast off private aims, break accumulated habits, and strive to revive affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were urged to serve loyally, drop private aims, break old habits, and revive the state.

sentences.zh: 二十七年辛丑，行在西安。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, xinchou, the court was at Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: In year 27, xinchou, the court remained at Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 春正月戊辰朔，詔以救濟順直兵災，開實官捐例。

translations.literal: First month, new moon day wuchen: to relieve military disaster in Zhili, the sale of substantive offices by contribution was opened.
translations.idiomatic: Month 1, new moon wuchen, substantive offices were sold by contribution to aid Zhili.

sentences.zh: 罷多倫諾爾歲貢海龍諸皮。

translations.literal: Tribute of sea-dragon and other pelts from Duolunuo'er was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Duolunuo'er tribute pelts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚午，賜載勳自盡。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, Zaiqun was granted suicide.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Zaiqun was allowed to kill himself.

sentences.zh: 辛未，毓賢處斬。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Yuxian was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Yuxian was put to death.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，英年、趙舒翹並賜自盡。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Yingnian and Zhao Shuqiao were both granted suicide.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Yingnian and Zhao Shuqiao were allowed suicide.

sentences.zh: 剛毅、徐桐、李秉衡並論斬，以前沒免。

translations.literal: Gangyi, Xu Tong, and Li Bingheng were all sentenced to decapitation, waived because they had died earlier.
translations.idiomatic: Gangyi, Xu Tong, and Li Bingheng were sentenced to beheading but spared as already dead.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，啟秀、徐承煜處斬。

translations.literal: On yihai day, Qixiu and Xu Chengyu were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Qixiu and Xu Chengyu were put to death.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，免仁和等縣荒廢田糧。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, grain tax on abandoned land in Renhe and other counties was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, tax on abandoned land in Renhe and elsewhere was remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，免新會貢橙。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, the Xinhui tribute of oranges was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Xinhui orange tribute was abolished.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，撥部帑百萬於山西備賑。

translations.literal: Second month, day jihai: one million taels from the ministry treasury were allocated for Shanxi famine relief.
translations.idiomatic: Month 2, jihai, one million taels were sent for Shanxi famine relief.

sentences.zh: 壬子，廣東郎中黎國廉等進方物，升敘有差。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Guangdong section member Li Guokang and others presented local products and received promotions of varying degree.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Li Guokang and others presented Guangdong products and were promoted.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，免蹕路所過暨被災陝西咸寧等處稅糧。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuchen: grain tax along the imperial route and at disaster counties such as Xianning in Shaanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Month 3, wuchen, grain tax along the route and at disaster counties was remitted.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔立督辦政務處，奕劻、李鴻章、榮祿、昆岡、王文韶、鹿傳霖並為督理大臣，劉坤一、張之洞遙為參預。

translations.literal: On jisi day, an edict established the Office for Government Affairs; Yi Kuang, Li Hongzhang, Ronglu, Kungang, Wang Wenshao, and Lu Chuanlin were supervising ministers, with Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong as distant associate planners.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, the Government Affairs Office was set up under Yi Kuang, Li Hongzhang, Ronglu, and others, with Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong advising from afar.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，免雲南臨安等處逋糧。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, overdue grain tax in Lin'an and elsewhere in Yunnan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, overdue Yunnan grain tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，論拳匪仇教保護不力罪，奪已故總督裕祿、駐藏大臣慶善原職，褫浙江巡撫劉樹棠職，布政使榮銓、副都統晉昌褫職戍極邊，道員鄭文欽、知縣白昶、都司周之德並處斬，餘褫謫有差。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, the crimes of inadequate protection in Boxer anti-Christian violence were weighed; deceased Governor-General Yulu and Tibetan Commissioner Qingshan were posthumously stripped of original rank; Zhejiang Governor Liu Shutang was stripped of office; Provincial Administration Commissioner Rongquan and Vice Censor-in-Chief Jin Chang were stripped and banished to the farthest frontier; Circuit Intendant Zheng Wenqin, Magistrate Bai Chang, and Commander Zhou Zhide were all executed; others were stripped or demoted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, officials who failed to stop Boxer violence were punished; Yulu and Qingshan were posthumously demoted, Liu Shutang dismissed, several executed or banished, and others demoted.

sentences.zh: 撥山東漕米五萬石賑直隸災民。

translations.literal: Fifty thousand shi of Shandong tribute grain were allocated to relieve disaster victims in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty thousand shi of Shandong grain were sent to relieve Zhili.

sentences.zh: 壬午，諭免自京來行在各署司員停補扣資。

translations.literal: On renwu day, an edict remitted the suspension of appointments and deduction of seniority for bureau officials who had come from Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Beijing officials at the traveling court regained appointment and seniority credit.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁酉，賞在京王公百官半俸，旗、綠營兵丁一月錢糧。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingyou: princes, nobles, and officials in the capital received half salary; banner Green Standard troops received one month's grain pay.
translations.idiomatic: Month 4, dingyou, capital nobles and officials got half pay and troops one month's grain.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命馬玉昆剿近畿餘匪，瞿鴻禨在軍機大臣上學習行走。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, Ma Yugun was ordered to suppress remaining bandits near the capital; Qu Hongji was placed above Grand Councilors for study and attachment.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Ma Yugun was sent against capital bandits; Qu Hongji joined the Grand Council for training.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命瞿鴻禨兼政務處大臣。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, Qu Hongji was ordered additionally to serve as minister of the Government Affairs Office.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Qu Hongji was also made a Government Affairs minister.

sentences.zh: 己酉，賑直隸旱災。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, drought disaster in Zhili was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Zhili drought victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔開經濟特科，命中外舉堪與試者。

translations.literal: On renzi day, an edict opened a special economic examination; officials at home and abroad were to recommend qualified candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, a special economics exam was opened and officials were told to recommend candidates.

sentences.zh: 免各省例貢，除茶葉藥材及關祭品者，一切食物悉罷之。

translations.literal: Routine tribute from the provinces was remitted, except tea, medicine, and ritual offerings; all food tribute was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial tribute was cut except tea, medicine, and ritual goods; food tribute ended.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命載灃充德國專使大臣。

translations.literal: On guichou day, Zaifeng was appointed envoy plenipotentiary to Germany.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Zaifeng was made envoy to Germany.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔從各國議，停順天、奉天、黑龍江、直隸、山西、河南、陝西、浙江、江西、湖南諸省考試五年。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, an edict followed the allied powers' agreement to suspend examinations for five years in Shuntian, Fengtian, Heilongjiang, Zhili, Shanxi, Henan, Shaanxi, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, and Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, exams were halted five years in ten provinces per allied agreement.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，命張百熙等修京師蹕路。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Zhang Baixi and others were ordered to repair the imperial route to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Zhang Baixi and others were told to repair the return route.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，停吉林今歲貢。

translations.literal: On guihai day, this year's tribute from Jilin was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Jilin tribute for the year was stopped.

sentences.zh: 五月乙丑，命那桐充日本專使大臣。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yichou: Natong was appointed envoy plenipotentiary to Japan.
translations.idiomatic: Month 5, yichou, Natong was made envoy to Japan.

sentences.zh: 展山西本年恩、正兩科鄉試。

translations.literal: Shanxi's regular and special provincial examinations for this year were postponed.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi provincial exams for the year were postponed.

sentences.zh: 癸未，賞道員蔡鈞四品京堂，充出使日本大臣。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, Circuit Intendant Cai Jun was granted fourth-rank Beijing post and appointed envoy to Japan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Cai Jun was promoted and sent as envoy to Japan.

sentences.zh: 甲午，賑墨爾根等處災。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, disaster at Mo'ergen and elsewhere was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Mo'ergen disaster victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，命副都統廕昌充出使德國大臣，尋命為荷蘭兼使。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingshen: Vice Censor-in-Chief Yinchang was appointed envoy to Germany and soon also minister to Holland.
translations.idiomatic: Month 6, bingshen, Yinchang was sent to Germany and soon also to Holland.

sentences.zh: 賞知府許台身道員，充出使韓國大臣。

translations.literal: Prefect Xu Taishun was promoted to circuit intendant and appointed envoy to Korea.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Taishun was promoted and made envoy to Korea.

sentences.zh: 庚子，萬壽節，停朝賀筵宴。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, the longevity festival; court congratulations and banquets were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the longevity festival passed without court banquets.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔置外務部，以總理各國事務衙門改設之，命奕劻總理，王文韶為會辦大臣，瞿鴻禨任尚書並會辦大臣，徐壽朋、聯芳為侍郎。

translations.literal: On guimao day, an edict established the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, refashioned from the Zongli Yamen; Yi Kuang was made minister; Wang Wenshao associate minister; Qu Hongji minister and associate; Xu Shoupeng and Lian Fang vice ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Zongli Yamen became the Foreign Ministry under Yi Kuang, Wang Wenshao, Qu Hongji, and two vice ministers.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，各國聯軍去京師。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, the allied armies left Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, allied troops left Beijing.

sentences.zh: 壬子，發內帑五萬於江西備賑。

translations.literal: On renzi day, fifty thousand taels from the inner treasury were sent for Jiangxi famine relief.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, fifty thousand taels were sent for Jiangxi famine relief.

sentences.zh: 賑棲霞火災。

translations.literal: Fire disaster at Qixia was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Qixia fire victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲子朔，命鄧增節制隨扈諸軍。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, new moon day jiazi: Deng Zeng was ordered to command all escort forces.
translations.idiomatic: Month 7, new moon jiazi, Deng Zeng took command of the escort armies.

sentences.zh: 免陝西、河南、直隸蹕路所過地額賦。

translations.literal: Land tax along the imperial route in Shaanxi, Henan, and Zhili was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Land tax along the route in Shaanxi, Henan, and Zhili was remitted.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔除漕務積弊，河運海運並改徵折色，在京倉采運收儲。

translations.literal: On yichou day, an edict removed accumulated abuses in grain transport; river and sea transport were both changed to cash levies, with grain purchased and stored in capital granaries.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, grain transport abuses were cut; river and sea dues became cash and grain was bought for capital stores.

sentences.zh: 世鐸罷直軍機。

translations.literal: Shiduo left the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Shiduo left the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 己巳，河決章丘、惠民。

translations.literal: On jisi day, the river broke at Zhangqiu and Huimin.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, the Yellow River broke at Zhangqiu and Huimin.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔改科舉自明年始，罷時文試帖，以經義、時務策問試士，停武科。

translations.literal: On jimao day, an edict reformed the examination system from the next year: eight-legged essays and copying were abolished; candidates were tested on classics, current affairs, and policy questions; military examinations were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, exams were reformed next year: eight-legged essays ended, policy questions added, and military exams halted.

sentences.zh: 予羅豐祿三品京堂，充出使俄國大臣。

translations.literal: Luo Fenglu was granted third-rank Beijing post and appointed envoy to Russia.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Fenglu was promoted and made envoy to Russia.

sentences.zh: 戊子，全權大臣奕劻、李鴻章與十一國公使議訂和約十二款成。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, plenipotentiaries Yi Kuang and Li Hongzhang and ministers of eleven states completed a twelve-article treaty.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Yi Kuang and Li Hongzhang finished a twelve-article treaty with eleven powers.

sentences.zh: 己丑，展陝西鄉試於明年舉行。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Shaanxi provincial examinations were postponed to the next year.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Shaanxi provincial exams were moved to next year.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔永罷實官捐例。

translations.literal: On renchen day, an edict permanently abolished the sale of substantive offices by contribution.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, sale of offices by contribution was ended for good.

sentences.zh: 諭各省建武備學堂。

translations.literal: Provinces were ordered to establish military training academies.
translations.idiomatic: Provinces were told to build military academies.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，諭各省裁兵勇，改練常備、續備、警察等軍。

translations.literal: On guisi day, provinces were ordered to cut troops and train standing, reserve, and police forces.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, provinces were told to cut old troops and train standing, reserve, and police forces.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午朔，以迴鑾有日，遣官告祭西嶽、中嶽。

translations.literal: Eighth month, new moon day jiawu: with return to the capital near, officials were sent to sacrifice at the Western and Central Sacred Peaks.
translations.idiomatic: Month 8, new moon jiawu, officials were sent to sacrifice at the Western and Central peaks before return.

sentences.zh: 蹕路所經名山大川、古帝王陵寢、先儒名臣祠墓，並由疆吏遣官致祭。

translations.literal: Famous mountains and rivers, ancient imperial tombs, and shrines to former sages and worthy ministers along the route were also to receive sacrifices by officials sent by border governors.
translations.idiomatic: Mountains, rivers, tombs, and sage shrines along the route were also to receive local sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔直省立學堂。

translations.literal: On yimao day, an edict ordered provinces to establish schools.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, provinces were ordered to open schools.

sentences.zh: 戊申，廢內外各署題本，除賀本外，均改為奏。

translations.literal: On wushen day, memorial reports at inner and outer offices were abolished; except congratulatory memorials, all were changed to memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, routine memorial reports were ended; only congratulations stayed, all else became memorials.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命盛宣懷為辦理商稅大臣。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Sheng Xuanhuai was appointed minister for commercial taxes.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Sheng Xuanhuai was made commercial tax minister.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔以變法圖強示天下，並以劉坤一、張之洞條奏命各疆吏舉要通籌。

translations.literal: On guichou day, an edict showed the empire the policy of reform for national strength; Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong's submitted proposals were ordered to be essential points for each governor to carry out comprehensively.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, reform for strength was proclaimed and Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong's plans were to guide governors.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，車駕發西安。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, the imperial procession left Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, the court left Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 己未，升允奏臨潼知縣夏良材誤供應，請褫職。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Sheng Yun memorialized that Lintong Magistrate Xia Liangcai had failed in provisioning and asked that he be stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Sheng Yun asked dismissal of Lintong magistrate Xia Liangcai for bad provisioning.

sentences.zh: 皇太后命從輕議。

translations.literal: The empress dowager ordered lenient deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager ordered lenient handling.

sentences.zh: 升允自請處分，原之。

translations.literal: Sheng Yun asked punishment for himself; this was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Yun asked to be punished; he was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，李鴻章卒，贈太傅，晉一等候爵。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiyou: Li Hongzhang died; posthumously made Grand Tutor and promoted one rank in the first-class marquisate.
translations.idiomatic: Month 9, jiyou, Li Hongzhang died and was posthumously made Grand Tutor and raised one marquis rank.

sentences.zh: 命王文韶署全權大臣，袁世凱署直隸總督兼北洋大臣。

translations.literal: Wang Wenshao was ordered to act as plenipotentiary; Yuan Shikai as acting Zhili governor-general and Beiyang minister.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wenshao acted as plenipotentiary; Yuan Shikai as acting Zhili governor and Beiyang chief.

sentences.zh: 是秋，發帑十五萬賑陝西、安徽災，留漕款十萬、漕米六萬石備安徽、江蘇賑。

translations.literal: That autumn, 150,000 taels were issued for disasters in Shaanxi and Anhui; 100,000 taels of transport funds and 60,000 shi of tribute grain were retained for Anhui and Jiangsu relief.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, 150,000 taels went to Shaanxi and Anhui; 100,000 taels and 60,000 shi grain were held for Anhui and Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 又賑兩湖、安徽、雲南水災，江蘇潮災。

translations.literal: Floods in Hunan-Hubei, Anhui, and Yunnan and tidal disaster in Jiangsu were also relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Floods in several provinces and Jiangsu tidal damage were also relieved.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, new moon day guisi: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Month 10, new moon guisi, a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 甲午，次開封。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, the procession reached Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, the court reached Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 惠民決口合龍。

translations.literal: The Huimin breach was closed.
translations.idiomatic: The Huimin river breach was sealed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，賞道員張德彝三品卿銜，充出使英國大臣，旋命兼使義比。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, Circuit Intendant Zhang Deyi was granted third-rank counselor rank and appointed envoy to Britain; soon also minister to Belgium.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Zhang Deyi was promoted and sent to Britain, soon also to Belgium.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，皇太后聖壽節，停朝賀。

translations.literal: On renyin day, the empress dowager's birthday; court congratulations were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, the empress dowager's birthday passed without court congratulations.

sentences.zh: 壬子，懿旨撤溥俊皇子名號。

translations.literal: On renzi day, an empress dowager decree revoked Pujun's designation as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Pujun was stripped of heir status.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔展會試於癸卯年。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, an edict postponed the metropolitan examination to the guimao year.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the metropolitan exam was moved to guimao year.

sentences.zh: 其明年順天鄉試及癸卯科會試，權移河南貢院舉行。

translations.literal: The next year's Shuntian provincial examination and the guimao metropolitan examination were temporarily moved to the Henan examination compound.
translations.idiomatic: Next year's Shuntian exam and the guimao metropolitan exam were held at the Henan compound.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，特予故大學士李鴻章建祠京師。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingzi: the late Grand Secretary Li Hongzhang was specially granted a shrine in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Month 11, bingzi, Li Hongzhang was granted a capital memorial shrine.

sentences.zh: 戊子，命貽穀督晉邊墾務。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Yigu was ordered to supervise frontier reclamation in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Yigu was told to oversee Shanxi frontier reclamation.

sentences.zh: 章丘決口合龍。

translations.literal: The Zhangqiu breach was closed.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhangqiu river breach was sealed.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上奉皇太后至自西安。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, the emperor escorted the empress dowager back from Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the emperor brought the empress dowager back from Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔以珍妃上年殉節宮中，追晉貴妃。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, an edict posthumously promoted the late Zhenfei, who had died for the dynasty in the palace the previous year, to Noble Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Zhenfei, who died in the palace last year, was posthumously made Noble Consort.

sentences.zh: 命翰、詹、科道及各署司員，按日預備召見。

translations.literal: Hanlin, Censorate, and office officials were ordered to prepare daily for audience.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin, censor, and office staff were told to stand ready daily for audience.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳朔，命王文韶仍督辦路礦，瞿鴻禨副之，袁世凱督辦關內外鐵路事宜，胡燏棻會辦。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon day guisi: Wang Wenshao was again ordered to supervise railways and mines, with Qu Hongji as deputy; Yuan Shikai to supervise railways inside and outside the pass, with Hu Yifen as associate.
translations.idiomatic: Month 12, new moon guisi, Wang Wenshao led railways and mines with Qu Hongji; Yuan Shikai led railways with Hu Yifen.

sentences.zh: 丙申，申諭中外臣工，重邦交，安民教。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, an edict again told officials at home and abroad to value foreign relations and settle people through teaching.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, officials were again told to honor foreign ties and govern through education.

sentences.zh: 以比匪誤國，附和權貴，褫左副都御史何乃瑩、侍講學士彭清藜、編修王龍文、知府連文沖、曾廉職。

translations.literal: For siding with bandits and misleading the state and currying favor with powerful officials, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief He Naiying, Lecturing Academician Peng Qingli, Compiler Wang Longwen, and Prefects Lian Wenchong and Zeng Lian were stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: He Naiying, Peng Qingli, Wang Longwen, Lian Wenchong, and Zeng Lian were dismissed for backing bandits and powerful patrons.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賑蹕路所過三十里內貧民。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, poor people within thirty li along the imperial route were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, poor along thirty li of the route were relieved.

sentences.zh: 己亥，祀天於圜丘。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Heaven was sacrificed to at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Heaven was sacrificed to at the Circular Mound Altar.

sentences.zh: 自戊戌年八月至於是月，始親詣。

translations.literal: From the eighth month of the wuxu year until this month, [the Emperor] personally performed the rites for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: From wuxu month 8 through this month, the Emperor personally performed the rites for the first time.

sentences.zh: 庚子，祭大社、大稷。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, sacrifices were offered to the Grand Earth and Grand Grain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the Grand Earth and Grand Grain were sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 遣睿親王魁斌等告祭方澤、朝日壇、夕月壇，恭親王溥偉、貝子溥倫詣東西陵告祭。

translations.literal: Prince Rui Kuibin and others were dispatched to perform announcement sacrifices at the Earth altar, the Sun-rise altar, and the Moon-set altar; Prince Gong Puwei and Beizi Pulun went to the Eastern and Western imperial mausoleums for announcement sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Kuibin, Prince Rui, and others announced sacrifices at the Earth, Sun-rise, and Moon-set altars; Puwei, Prince Gong, and Beizi Pulun announced sacrifices at the Eastern and Western tombs.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命袁世凱參預政務處。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Yuan Shikai was ordered to join the Office for Government Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Yuan Shikai was told to join the Office for Government Affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命鎮國將軍載振充英國專使，賀其君加冕，尋晉貝子銜。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Defender of the State Zai Zhen was appointed special envoy to Britain to congratulate the king on his coronation; he was soon promoted to beizi rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Zai Zhen was sent to Britain to congratulate the coronation and soon made a beizi.

sentences.zh: 免蹕路所過河南州縣額賦十之三。

translations.literal: One-third of the regular tax quota was remitted for the Henan prefectures and counties along the imperial procession route.
translations.idiomatic: Henan counties on the procession route had one-third of their tax quota remitted.

sentences.zh: 賑廣西火災。

translations.literal: Relief was ordered for the Guangxi fire disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi fire victims were ordered relieved.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，兩宮見各國公使於乾清宮。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the two Dowager Empresses received the foreign ministers at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, both dowagers received foreign ministers at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 免雲南銅廠積年民欠。

translations.literal: Accumulated civilian arrears at Yunnan copper mines were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Long-standing civilian debts at Yunnan copper works were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以瞿鴻禨為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Qu Hongji was made Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Qu Hongji joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 授孫家鼐體仁閣大學士。

translations.literal: Sun Jianai was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Bodies Benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Jianai was made a Grand Secretary of the Bodies Benevolence Hall.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，兩宮見各國公使暨其夫人等於養性殿。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the two Dowager Empresses received the foreign ministers and their wives at the Hall of Cultivating Nature.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, both dowagers received foreign ministers and their wives at the Hall of Cultivating Nature.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，免山西州縣歷年逋賦倉穀。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, years of unpaid grain tax and stored grain owed by Shanxi prefectures and counties were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Shanxi tax and granary arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚申，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, a combined ancestral sacrifice was held at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, a combined sacrifice was held at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，上始復御保和殿，筵宴蒙古王公暨文武大臣。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, the Emperor resumed holding banquets in the Hall of Preserving Harmony for Mongol princes and civil and military officials.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, the Emperor again banqueted Mongol princes and officials in the Hall of Preserving Harmony.

sentences.zh: 免浙江仁、錢等州縣，杭嚴、嘉湖二衛未墾地畝糧賦。

translations.literal: Land tax on unreclaimed fields was remitted in Renhe, Qiantang, and other Zhejiang counties, and in the Hangyan and Jiahu garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: Unreclaimed-field land tax was waived in Zhejiang counties including Renhe and Qiantang and in the Hangyan and Jiahu garrisons.

sentences.zh: 二十八年壬寅春正月庚午，享太廟。

translations.literal: Twenty-eighth year, renyin, spring, first month, day gengwu: sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In year 28, renyin, spring month 1, gengwu, the Imperial Ancestral Temple was sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 辛未，祈穀於上帝。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, prayers for grain were offered to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, grain prayers were offered to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，四川提督宋慶卒，晉封三等男爵。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Sichuan provincial military commissioner Song Qing died and was posthumously enfeoffed as third-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Song Qing, Sichuan commander, died and was posthumously made a third-class baron.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命張翼總辦路礦事宜，王文韶、瞿鴻禨為督理，呂海寰會盛宣懷議商約。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Zhang Yi was ordered to oversee railway and mining affairs overall; Wang Wenshao and Qu Hongji were made supervisors; Lü Haihuan was ordered to confer with Sheng Xuanhuai on commercial treaties.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Zhang Yi took overall charge of railways and mines; Wang Wenshao and Qu Hongji supervised; Lü Haihuan was to consult Sheng Xuanhuai on trade treaties.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，罷河東河道總督。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Governor-General of the Hedong River Circuit was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Hedong River governor-generalship was abolished.

sentences.zh: 命各省大吏清釐屯地，改屯食襄為丁糧，撤衛官歸營，屯丁、運軍並罷。

translations.literal: Provincial governors were ordered to clarify garrison land holdings, convert military rations to household grain tax, return garrison officials to camps, and abolish garrison households and transport troops.
translations.idiomatic: Provinces were told to sort garrison lands, turn military rations into household tax, return garrison officers to camps, and abolish garrison and transport troops.

sentences.zh: 諭各省立農工學堂。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the provinces to establish agricultural and industrial schools.
translations.idiomatic: The provinces were ordered to set up agricultural and industrial schools.

sentences.zh: 戊子，罷詹事府、通政使司。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Household of the Heir Apparent and the Office of Transmission were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, the Heir Apparent's Household and the Office of Transmission were abolished.

sentences.zh: 二月壬辰朔，命張德彝充日斯巴尼亞專使，賀其君加冕。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon day renchen: Zhang Deyi was appointed special envoy to Spain to congratulate the king on his coronation.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, new moon renchen, Zhang Deyi was sent to Spain to congratulate the coronation.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，諭各省亟立學堂暨武備學堂，開館編纂新律。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the provinces were urgently ordered to establish schools and military academies and to open offices for compiling new laws.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, provinces were pressed to open schools, military academies, and offices to draft new laws.

sentences.zh: 甲午，廣西遊匪戕法兵官，剿辦之。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Guangxi roving bandits killed a French soldier; they were suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Guangxi bandits killed a French soldier and were suppressed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，釋奠於先師。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the sacrifice to the sage teacher was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the Confucian sacrifice was performed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，祭大社、大稷。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, sacrifices were offered to the Grand Earth and Grand Grain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the Grand Earth and Grand Grain were sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，劉坤一乞疾，慰留。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Liu Kunyi requested leave on grounds of illness and was urged to remain in office.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Liu Kunyi asked to retire ill and was told to stay.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉朔，交收東三省條約成。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon day xinyou: the handover treaty for the three eastern provinces was concluded.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, new moon xinyou, the three eastern provinces handover treaty was signed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，見義使嘎釐納於乾清宮。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Italian minister Galignani was received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Italian minister Galignani was received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，祀先農，親耕耤田。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the Former Agriculture was worshipped and the Emperor personally ploughed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, the Former Agriculture rite was held and the Emperor ploughed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上奉皇太后謁東陵，免蹕路所過州縣額賦十之三。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to visit the Eastern mausoleums; one-third of regular taxes was remitted along the procession route.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, the Emperor escorted the empress dowager to the Eastern tombs and remitted one-third of taxes along the route.

sentences.zh: 己巳至庚午，謁諸陵。

translations.literal: From day jisi to day gengwu, the imperial tombs were visited.
translations.idiomatic: From jisi through gengwu, the imperial tombs were visited.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，幸南苑，駐蹕團河行宮。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, the court went to the Southern Park and halted at the Tuanhe Travelling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, the court went to the Southern Park and stayed at Tuanhe Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬午，至自東陵。

translations.literal: On day renwu, [the court] returned from the Eastern mausoleums.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, the court returned from the Eastern tombs.

sentences.zh: 癸未，皇后祀先蠶。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the Empress performed the rite to the Primordial Silkworm.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, the empress performed the Primordial Silkworm rite.

sentences.zh: 是春，免宣威、昆明及齊齊哈爾、墨爾根旗屯災賑。

translations.literal: That spring, disaster relief was remitted for the garrison settlements at Xuanwei, Kunming, Qiqihar, and Mergen.
translations.idiomatic: That spring, disaster relief was granted to Xuanwei, Kunming, Qiqihar, and Mergen garrisons.

sentences.zh: 免榆林等處逋賦，西安等□縣秋糧十之二。

translations.literal: Arrears were remitted at Yulin and elsewhere; two-tenths of autumn grain tax was remitted at Xi'an and other □ counties.
translations.idiomatic: Yulin arrears were forgiven and Xi'an and other □ counties had two-tenths of autumn grain tax waived.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬辰，見俄使雷薩爾於乾清宮。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renchen: Russian minister Lessar was received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: In summer month 4, renchen, Russian minister Lessar was received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 甲午，常雩祀天。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the regular summer prayer-for-rain sacrifice to Heaven was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, the regular summer rain prayer to Heaven was held.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命沈家本、伍廷芳參訂現行法律。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Shen Jiaben and Wu Tingfang were ordered to help revise current laws.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Shen Jiaben and Wu Tingfang were told to help revise current laws.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，李經羲以陳奏失辭，免雲南巡撫，下部議。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Li Jingxi was dismissed as Yunnan governor for improper memorial wording and referred to the ministries for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Li Jingxi lost the Yunnan governorship for bad wording and was referred to the ministries.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命許鎯充出使義國大臣，吳德章充出使奧國大臣，楊兆鋆充出使比國大臣。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Xu Heng was appointed minister to Italy, Wu Dezhang minister to Austria, and Yang Zhaokun minister to Belgium.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Xu Heng went to Italy, Wu Dezhang to Austria, and Yang Zhaokun to Belgium.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，皇后躬桑。
