translations.literal: On day guimao, the Empress performed the mulberry-picking rite.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the empress performed the mulberry-picking rite.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，裁銀、緞匹、顏料三庫，罷管庫大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, the silver, silk bolt, and pigment treasuries were abolished and the supervising treasury grandees dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, the silver, silk, and pigment treasuries were cut and their supervising grandees removed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，免灤平被災地課。

translations.literal: On day yimao, land tax was remitted for disaster-stricken land in Luanping.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Luanping disaster land tax was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，授袁世凱直隸總督兼北洋大臣。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renxu: Yuan Shikai was appointed Governor-General of Zhili and concurrently Commissioner for the Northern Seas.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, renxu, Yuan Shikai became Zhili governor-general and Northern Seas commissioner.

sentences.zh: 免雙城逋賦。

translations.literal: Arrears at Shuangcheng were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Shuangcheng tax arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 甲子，見各國公使等於樂壽堂。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the foreign ministers were received at the Hall of Leshou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, foreign ministers were received at the Hall of Leshou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，廣西匪陷廣南之皈朝，雲南官軍擊走之，復其城。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Guangxi bandits seized Gui Chao in Guangnan; Yunnan government troops drove them off and recovered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Guangxi bandits took Gui Chao in Guangnan; Yunnan troops drove them out and retook the city.

sentences.zh: 丙子，夏至，祭地於方澤。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, the summer solstice; sacrifice to Earth was performed at the Square Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the summer solstice; Earth was sacrificed to at the Square Mound.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，見美使康格等於乾清宮。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, American minister Conger and others were received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, US minister Conger and others were received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 六月己丑朔，免鶴慶、賓川被災雜賦。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon day jichou: miscellaneous taxes were remitted for disaster areas in Heqing and Binchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, new moon jichou, Heqing and Binchuan disaster miscellaneous taxes were waived.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命孫寶琦充出使法國大臣，胡惟德充出使俄國大臣，梁誠充出使美日祕大臣。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Sun Baoqi was appointed minister to France, Hu Weide minister to Russia, and Liang Cheng minister to the United States, Japan, and Peru.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Sun Baoqi went to France, Hu Weide to Russia, and Liang Cheng to the United States, Japan, and Peru.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，見美使康格及博覽會長巴禮德於乾清宮。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, American minister Conger and exposition director Berlek were received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, US minister Conger and exposition director Berlek were received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命張之洞為督辦商務大臣。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Zhang Zhidong was appointed Superintendent of Commercial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Zhang Zhidong was made superintendent of commercial affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，賑四川南充、簡等屬災。

translations.literal: On day guichou, relief was ordered for disasters in Nanchong, Jian, and other districts of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Sichuan districts including Nanchong and Jian were ordered relieved.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，頒行學堂章程。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengwu: school regulations were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn month 7, gengwu, school regulations were issued.

sentences.zh: 八月甲申，移雲南迤西道駐騰越，兼監督關務。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiashen: the Yunnan Tengyue Circuit was moved to Tengyue with concurrent supervision of customs.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, jiashen, the Yunnan Tengyue circuit was stationed at Tengyue and given customs oversight.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，袁世凱請裁陋規加公費，命他省仿行。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Yuan Shikai requested abolition of irregular fees and addition of public expenses; other provinces were ordered to follow.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Yuan Shikai asked to cut irregular fees and add public expenses, and other provinces were told to copy him.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，河決利津、壽張等處。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Yellow River burst its banks at Lijin, Shouzhang, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Yellow River broke at Lijin, Shouzhang, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 己酉，見德使葛爾士等於仁壽殿。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, German minister Gelos and others were received at the Hall of Benevolent Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, German minister Gelos and others were received at the Hall of Benevolent Longevity.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，河復決惠民。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the river burst again at Huimin.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the river broke again at Huimin.

sentences.zh: 九月癸巳，兩江總督劉坤一卒，追封一等男，贈太傅。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guisi: Liangjiang Governor-General Liu Kunyi died; he was posthumously enfeoffed as first-class baron and given the title Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, guisi, Liu Kunyi, Liangjiang governor-general, died and was posthumously made a first-class baron and Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 命張之洞署兩江總督兼南洋大臣。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhidong was ordered to serve as acting Liangjiang Governor-General and Commissioner of the Southern Ocean.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong was told to act as Liangjiang governor-general and Southern Ocean commissioner.

sentences.zh: 免天津被兵新舊額賦。

translations.literal: New and old regular taxes for Tianjin areas affected by military disturbances were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Tianjin war-hit areas had new and old tax quotas remitted.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，見法使賈斯那等於仁壽殿。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, French minister Gasnier and others were received at the Hall of Benevolent Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, French minister Gasnier and others were received at the Hall of Benevolent Longevity.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，見各國公使於仁壽殿。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, the foreign ministers were received at the Hall of Benevolent Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, foreign ministers were received at the Hall of Benevolent Longevity.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命袁世凱充督辦商務大臣，伍廷芳副之，兼議各國商約。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Yuan Shikai was appointed Superintendent of Commercial Affairs with Wu Tingfang as deputy, also to negotiate commercial treaties with various countries.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Yuan Shikai headed commercial affairs with Wu Tingfang as deputy and also negotiated foreign trade treaties.

sentences.zh: 是秋，發庫帑三十萬，續撥義賑十二萬，並於四川備賑。

translations.literal: That autumn, 300,000 taels from the treasury were issued, another 120,000 for disaster relief was allocated, and funds were also set aside for relief in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, 300,000 treasury taels were issued, 120,000 more for relief, and Sichuan relief funds were set aside.

sentences.zh: 又賑山東、廣東、雲南、福建、貴州等屬水災。

translations.literal: Relief was also ordered for flood disasters in Shandong, Guangdong, Yunnan, Fujian, Guizhou, and other regions.
translations.idiomatic: Floods in Shandong, Guangdong, Yunnan, Fujian, Guizhou, and elsewhere were also ordered relieved.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊子，中英商約成。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuzi: the Sino-British commercial treaty was concluded.
translations.idiomatic: In winter month 10, wuzi, the Sino-British commercial treaty was signed.

sentences.zh: 己丑，湖南都司劉長儒坐不保護教士處斬。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Hunan battalion commander Liu Changru was executed for failing to protect missionaries.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Hunan commander Liu Changru was executed for not protecting missionaries.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑山、陝各屬災。

translations.literal: That month, relief was ordered for disasters in Shanxi and Shaanxi jurisdictions.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Shanxi and Shaanxi disaster areas were ordered relieved.

sentences.zh: 雲南劍川、鶴慶州，新疆疏勒等□縣俱地震。

translations.literal: Earthquakes occurred in Jianchuan and Heqing prefectures in Yunnan and in □ counties including Shule in Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan's Jianchuan and Heqing and Xinjiang's Shule and other □ counties were all shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午，詔自明年會試始，凡授編、檢及改庶常與部屬中書用者，胥肄業京師大學堂，俟得文憑，始許散館及奏留。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuwu: an edict decreed that from the next metropolitan examination onward, all appointees as compilers, revisers, converted bachelors, and ministry clerks must study at the Capital University and could only leave the Hanlin Academy or apply to remain after receiving a diploma.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, wuwu, from the next metropolitan exam all new compilers, revisers, converted bachelors, and ministry clerks had to study at the Capital University and could not leave the Hanlin until they held diplomas.

sentences.zh: 分省知縣亦各入課吏館學習。

translations.literal: Provincial magistrates were also each to enter training halls for instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Each provincial magistrate was also to study in a training hall.

sentences.zh: 己未，以有泰為駐藏大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, You Tai was appointed Resident Commissioner in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, You Tai was made resident commissioner in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，發內帑、部帑各五萬於山東備賑。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, 50,000 taels each from the privy purse and ministry treasury were sent to Shandong for disaster relief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, 50,000 taels each from the privy and ministry treasuries went to Shandong for relief.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，調魏光燾為兩江總督兼南洋大臣。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Wei Guangtao was transferred to be Liangjiang Governor-General and Commissioner of the Southern Ocean.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Wei Guangtao was moved to Liangjiang governor-general and Southern Ocean commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，免臨潼被水地課五年。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, land tax on flooded land in Lintong was remitted for five years.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Lintong flooded land tax was waived for five years.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，冬至，祀天於圜丘。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the winter solstice; Heaven was worshipped at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the winter solstice; Heaven was worshipped at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 是月，見法使呂班、美使康格於乾清宮。

translations.literal: That month, French minister Beau and American minister Conger were received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: That month, French minister Beau and US minister Conger were received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯，命袁世凱充督辦電務大臣。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guimao: Yuan Shikai was appointed Superintendent of Telegraph Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, guimao, Yuan Shikai was made superintendent of telegraph affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，旌殉親異域使俄大臣楊儒子錫宸孝行。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the filial conduct of Xi Chen, son of the late envoy to Russia Yang Ru who died in a foreign land for his father, was commended.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Xi Chen, son of envoy Yang Ru who died abroad mourning his father, was rewarded for filial conduct.

sentences.zh: 是月，免江、浙各□州縣衛額賦，宜良被水租糧。

translations.literal: That month, regular taxes were remitted for □ prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Jiangsu and Zhejiang; rent grain was remitted for flooded Yiliang.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Jiangsu and Zhejiang □ prefectures, counties, and garrisons had tax quotas waived and flooded Yiliang had rent grain remitted.

sentences.zh: 二十九年癸卯春正月丁巳朔，停筵宴。

translations.literal: Twenty-ninth year, guimao, spring, first month, on dingsi new moon day: banquets were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In year 29, guimao, spring month 1, new moon dingsi, banquets were suspended.

sentences.zh: 以明歲皇太后七旬聖壽，詔開慶榜，本年為癸卯恩科鄉試，來年為甲辰恩科會試，其正科鄉、會試並於下屆舉行。

translations.literal: Because the Empress Dowager would reach her seventieth birthday the next year, an edict opened a celebratory examination list: this year would be the guimao grace-year provincial examination, next year the jiachen grace-year metropolitan examination; the regular provincial and metropolitan examinations would both be held at the next regular cycle.
translations.idiomatic: For the empress dowager's seventieth birthday next year, a grace examination was opened: guimao provincial and jiachen metropolitan grace exams this cycle, with regular exams deferred to the next cycle.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，見美使康格等於乾清宮。

translations.literal: On day yichou, American minister Conger and others were received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, US minister Conger and others were received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命榮慶同管大學堂事。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Rong Qing was ordered to jointly administer university affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Rong Qing was told to help run the university.

sentences.zh: 己巳，見各國公使等於養性殿。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the foreign ministers were received at the Hall of Cultivating Nature.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, foreign ministers were received at the Hall of Cultivating Nature.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，免鎮西、疏附被災糧賦。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, grain tax was remitted for disaster areas in Zhenxi and Shufu.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Zhenxi and Shufu disaster grain tax was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，惠民決口合龍。

translations.literal: Second month, day renzi: the Huimin breach was closed.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, renzi, the Huimin river breach was closed.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon day bingchen: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, new moon bingchen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚申，見德親王亨利、公使葛爾士等於乾清宮。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, German Prince Henry, minister Gelos, and others were received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, German Prince Henry, minister Gelos, and others were received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 詔以謁陵取道鐵路，禁攤派差徭，扈從並免供給。

translations.literal: An edict decreed that the mausoleum visit would use the railway, banned irregular levies of labor service, and exempted escorts from supplying provisions.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the tomb visit to go by rail, banned irregular corvée levies, and freed escorts from supplying provisions.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，裁官學滿、漢總裁及教習。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, the Manchu and Chinese superintendents and instructors of the Imperial School were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, the Manchu and Chinese heads and teachers of the Imperial School were cut.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，祀先農，親耕耤田。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Former Agriculture was worshipped and the Emperor personally ploughed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the Former Agriculture rite was held and the Emperor ploughed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 上奉皇太后謁西陵。

translations.literal: The Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, paid homage at the Western Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the dowager, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，幸保定府駐蹕，免蹕路所過州縣額賦十之三。

translations.literal: On day yichou, [the Emperor] visited Baoding Prefecture and halted the imperial progress; one-third of the regular tax quota was remitted for prefectures and counties along the procession route.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, he halted at Baoding and remitted one-third of taxes along the route.

sentences.zh: 己巳，榮祿卒，贈太傅，晉一等男。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Ronglu died and was posthumously made Grand Tutor and promoted one rank to baron.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Ronglu died and was posthumously made Grand Tutor and a first-class baron.

sentences.zh: 罷印花稅及一切苛細雜捐，科派侵漁者論如律。

translations.literal: Stamp tax and all harsh miscellaneous levies were abolished; those who assessed and extorted extra levies were prosecuted according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Stamp tax and petty levies were abolished; illegal extortion was punished by law.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命奕劻為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Yikuang was appointed Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Yikuang joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，幸南苑。

translations.literal: On day guihai, [the Emperor] visited the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the Southern Park was visited.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，幸團河駐蹕。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, [the Emperor] visited Tuanhe and halted the imperial progress.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, he halted the progress at Tuanhe.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命奕劻、瞿鴻禨會戶部整理財政。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Yikuang and Qu Hongji were ordered to join the Board of Revenue in reorganizing finances.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Yikuang and Qu Hongji were told to reorganize finances with the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 立銀錢鑄造總廠於京師。

translations.literal: A general mint for silver coinage was established in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: A capital mint for silver coin was established.

sentences.zh: 命載振、袁世凱、伍廷芳參訂商律。

translations.literal: Zai Zhen, Yuan Shikai, and Wu Tingfang were ordered to assist in revising the commercial code.
translations.idiomatic: Zai Zhen, Yuan Shikai, and Wu Tingfang were told to help revise commercial law.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，至自南苑。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, [the Emperor] returned from the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, he returned from the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 是月，免陝西庚子年逋賦。

translations.literal: That month, arrears from the gengzi year in Shaanxi were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Shaanxi gengzi-year tax arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，見各國公使於仁壽殿。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jihai: the foreign ministers were received at the Hall of Benevolent Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: In summer month 4, jihai, foreign ministers were received at the Hall of Benevolent Longevity.

sentences.zh: 己酉，雲南匪陷臨安府城。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Yunnan bandits seized Lin'an Prefecture city.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Yunnan bandits took Lin'an city.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，免蹕路所過州縣旗租。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, banner rents along the imperial procession route were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, banner rents on the procession route were waived.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命崇禮為東閣大學士，敬信協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Chongli was appointed Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion; Jingxin was appointed Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Chongli was made Eastern Pavilion Grand Secretary and Jingxin associate Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 五月癸亥，命鐵良會袁世凱練京旗兵。

translations.literal: Fifth month, guihai day: Tie Liang was ordered to join Yuan Shikai in drilling the Beijing Banner troops.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, guihai, Tie Liang was told to drill Beijing Banner troops with Yuan Shikai.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，戶部火。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Board of Revenue burned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, fire struck the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命楊樞充出使日本大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Yang Shu was appointed minister to Japan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Yang Shu was made minister to Japan.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，雲南裸夷平。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the Yunnan Luo tribes were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Yunnan Luo rebels were pacified.

sentences.zh: 壬午，賜王壽彭等三百一十五人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Wang Shoupeng and 315 others were granted jinshi with first and lower passes, each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, 315 candidates including Wang Shoupeng received jinshi degrees at different levels.

sentences.zh: 閏五月甲申朔，命馮子材會岑春渲辦理廣西軍務。

translations.literal: Intercalary fifth month, new moon day jiashen: Feng Zicai was ordered to join Cen Chunxuan in managing Guangxi military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month 5, new moon jiashen, Feng Zicai was told to manage Guangxi military affairs with Cen Chunxuan.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命張之洞會張百熙、榮慶釐定大學堂章程。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Zhang Zhidong was ordered to join Zhang Boxing and Rongqing in fixing regulations for the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Zhang Zhidong, Zhang Boxing, and Rongqing were told to settle university regulations.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，滇軍復臨安府城，石屏匪首周雲祥伏誅。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Yunnan troops recovered Lin'an Prefecture city; bandit leader Zhou Yunxiang of Shiping was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Yunnan troops retook Lin'an; Shiping bandit Zhou Yunxiang was executed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，自四月不雨，至於是日雨。

translations.literal: On day renchen, from the fourth month without rain until this day it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, rain fell for the first time since the drought began in month 4.

sentences.zh: 丙申，廣西巡撫王之春、提督蘇元春並褫職，以柯逢時為廣西巡撫，劉光才為廣西提督。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Guangxi Governor Wang Zhichun and Military Commissioner Su Yuanchun were both stripped of office; Ke Fengshi was made Guangxi governor and Liu Guangcai Guangxi military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Wang Zhichun and Su Yuanchun were dismissed; Ke Fengshi became governor and Liu Guangcai military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己亥，御試經濟特科人員於保和殿。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the special examination in practical statecraft was held at the Hall of Preserving Harmony.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the economics special exam was held in the Hall of Preserving Harmony.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命馬玉昆巡緝近畿盜賊。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Ma Yukun was ordered to patrol and suppress bandits in the capital vicinity.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Ma Yukun was told to patrol bandits near the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，中英續訂商約成。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, the renewed Sino-British commercial treaty was concluded.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, the Sino-British commercial treaty renewal was signed.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌，予考取特科袁嘉穀等升敘有差。

translations.literal: Sixth month, renxu day: those who passed the special examination, including Yuan Jiagu, were promoted in rank each according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, renxu, special-exam passers including Yuan Jiagu were promoted at different levels.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，逮蘇元春下獄。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Su Yuanchun was arrested and imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Su Yuanchun was jailed.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，世鐸等請加上皇太后徽號。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Shishuo and others requested that an honorific title be added for the Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Shishuo and others asked to add a dowager honorific title.

sentences.zh: 懿旨以廣西兵事方殷，民生困苦，不許。

translations.literal: An edict from the Empress Dowager refused, citing that Guangxi military affairs were still pressing and the people's livelihood was distressed.
translations.idiomatic: The dowager refused: Guangxi fighting was fierce and the people were suffering.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，河決利津。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Yellow River burst its banks at Lijin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, the Yellow River broke at Lijin.

sentences.zh: 是月，見日使內田康哉等、義使嘎釐納等於仁壽殿。

translations.literal: That month, Japanese minister Uchida Kanzo and others and Italian minister Gallina and others were received at the Hall of Benevolent Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Japanese minister Uchida and Italian minister Gallina were received at the Hall of Benevolent Longevity.

sentences.zh: 山東煙台水災，賑之。

translations.literal: Flood disaster at Yantai, Shandong; relief was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Yantai, Shandong flood victims were ordered relieved.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙酉，開廈門、鼓浪嶼為各國公地。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, yiyou day: Xiamen and Gulangyu were opened as international settlement zones.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn month 7, yiyou, Xiamen and Gulangyu were opened as foreign concessions.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，賞鄭孝胥四品京堂，督辦廣西邊防，得專奏。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Zheng Xiaoxu was rewarded with fourth-rank capital bureau status, put in charge of Guangxi frontier defense, and granted the right of direct memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Zheng Xiaoxu was given fourth-rank status to oversee Guangxi's frontier with direct memorial rights.

sentences.zh: 昆岡致仕。

translations.literal: Kun Gang retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: Kun Gang retired.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，初置商部，以載振為尚書。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Ministry of Commerce was first established, with Zai Zhen as minister.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the Commerce Ministry was created with Zai Zhen as head.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子朔，王公百官豫請來年皇太后七旬萬壽報效廉俸申祝，懿旨止之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, new moon day renzi: princes, dukes, and officials asked in advance to offer portions of their salaries for the Empress Dowager's seventieth birthday next year; an edict from the Empress Dowager forbade it.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, new moon renzi, officials asked to donate salaries for the dowager's seventieth birthday; she forbade it.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，免靈州瀕河地糧。

translations.literal: On day guichou, land tax on riverside fields in Ling Prefecture was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Ling riverside land tax was waived.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，日本商約成。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Japanese commercial treaty was concluded.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the Japanese commercial treaty was signed.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，見各國公使於仁壽殿。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the foreign ministers were received at the Hall of Benevolent Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, foreign ministers were received at the Hall of Benevolent Longevity.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以敬信為體仁閣大學士，裕德協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Jingxin was made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Embodied Benevolence; Yude was made Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Jingxin became Embodied Benevolence Grand Secretary and Yude associate Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，見法使呂班、德使穆默於仁壽殿。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, French minister Dubail and German minister Mumm were received at the Hall of Benevolent Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, French minister Dubail and German minister Mumm were received at the Hall of Benevolent Longevity.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，命榮慶在軍機大臣上學習行走。

translations.literal: Ninth month, bingshen day: Rongqing was ordered to study while serving on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, bingshen, Rongqing was told to study on the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 調那桐為外務部尚書兼會辦大臣。

translations.literal: Na Tong was transferred to be Minister of Foreign Affairs and concurrent assisting minister.
translations.idiomatic: Na Tong was moved to head foreign affairs as assisting minister.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命那桐與奕劻、瞿鴻禨整理戶部財政，榮慶充政務處大臣。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Na Tong was ordered to join Yikuang and Qu Hongji in reorganizing Board of Revenue finances; Rongqing was appointed minister of the Office of Government Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Na Tong joined Yikuang and Qu Hongji on finances; Rongqing joined the Government Affairs Office.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，命孫家鼐、張百熙並充政務處大臣。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Sun Jianai and Zhang Boxing were both appointed ministers of the Office of Government Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Sun Jianai and Zhang Boxing joined the Government Affairs Office.

sentences.zh: 是秋，賑湖北、陝西等屬水災，懷柔雹災，雲南各屬水旱災雹災，鎮西、綏來蝗災凍災。

translations.literal: That autumn, flood relief was ordered for Hubei, Shaanxi, and subordinate districts; hail disaster in Huairou; flood, drought, and hail in Yunnan subordinates; locust and frost disasters in Zhenxi and Suilai.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, floods in Hubei and Shaanxi, hail in Huairou, disasters in Yunnan, locusts and frost in Zhenxi and Suilai were relieved.

sentences.zh: 十月辛亥朔，見荷使希特斯於乾清宮。

translations.literal: Tenth month, new moon day xinhai: Dutch minister Heidt was received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, new moon xinhai, Dutch minister Heidt was received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以英秀接收阿勒台借地，率議展緩，命瑞洵往按之。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, because Yingxiu's reception of borrowed territory at Aletai led to proposals to extend the deadline, Ruixun was ordered to go investigate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Ruixun was sent to investigate Aletai leased land after Yingxiu delayed handover.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，置練兵處，命奕劻總理，袁世凱、鐵良副之。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the Army Reorganization Office was established; Yikuang was appointed director, Yuan Shikai and Tie Liang deputies.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, the Army Reorganization Office was set up under Yikuang with Yuan Shikai and Tie Liang as deputies.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命岑春渲總統廣西諸軍。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Cen Chunxuan was ordered to command all Guangxi forces.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Cen Chunxuan was put in command of all Guangxi troops.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，賞楊晟四品卿銜，充出使奧國大臣。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Yang Sheng was rewarded with fourth-rank honorary title and appointed minister to Austria.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Yang Sheng was given fourth rank and sent as minister to Austria.

sentences.zh: 丙子，袁世凱劾張翼擅售開平煤礦暨秦王島口岸於外人。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Yuan Shikai impeached Zhang Yi for selling the Kaiping coal mines and the Qinhuangdao port to foreigners without authorization.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Yuan Shikai charged Zhang Yi with illegally selling Kaiping mines and Qinhuangdao port to foreigners.

sentences.zh: 詔褫職，責令收回。

translations.literal: An edict stripped him of office and ordered recovery of what was sold.
translations.idiomatic: He was dismissed and ordered to take the assets back.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午，諭曰：「興學育才，當務之急。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, bingwu day: an edict said: "Promoting schools and nurturing talent is the urgent task.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, bingwu, an edict said promoting schools and talent was the urgent task.

sentences.zh: 據張之洞同管學大臣會訂學章所稱，學堂、科舉合為一途，俾士皆實學，學皆實用。

translations.literal: According to what Zhang Zhidong and the Superintendent of Education jointly fixed in school regulations, schools and the examination system are to be merged into one path, so that scholars gain real learning and learning gains real use.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong and the education superintendent had merged schools and examinations so scholars would gain real learning.

sentences.zh: 著自丙午科始，鄉、會中額，及各省學額，逐科遞減。

translations.literal: From the bingwu examinations onward, quotas for provincial and metropolitan degrees and for provincial student quotas are to be reduced examination by examination.
translations.idiomatic: From the bingwu exams onward, provincial, metropolitan, and student quotas would shrink each round.

sentences.zh: 俟各省學堂辦齊有效，科舉學額分別停止，以後均歸學堂考取。

translations.literal: When provincial schools are fully set up and effective, examination quotas are to be stopped separately; afterward all selection is through school examinations."
translations.idiomatic: When provincial schools worked, exam quotas would end and selection would pass entirely to schools."

sentences.zh: 」丁未，改管學大臣為學務大臣，以孫家鼐任之。

translations.literal: " On dingwei day, the Superintendent of Education was renamed Minister of Education, with Sun Jianai appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the education superintendent became Minister of Education under Sun Jianai.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，廣西匪首覃志發等伏誅。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, bingchen day: Guangxi bandit leaders Tan Zhifa and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, bingchen, Guangxi bandits Tan Zhifa and others were executed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔內務府再減宮廷用費，罷一切不急工作。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, an edict ordered the Imperial Household Department again to cut palace expenses and stop all non-urgent work.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, the Household Department was told to cut palace spending and halt non-urgent projects.

sentences.zh: 己巳，置翰林學士撰文，並增員缺，更定品級。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Hanlin academicians for drafting were established, posts increased, and grades revised.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, drafting Hanlin posts were created with more slots and new grades.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以日、俄手冓兵，中國守局外中立例，宣諭臣民。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, because Japan and Russia had joined battle, China would observe neutrality and the people were so informed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, with Japan and Russia at war, China's neutrality was proclaimed to the people.

sentences.zh: 己卯，授榮慶軍機大臣。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Rongqing was appointed Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Rongqing joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 是月，免安州被澇、昆明被旱地畝租糧。

translations.literal: That month, land tax and grain rent on flooded fields in An Prefecture and drought-stricken fields in Kunming were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month, flooded An and drought-hit Kunming land taxes were waived.

sentences.zh: 是冬，賑甘肅、雲南各州縣水災，南州、新化蛟災，瀘州火災。

translations.literal: That winter, flood relief was ordered for Gansu and Yunnan prefectures and counties; torrent disaster in Nanzhou and Xinhua; fire disaster in Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, Gansu and Yunnan floods, Nanzhou and Xinhua torrents, and Luzhou fire were relieved.

sentences.zh: 三十年甲辰春正月癸未，移廣西鹽道駐梧州，兼關監督。

translations.literal: Thirtieth year, jiachen, spring, first month, guiwei day: the Guangxi Salt Circuit was moved to Wuzhou with concurrent customs supervision.
translations.idiomatic: In year 30, jiachen, spring month 1, guiwei, the Guangxi salt circuit moved to Wuzhou and took customs oversight.

sentences.zh: 河決利津王莊。

translations.literal: The Yellow River burst its banks at Wangzhuang, Lijin.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River broke at Wangzhuang in Lijin.

sentences.zh: 甲申，見美、英、法、德、日、義、比、荷、葡各使康格等於乾清宮。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, ministers of the United States, Britain, France, Germany, Japan, Italy, Belgium, the Netherlands, and Portugal, including Conger, were received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, US, British, French, German, Japanese, Italian, Belgian, Dutch, and Portuguese ministers including Conger were received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 己丑，雲南提督張春發有罪，褫職戍軍台。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Yunnan Military Commissioner Zhang Chunfa was found guilty, stripped of office, and banished to a military guard post.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Zhang Chunfa, Yunnan commander, was dismissed and banished for misconduct.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以皇太后七旬聖壽，上御太和殿，頒詔天下，覃恩有差。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, for the Empress Dowager's seventieth sacred birthday, the Emperor ascended the Hall of Supreme Harmony, issued an edict to the realm, and granted amnesty each according to degree.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, for the dowager's seventieth birthday, the Emperor proclaimed amnesty from the Hall of Supreme Harmony.

sentences.zh: 已亥，雲南普洱鎮總兵高德元坐玩寇殃民處斬。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Gaodeyuan, commander at Pu'er in Yunnan, was executed for indulging bandits and harming the people.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Pu'er commander Gaodeyuan was beheaded for tolerating bandits and harming civilians.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔停本年秋決。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, an edict suspended autumn executions for this year.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, autumn executions were suspended this year.

sentences.zh: 二月庚戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon day gengxu: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, new moon gengxu, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己未，見葡使白朗穀於乾清宮。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Portuguese minister Barraso was received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Portuguese minister Barraso was received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，利津決口合龍。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the Lijin breach was closed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, the Lijin river breach was sealed.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰朔，見德使穆默等於乾清宮。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon day gengchen: German minister Mumm and others were received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, new moon gengchen, German minister Mumm and others were received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 癸未，御史蔣式瑆以疏劾奕劻語無根據，責還本官。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Censor Jiang Shixing was rebuked and returned to his post for memorializing against Yikuang on groundless charges.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Censor Jiang Shixing was sent back for a baseless attack on Yikuang.

sentences.zh: 戊子，下王照於獄。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Wang Zhao was imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Wang Zhao was jailed.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，免榆林等州縣逋課。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, tax arrears in Yulin and other prefectures and counties were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Yulin and other counties' tax arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丁未，張德彝與英訂保工條約成。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the labor-protection treaty with Britain negotiated by Zhang Deyi was concluded.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Zhang Deyi's Sino-British labor treaty was signed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛亥，見德親王阿拉拜爾、公使穆默於乾清宮。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinhai day: German Prince Albrecht and minister Mumm were received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: In summer month 4, xinhai, German Prince Albrecht and minister Mumm were received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，蘇元春戍新疆。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Su Yuanchun was banished to garrison duty in Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Su Yuanchun was sent to Xinjiang in exile.

sentences.zh: 是月，免鄧川上年災糧，新化被蛟，呼蘭、綏化等屬被兵逋賦。

translations.literal: That month, disaster grain tax in Dengchuan from the previous year was remitted; flash floods in Xinhua; war arrears in Hulan, Suihua, and subordinate districts.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Dengchuan disaster tax, Xinhua flood tax, and Hulan-Suihua war arrears were waived.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，命道員袁大化辦理安徽礦務。

translations.literal: Fifth month, xinsi day: Circuit Intendant Yuan Dahua was ordered to manage Anhui mining affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, xinsi, Yuan Dahua was told to handle Anhui mining.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，熱河行宮災。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, fire struck the Jehol imperial villa.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, the Jehol palace burned.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，懿旨特赦戊戌黨籍，除康有為、梁啟超、孫文外，褫職者復原銜，通緝、監禁、編管者釋免之。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, an edict from the Empress Dowager specially pardoned those of the 1898 faction; except Kang Youwei, Liang Qichao, and Sun Wen, those stripped of office had rank restored and those wanted, imprisoned, or under surveillance were released.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the dowager amnestied the 1898 reformers except Kang, Liang, and Sun; dismissed officials were restored and prisoners freed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，廣西叛勇陷柳城，斬統領祖繩武於軍前。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Guangxi mutinous troops seized Liucheng; commander Zu Shengwu was beheaded before the army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Guangxi mutineers took Liucheng and commander Zu Shengwu was executed in camp.

sentences.zh: 己亥，旌九世同居邢台貢生范鳳儀。

translations.literal: On day jihai, tribute student Fan Fengyi of Xingtai, nine generations dwelling together, was commended.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Xingtai student Fan Fengyi was honored for nine generations under one roof.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，賜劉春霖等二百七十三人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Liu Chunlin and 273 others were granted jinshi with first and lower passes, each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, 273 candidates including Liu Chunlin received jinshi degrees at different levels.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，懿旨，本年七旬壽節停筵宴，將軍、督撫等毋來京祝嘏，並免進獻。

translations.literal: On day yisi, an edict from the Empress Dowager ordered that banquet celebrations for this year's seventieth birthday be stopped; generals and governors were not to come to the capital to offer congratulations, and tribute gifts were also waived.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the dowager canceled birthday banquets and forbade governors from coming to court or sending gifts.

sentences.zh: 罷粵海、淮安關監督，江寧織造。

translations.literal: The superintendents of the Guangdong Maritime Customs and Huai'an Customs and the Nanjing imperial silk weaving office were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong customs, Huai'an customs, and Nanjing silk weaving superintendents were abolished.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，諭曰：「時艱民困，官吏壅蔽，下情不通。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jiyou day: an edict said: "Times are hard and the people suffer; officials obstruct and block, and sentiment below does not reach above.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, jiyou, an edict said hard times and official obstruction kept the court from hearing the people.

sentences.zh: 甚至州縣錢糧浮收中飽，以完作欠，百弊叢生，大負朝廷恤民之意。

translations.literal: Even at prefecture and county level, tax and grain are collected beyond quota and pocketed in the middle; what was paid is counted as owed—countless abuses arise, gravely betraying the court's intent to care for the people.
translations.idiomatic: Counties over-collected taxes, pocketed surcharges, and booked payments as arrears, betraying the court's care for the people.

sentences.zh: 各督撫速將糧額幾何，實徵幾何，正耗收米或折色幾何，具列簡明表冊。

translations.literal: Each governor-general and governor is urgently to report how much was the quota, how much actually collected, how much grain for principal and surcharge or how much converted to cash, setting forth concise tables.
translations.idiomatic: Every governor-general and governor had to report quotas, actual collections, grain and surcharges, or cash conversions in concise tables.

sentences.zh: 此外有無規費，一一登明聲敘，毋飾毋漏，據實奏聞。

translations.literal: Whether there are any other customary fees besides these must each be clearly recorded and stated—no embellishment, no omission—and reported truthfully in memorial."
translations.idiomatic: Any other fees had to be listed plainly without concealment and reported truthfully."

sentences.zh: 」壬子，命鐵良往江南考求製造局廠，籌畫所宜，並察出入款目，及各司庫局所利弊。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Tie Liang was ordered to go to Jiangnan to survey manufacturing bureau workshops, plan what was suitable, and inspect income and expenditure accounts and the pros and cons of each treasury and bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Tie Liang was sent to Jiangnan to review arsenals, plan reforms, and audit treasuries and bureaus.

sentences.zh: 戊午，趣岑春渲赴桂、柳督師。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Cen Chunxuan was urgently summoned to supervise troops in Gui and Liu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Cen Chunxuan was rushed to command in Guangxi and Liuzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，青海住牧盟長車琳端多布等，請藉年班繼貢物赴京祝嘏。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Qinghai pasture league chiefs Chelinduoduo and others asked to use the annual tribute escort to bring congratulatory gifts to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Qinghai league chiefs asked to join the tribute mission with birthday gifts for the capital.

sentences.zh: 懿旨嘉獎，仍卻之。

translations.literal: An empress-dowager decree praised them but still declined.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager commended them but still refused.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，永定河決。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Yongding River breached.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, the Yongding River broke.

sentences.zh: 丙子，河決利津薄莊。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, the river breached at Bozhuang in Lijin.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the river broke at Lijin's Bozhuang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊寅，見比使葛飛業於乾清宮。

translations.literal: Seventh month, autumn, day wuyin: the Belgian minister Ge Feiye was received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, wuyin, Belgian minister Ge Feiye was received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 罷福建水師提督，歸並於陸路提督，移駐廈門。

translations.literal: The Fujian naval commander-in-chief was abolished and merged into the land-route commander-in-chief, who moved his headquarters to Xiamen.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian's naval commander-in-chief was abolished and merged into the land commander at Xiamen.

sentences.zh: 甲申，永定河北下汛復決。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the Yongding River's lower summer flood season breached again.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, the Yongding broke again in the lower summer season.

sentences.zh: 戊子，發內帑十萬賑四川水旱災。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, one hundred thousand taels from the privy purse were released to relieve Sichuan flood and drought.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, one hundred thousand taels from the privy purse went to Sichuan flood and drought relief.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，英兵入藏境，達賴逃，褫其名號，命班禪額爾德尼攝之。

translations.literal: On day renchen, British troops entered Tibet; the Dalai Lama fled; his title was stripped; the Panchen Erdeni was ordered to act in his place.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, British troops entered Tibet; the Dalai fled and lost his title; the Panchen Erdeni was put in charge.

sentences.zh: 甲午，甘肅黃河決，皋蘭被災，命崧蕃賑濟。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the Yellow River in Gansu breached; Gaolan suffered disaster; Song Fan was ordered to provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Gansu's Yellow River broke at Gaolan; Song Fan was told to relieve the district.

sentences.zh: 乙未，停九江進瓷器。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Jiujiang's porcelain tribute was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Jiujiang porcelain tribute was stopped.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命李興銳署兩江總督兼南洋大臣。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Li Xingrui was appointed acting governor-general of the Two Jiangs and minister for the Southern Seas.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Li Xingrui became acting Two-Jiangs governor-general and Southern Seas minister.

sentences.zh: 是月，賞湯壽潛四品卿銜，督辦浙江鐵路。

translations.literal: That month, Tang Shouqian was granted the fourth-rank chamberlain title and put in charge of the Zhejiang railway.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Tang Shouqian received fourth-rank chamberlain rank to build the Zhejiang railway.

sentences.zh: 八月丁未朔，裁併內務府司員。

translations.literal: Eighth month, new moon on day dingwei: staff posts in the Imperial Household Department were cut and merged.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, dingwei new moon, Imperial Household Department posts were reduced.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賞唐紹儀副都統銜，往西藏查辦事件。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Tang Shaoyi was granted acting vice commissioner-in-chief rank and sent to Tibet to investigate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Tang Shaoyi received vice commissioner rank to investigate Tibet.

sentences.zh: 辛未，見義使嘎尼納於仁壽殿。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Italian minister Ganina was received at the Hall of Benevolent Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Italian minister Ganina was received at the Hall of Benevolent Longevity.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，見墨使酈華於乾清宮。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Mexican minister Li Hua was received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Mexican minister Li Hua was received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子朔，見英使薩道義於乾清宮。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on day bingzi: the British minister Sadoi was received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, bingzi new moon, British minister Sadoi was received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 癸未，敬信以疾免。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Jing Xin was dismissed on illness.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, ill Jing Xin was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 己亥，李興銳卒，命周馥署兩江總督兼南洋大臣。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Li Xingrui died; Zhou Fu was appointed acting governor-general of the Two Jiangs and minister for the Southern Seas.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Li Xingrui died; Zhou Fu became acting Two-Jiangs governor-general and Southern Seas minister.

sentences.zh: 以英兵入藏，達賴求救，命德麟安撫之。

translations.literal: Because British troops had entered Tibet, the Dalai Lama sought aid; Delin was ordered to pacify him.
translations.idiomatic: As British troops had entered Tibet, the Dalai sought help and Delin was ordered to pacify him.

sentences.zh: 英兵旋退。

translations.literal: The British troops soon withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The British troops soon pulled back.

sentences.zh: 敕唐紹儀為議約全權大臣。

translations.literal: Tang Shaoyi was commissioned plenipotentiary minister for treaty negotiations.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Shaoyi was made plenipotentiary treaty minister.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，改湖北糧道為施鶴兵備道。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Hubei grain intendant was changed to the Shihe military defense circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Hubei's grain intendant became the Shihe military defense circuit.

sentences.zh: 是秋，免吉林被兵、雲南水旱兵災逋賦，武威、金州額賦。

translations.literal: That autumn, overdue levies were remitted for Jilin districts afflicted by war, Yunnan flood, drought, and war, and quota taxes in Wuwei and Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, Jilin war arrears, Yunnan disaster arrears, and Wuwei and Jinzhou quota taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 賑雲南、順天、福建、甘肅、江西水災，山西、浙江、廣東等處災。

translations.literal: Relief was sent for floods in Yunnan, Shuntian, Fujian, Gansu, and Jiangxi, and disasters in Shanxi, Zhejiang, Guangdong, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Flood relief went to Yunnan, Shuntian, Fujian, Gansu, and Jiangxi; other provinces received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，呂海寰續訂中葡商約成。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingwu: Lü Haihuan completed the revised Sino-Portuguese commercial treaty.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, month 10, bingwu, Lü Haihuan finished the revised Sino-Portuguese commercial treaty.

sentences.zh: 以裕德為體仁閣大學士，世續協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Yu De was made grand secretary of the Hall of Embodied Benevolence; Shixu was made associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Yu De became grand secretary of the Hall of Embodied Benevolence; Shixu became associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，見奧、美、德、俄、比諸使齊幹等於皇極殿。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, ministers of Austria, the United States, Germany, Russia, and Belgium, including Qi Gan, were received at the Hall of Supreme Harmony.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Austrian, American, German, Russian, and Belgian ministers were received at the Hall of Supreme Harmony.

sentences.zh: 永定河決口合龍。

translations.literal: The Yongding River breach was closed.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongding breach was sealed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上奉皇太后御仁壽殿，賜近支宗籓等宴，率王、貝勒、貝子、公等進舞。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to the Hall of Benevolent Longevity and gave a banquet to close imperial clansmen; princes, beiles, beizi, and dukes led the dance.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, the Emperor took the empress dowager to the Hall of Benevolent Longevity, feasted close clansmen, and led princes in dance.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，皇太后聖壽節，上詣排雲殿進表賀。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Empress Dowager's birthday; the Emperor went to the Paiyun Hall to present a congratulatory memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the empress dowager's birthday, the Emperor congratulated her at the Paiyun Hall.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，見英、日、法、韓諸使薩道義等於皇極殿。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, the British, Japanese, French, and Korean ministers, including Sadoi, were received at the Hall of Supreme Harmony.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, British, Japanese, French, and Korean ministers were received at the Hall of Supreme Harmony.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，懿旨禁各省藉新政巧立名目，苛細私捐。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, an empress-dowager edict forbade provinces from using New Policies as a pretext to create names and exact petty private levies.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, the empress dowager barred provinces from petty New Policy levies.

sentences.zh: 一切學堂工藝有關教養者，當官為勸導，紳民自籌，毋滋苛擾。

translations.literal: For all schools and crafts related to education and nurture, officials were to guide and encourage them; gentry and people were to fund them themselves without harassment.
translations.idiomatic: Schools and useful crafts were to be officially encouraged; local gentry were to fund them without harassment.

sentences.zh: 除浙江墮民籍，准入學堂，畢業者予出身。

translations.literal: The degraded-people register in Zhejiang was abolished; they were admitted to schools, and graduates were granted official status.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang's degraded-people register was abolished; graduates of schools could receive official rank.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙亥朔，命廕昌仍充出使德國大臣，曾廣銓充出使韓國大臣。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon on day yihai: Yin Chang was again made minister to Germany; Zeng Guangquan was made minister to Korea.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, yihai new moon, Yin Chang returned as minister to Germany and Zeng Guangquan became minister to Korea.

sentences.zh: 四川打箭爐地震。

translations.literal: An earthquake struck Dajianlu in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Dajianlu in Sichuan was shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，見義使巴樂禮於乾清宮。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Italian minister Palese was received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Italian minister Palese was received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 壬午，廣西匪首陸亞發伏誅。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Guangxi bandit chief Lu Yafa was executed after capture.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Guangxi bandit chief Lu Yafa was executed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，定新軍官制。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the New Army officer system was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, the New Army officer regulations were set.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，諭增祺賑撫東三省難民。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Zeng Qi was instructed to relieve and pacify refugees in the Three Eastern Provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Zeng Qi was told to relieve Three Eastern Provinces refugees.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，見義使巴樂禮、荷使希特斯、葡使阿梅達等於皇極殿。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wushen: the Italian minister Palese, Dutch minister Histers, and Portuguese minister Almeida were received at the Hall of Supreme Harmony.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, wushen, Italian, Dutch, and Portuguese ministers were received at the Hall of Supreme Harmony.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，裁江安糧道，改江南鹽道為鹽糧道。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Jiang'an grain intendant was abolished; the Jiangnan salt intendant was changed to the salt-and-grain intendant.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Jiang'an's grain intendant was cut and Jiangnan's salt post became salt-and-grain intendant.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，發內帑三十萬賑奉天難民。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, three hundred thousand taels from the privy purse were released to relieve Fengtian refugees.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, three hundred thousand taels from the privy purse went to Fengtian refugees.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，直隸始行公債票。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Zhili began issuing public bond notes.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Zhili began public bond issues.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，罷漕運總督，置江淮巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the grain-transport governor-general was abolished and a Jiang-Huai governor was established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, the grain-transport governor-general was abolished and a Jiang-Huai governor was set up.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，立貴冑學堂。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, an academy for noble youths was established.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, a noble youths' academy was founded.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，置黑龍江巡道兼按察使銜，蘭綏海兵備道，呼蘭、綏化二府。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, a Heilongjiang circuit intendant with acting surveillance commissioner rank was established, a Lan-Suihai military defense circuit, and the two prefectures of Hulan and Suihua.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Heilongjiang gained a circuit intendant with surveillance rank, a Lan-Suihai defense circuit, and Hulan and Suihua prefectures.

sentences.zh: 辛未，修四川都江堰。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Dujiangyan works in Sichuan were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Sichuan's Dujiangyan works were repaired.

sentences.zh: 是冬，裁湖北、雲南巡撫，湖南、陝西糧道。

translations.literal: That winter, the Hubei and Yunnan governors were abolished, and the Hunan and Shaanxi grain intendants.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, Hubei and Yunnan governors and Hunan and Shaanxi grain intendants were cut.

sentences.zh: 免石屏、趙州秋糧，陳留等州縣逋賦，朝邑被水額賦。

translations.literal: Autumn grain was remitted for Shiping and Zhaozhou; overdue levies for Chenliu and other districts; quota taxes for flood-stricken Chaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: Shiping and Zhaozhou autumn grain, Chenliu arrears, and Chaoyi flood quota taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 三十一年乙巳春正月丁丑，見德、英、日本、法、荷、比、義、日、葡、墨、美、韓、奧諸使於乾清宮。

translations.literal: Thirty-first year, yisi, spring, first month, day dingchou: ministers of Germany, Britain, Japan, France, the Netherlands, Belgium, Italy, Russia, Portugal, Mexico, the United States, Korea, and Austria were received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: Year 31, spring 1, dingchou: German, British, Japanese, French, Dutch, Belgian, Italian, Russian, Portuguese, Mexican, American, Korean, and Austrian ministers were received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 達賴喇嘛請於庫倫建廟諷經，不許。

translations.literal: The Dalai Lama asked to build a temple at Kulun for sutra recitation; it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The Dalai Lama's request for a Kulun temple was refused.

sentences.zh: 命仍還藏，善撫眾生。

translations.literal: He was ordered to return to Tibet and govern the people well.
translations.idiomatic: He was told to return to Tibet and care for the people.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，鐵良言察閱諸省營伍，湖北陸軍為最優，詔嘉獎。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Tie Liang reported on his inspection of provincial camps; Hubei's army was rated best; an imperial commendation was issued.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Tie Liang's camp inspection praised Hubei's army best and drew an imperial commendation.

sentences.zh: 江南各軍統領懲罰有差。

translations.literal: Commanders of the various Jiangnan armies were punished to differing degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan army commanders were punished variously.

sentences.zh: 命唐紹儀充出使英國大臣。

translations.literal: Tang Shaoyi was appointed minister to Britain.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Shaoyi became minister to Britain.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，懿旨發內帑三十萬撫恤東三省難民。

translations.literal: Second month, day yisi: an empress-dowager edict released three hundred thousand taels from the privy purse to comfort refugees in the Three Eastern Provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, yisi, the empress dowager gave three hundred thousand taels from the privy purse for Three Eastern Provinces refugees.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，命長庚、徐世昌考驗改編三鎮新軍。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Chang Geng and Xu Shichang were ordered to inspect and reorganize the three-division New Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Chang Geng and Xu Shichang were told to inspect and reorganize the three-division New Army.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，景陵隆恩殿災。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, fire destroyed the Longen Hall at the Jing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, the Jing Mausoleum Longen Hall burned.

sentences.zh: 庚午，見美使康格於海晏堂。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the American minister Conger was received at the Hall of Universal Peace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, American minister Conger was received at the Hall of Universal Peace.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賑阿拉善遊牧。

translations.literal: On day renshen, relief was sent to Alashan nomads.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Alashan nomads received relief.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，免陝西前歲逋糧。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the previous year's overdue grain in Shaanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Shaanxi's prior-year grain arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥，奉天饑。

translations.literal: Third month, day yihai: famine in Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, yihai, Fengtian suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 俄兵入長春，據之。

translations.literal: Russian troops entered Changchun and occupied it.
translations.idiomatic: Russian troops entered and seized Changchun.

sentences.zh: 丙子，巴塘番人焚毀法國教堂，駐藏幫辦鳳全剿捕，遇伏死。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Batang Tibetans burned a French church; Feng Quan, assistant commissioner in Tibet, pursued and was ambushed and killed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Batang Tibetans burned a French church; Feng Quan was killed in an ambush while suppressing them.

sentences.zh: 飭四川提督馬維騏剿之。

translations.literal: The Sichuan provincial commander Ma Weiqi was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan commander Ma Weiqi was ordered to suppress the rebels.

sentences.zh: 命柯逢時管理八省土膏統捐事宜。

translations.literal: Ke Fengshi was ordered to manage the unified native-opium levy in eight provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Ke Fengshi was put in charge of the eight-province native-opium levy.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，見德親王福禮留伯、公使穆默於乾清宮。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the German prince Fürst von Hohenlohe and minister Mumm were received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, German Prince Hohenlohe and minister Mumm were received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔督撫舉堪勝提鎮官者。

translations.literal: On day jimao, governors and governors-general were instructed to recommend men fit for regional commander and brigade commander posts.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, governors were told to recommend fit regional and brigade commanders.

sentences.zh: 己丑，雲南省城開商埠。

translations.literal: On day jichou, a commercial port was opened in Yunnan provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Yunnan's provincial capital opened as a treaty port.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，罷新置江淮巡撫，改淮揚總兵為江北提督。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the newly established Jiang-Huai governor was abolished; the Huai-Yang regional commander was changed to commander-in-chief of Jiangbei.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the Jiang-Huai governor was cut and the Huai-Yang commander became Jiangbei commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，諭更定法律。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the law was ordered revised.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, legal revision was ordered.

sentences.zh: 死罪至斬決止，除凌遲、梟首、戮屍等刑。

translations.literal: Capital punishment was limited to decapitation; lingering death, exposure of the head, and corpse mutilation were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Capital punishment stopped at decapitation; lingering death, exposure, and mutilation were abolished.

sentences.zh: 斬、絞、監候者以次遞減。

translations.literal: Decapitation, strangulation, and imprisonment awaiting execution were reduced step by step.
translations.idiomatic: Decapitation, strangulation, and suspended sentences were reduced in severity.

sentences.zh: 緣坐各條，除知情外，餘悉寬免。

translations.literal: For all collective-punishment articles, except those who knowingly shared guilt, the rest were broadly remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Collective-punishment rules were broadly remitted except for knowing accomplices.

sentences.zh: 刺字諸例並除之。

translations.literal: All tattooing provisions were also abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Tattooing provisions were abolished as well.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以禁止刑訊，變通笞、杖，清查監獄羈所，諭督撫實力奉行。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, because judicial torture was forbidden, bamboo and stick punishments were adjusted, prisons and detention houses were inspected, and governors were instructed to enforce this in earnest.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, torture was banned, bamboo punishments adjusted, prisons inspected, and governors told to enforce the reforms.

sentences.zh: 乙未，犍為匪徒作亂，官軍剿平之。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, bandits rose in Qianwei; government troops suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Qianwei bandits were suppressed by government troops.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命周馥往江北籌畫吏治、海防、河工、捕務。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Zhou Fu was ordered to go to Jiangbei to plan local administration, coastal defense, river works, and policing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Zhou Fu was sent to Jiangbei to plan administration, coast defense, rivers, and policing.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰，以俄艦至南洋，諭所在預防，並禁商人運煤接濟。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiachen: because Russian warships had reached the Southern Seas, the localities were instructed to take precautions and merchants were forbidden to transport coal to assist them.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month 4, jiachen, Russian warships in the south brought precautions and a ban on merchant coal sales to them.

sentences.zh: 更定竊盜條款。

translations.literal: The articles on theft were revised.
translations.idiomatic: Theft statutes were revised.

sentences.zh: 凡應擬笞、杖者改罰工作。

translations.literal: All cases warranting bamboo or stick punishment were changed to penal labor.
translations.idiomatic: Bamboo and stick sentences became penal labor.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，諭各省府州縣立罪犯習藝所。

translations.literal: On day yisi, provinces, prefectures, departments, and counties were instructed to establish houses of correction for convicts to learn crafts.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, every province was told to establish convict craft houses.

sentences.zh: 丙午，賞劉永慶侍郎銜，署江北提督，鎮、道以下歸節制。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Liu Yongqing was granted vice minister rank, made acting commander-in-chief of Jiangbei, and brigade commanders and circuit intendants below were placed under his command.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Liu Yongqing became acting Jiangbei commander-in-chief with vice minister rank over subordinate commanders.

sentences.zh: 丁未，裁廣東糧道，置廉欽兵備道。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Guangdong grain intendant was abolished and a Lian-Qin military defense circuit was established.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Guangdong's grain intendant was cut and a Lian-Qin defense circuit was set up.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命程德全署黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Cheng Desuan was appointed acting general of Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Cheng Desuan became acting Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 壬子，德兵艦突至海州測量，飭嚴詰。

translations.literal: On day renzi, a German warship suddenly reached Haizhou to survey; a stern inquiry was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, a German warship surveyed Haizhou and drew a stern protest.

sentences.zh: 五月丁亥，見日使賈思理、美使柔克義於乾清宮。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dinghai: the Japanese minister Kajiwara and American minister Rockhill were received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, dinghai, Japanese minister Kajiwara and American minister Rockhill were received at the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，見墨使胡爾達於皇極殿。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the Mexican minister Hulda was received at the Hall of Supreme Harmony.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Mexican minister Hulda was received at the Hall of Supreme Harmony.

sentences.zh: 庚子，王文韶罷軍機大臣，命徐世昌在軍機大臣上學習行走，兼政務處大臣，鐵良、徐世昌會辦練兵事。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Wang Wenshao was removed as grand councilor; Xu Shichang was ordered to study while serving on the Grand Council, also as a minister of the Office of Government Affairs; Tie Liang and Xu Shichang jointly managed military training.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Wang Wenshao left the Grand Council; Xu Shichang joined it and the Office of Government Affairs; Tie Liang and Xu Shichang shared military training.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午，見俄使璞科第於仁壽殿。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingwu: the Russian minister Pokotilov was received at the Hall of Benevolent Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, bingwu, Russian minister Pokotilov was received at the Hall of Benevolent Longevity.

sentences.zh: 免中牟等州縣逋賦。

translations.literal: Overdue levies were remitted for Zhongmou and other districts.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongmou and other districts were forgiven overdue levies.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，予考試留學生金邦平等進士舉人出身有差。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, returned students who passed the examination, including Jin Bangping, were granted jinshi and juren status in differing degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, returned students such as Jin Bangping received jinshi and juren ranks by examination.

sentences.zh: 命載澤、戴鴻慈、徐世昌、端方往東西洋各國考察政治。

translations.literal: Zai Ze, Dai Hongci, Xu Shichang, and Duanfang were ordered to go to Eastern and Western countries to study government.
translations.idiomatic: Zai Ze, Dai Hongci, Xu Shichang, and Duanfang were sent abroad to study government.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔置盛京三陵守護大臣。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, guardians for the three Mukden mausoleums were established by decree.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, guardians were established for the three Mukden mausoleums.

sentences.zh: 裁盛京戶、禮、兵、刑、工五部侍郎。

translations.literal: The five vice ministers of the Mukden boards of Revenue, Rites, War, Punishments, and Works were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Mukden's five board vice ministers were abolished.

sentences.zh: 己未，以世續為體仁閣大學士，那桐協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Shiru was made Grand Secretary of the Tiren Pavilion and Natong Assistant Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Shiru became Tiren Pavilion grand secretary and Natong assistant grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，裁廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Guangdong governor-general post was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the Guangdong governor-generalship was cut.

sentences.zh: 庚午，黔匪陷都勻之四寨，官軍克復之。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Guizhou bandits took four stockades at Duyun; government troops recovered them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Duyun bandits seized four stockades but troops retook them.

sentences.zh: 七月丙子，罷御史巡視五城及街道□，改練勇為巡捕。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day bingzi: censor patrol of the five wards and street offices was abolished, and trained braves were changed into patrol police.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, bingzi, censor street patrol was ended and trained braves became patrol police.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，續派紹英為出洋考察政治大臣。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Shaoying was again dispatched as a minister to inspect government abroad.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Shaoying was sent again to study foreign government.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以巴塘兵事，開實官捐一年。

translations.literal: On day jichou, because of the Batang military affair, purchase of substantive offices was opened for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Batang fighting opened one year of substantive-office sales.

sentences.zh: 丙申，賞廷傑侍郎，往奉天辦墾荒事務。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Tingjie was rewarded with vice-minister rank and sent to Fengtian to manage reclamation affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Tingjie gained vice-minister rank for Fengtian reclamation work.

sentences.zh: 常德、湘潭開商埠。

translations.literal: Changde and Xiangtan were opened as treaty ports.
translations.idiomatic: Changde and Xiangtan became treaty ports.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命鐵良在軍機大臣上學習行走，尋兼政務處大臣。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Tieliang was ordered to study and serve under the Grand Council ministers and soon also served on the Bureau of Government Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Tieliang joined the Grand Council for training and soon the Government Affairs Bureau.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，諭：「各省工商抵制美約，既礙邦交，亦損商務。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renyin: an edict stated, "In the provinces, merchants and gentry boycotting the American treaty both harm interstate relations and damage commerce.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, renyin, the court said provincial anti-American boycotts hurt diplomacy and trade.

sentences.zh: 疆吏當剴切開導，以時稽察之。

translations.literal: Border officials must earnestly instruct the people and inspect the matter in good time."
translations.idiomatic: Governors must guide the people and keep timely watch."

sentences.zh: 」甲辰，詔廢科舉。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, an edict abolished the civil service examinations.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, the examinations were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙午，裁奉天府尹、府丞，改置東三省學政。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Fengtian intendant and vice intendant were cut and Eastern Three Provinces education commissioners were established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Fengtian's intendant posts ended and Manchuria gained education commissioners.

sentences.zh: 命劉式訓充出使法日大臣，黃誥充出使義國大臣，周榮曜充出使比國大臣。

translations.literal: Liu Shixun was appointed envoy minister to France and Japan, Huang Gao to Italy, and Zhou Rongyao to Belgium.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shixun went to France and Japan, Huang Gao to Italy, and Zhou Rongyao to Belgium.

sentences.zh: 榮曜旋罷，改任李盛鐸。

translations.literal: Rongyao was soon removed and Li Shengduo took his place.
translations.idiomatic: Rongyao was recalled and Li Shengduo replaced him.

sentences.zh: 丁未，免奉天北路被兵額賦。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, grain taxes for Fengtian's northern route districts ravaged by troops were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Fengtian northern-route war taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，發內帑三萬於江蘇備急賑。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, thirty thousand taels from the privy purse were issued for Jiangsu emergency relief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, thirty thousand taels from the privy purse went to Jiangsu relief.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔各省學政專司考校學堂，嗣後學政事宜，歸學務大臣考核。

translations.literal: On day guichou, an edict ordered provincial education commissioners to devote themselves solely to examining schools; thereafter education commissioners' affairs would be assessed by the Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, education commissioners were confined to school examinations under the Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 戊午，新疆巡撫潘效蘇坐侵款褫職，戍軍台。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Pan Xiaosu, governor-general of Xinjiang, was stripped of office for embezzlement and exiled to the military colonies.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Xinjiang governor Pan Xiaosu lost office for embezzlement and went to the colonies.

sentences.zh: 己未，命袁世凱、鐵良校閱新軍秋操。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Yuan Shikai and Tieliang were ordered to review the new army's autumn maneuvers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Yuan Shikai and Tieliang were told to inspect autumn maneuvers.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，命汪大燮充出使英國大臣，楊晟充出使德國大臣，李經邁充出使奧國大臣。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Wang Daxie was appointed envoy minister to Britain, Yang Sheng to Germany, and Li Jingmai to Austria.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Wang Daxie went to Britain, Yang Sheng to Germany, and Li Jingmai to Austria.

sentences.zh: 甲子，開海州商埠。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Haizhou was opened as a treaty port.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Haizhou became a treaty port.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，改命李經方為商約大臣。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Li Jingfang was reassigned Minister of Commercial Treaties.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Li Jingfang became Minister of Commercial Treaties.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，載澤等啟行，甫登車，有人猝擲炸彈。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, when Zai Ze and the others set out, just as they boarded the carriage someone suddenly threw a bomb.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, as Zai Ze's party boarded their train a bomb was thrown.

sentences.zh: 事上，詔嚴捕重懲。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, an edict ordered severe arrest and heavy punishment.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the culprits seized and punished severely.

sentences.zh: 己巳，巴塘亂平，匪首喇嘛阿澤、隆本郎吉等伏誅。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Batang rising was pacified; the rebel chiefs the lama Aze, Longben Langji, and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Batang was quiet and rebel leaders including Lama Aze were executed.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，以三品京堂周榮曜舊充關書，侵盜鉅帑，褫職逮治，籍其貲。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingzi: third-rank capital official Zhou Rongyao, who had formerly served on customs ledgers, was stripped of office, arrested, and tried for embezzling a huge treasury sum; his property was registered for seizure.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, bingzi, ex-customs clerk Zhou Rongyao lost office for huge embezzlement and his estate was seized.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，初置巡警部，以徐世昌為尚書。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Police Department was first established, with Xu Shichang as minister.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the Police Department was created under Xu Shichang.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，北新倉火。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, fire broke out at Beixin Granary.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Beixin Granary burned.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，論肅清廣西功，晉岑春渲太子少保銜，李經羲優獎。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, merit in pacifying Guangxi was discussed; Cen Chunxuan was given the Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent rank and Li Jingxi was specially rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Guangxi pacification honors raised Cen Chunxuan and rewarded Li Jingxi.

sentences.zh: 丙申，見德使穆默於勤政殿。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the German minister Mumm von Schwarzenstein was received in the Hall of Diligent Government.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Minister Mumm was received in the Hall of Diligent Government.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，命尚其亨、李盛鐸會同載澤等赴各國考察政治。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Shang Qiheng and Li Shengduo were ordered to join Zai Ze and the others in inspecting government in each country.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Shang Qiheng and Li Shengduo joined Zai Ze's foreign inspection mission.

sentences.zh: 是秋，賑貴州、雲南各屬水災，太康風災，鎮番暨巴燕戎格雹災風災。

translations.literal: That autumn, flood relief was sent to Guizhou and Yunnan districts, Taikang wind disaster, and Zhenfan together with Bayan Rongge hail and wind disaster.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn brought relief for Guizhou and Yunnan floods, Taikang wind damage, and Zhenfan-Bayan Rongge hailstorms.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯，見日本公使內田康哉等於勤政殿。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guimao: the Japanese minister Uchida Kanzo and others were received in the Hall of Diligent Government.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, month 10, guimao, Minister Uchida and others were received.

sentences.zh: 置吉林哈爾濱道。
