translations.literal: The Jilin Harbin Circuit was established.
translations.idiomatic: Jilin's Harbin Circuit was set up.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，蘆漢鐵路成。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Luhankou Railway was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the Luhankou Railway opened.

sentences.zh: 英兵入藏，索賠款一百二十餘萬。

translations.literal: British troops entered Tibet and demanded indemnity of more than 1.2 million taels.
translations.idiomatic: British forces entered Tibet and demanded over 1.2 million taels.

sentences.zh: 諭國家代給，以恤番艱。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the state to pay on Tibet's behalf to relieve Tibetan hardship.
translations.idiomatic: The court paid for Tibet to ease Tibetan distress.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，訂鑄造銀幣及行用章程。

translations.literal: On day renxu, regulations for minting silver coins and their circulation were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, silver coin minting and circulation rules were set.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以陸徵祥充出使荷國大臣，兼理海牙和平會事。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Lu Zhengxiang was appointed envoy minister to the Netherlands and also handled Hague peace conference affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Lu Zhengxiang went to the Netherlands and the Hague peace conference.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，置考察政治館，擇各國政法宜於中國治體者，斟酌損益，纂訂成書，取旨裁定。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, a Bureau for Inspecting Government was established to select foreign laws and institutions suited to China's polity, weigh additions and cuts, compile a book, and submit it for imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, a bureau was set up to adapt foreign institutions to China's polity.

sentences.zh: 詔：「近有不逞之徒，造為革命排滿之說，假借黨派，陰行叛逆。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Recently unruly persons have fabricated talk of revolution and anti-Manchu exclusion, borrowing party names while secretly carrying out rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: The court warned that revolutionaries were plotting rebellion under party names.

sentences.zh: 各疆臣應嚴禁密緝。

translations.literal: Each border official must strictly forbid it and secretly arrest offenders.
translations.idiomatic: Governors must ban such talk and arrest plotters in secret.

sentences.zh: 首從各犯，論如謀逆例。

translations.literal: Ringleaders and all accomplices are to be punished under the statute for plotting treason."
translations.idiomatic: Leaders and accomplices face the treason statute."

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午朔，陝、洛會匪平。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon on day gengwu: Shaanxi and Luoyang joint bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, gengwu new moon, Shaanxi-Luoyang bandits were subdued.

sentences.zh: 辛未，裕德卒。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Yu De died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Yu De died.

sentences.zh: 丙子，罷駐韓使臣，改置總領事。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, the resident minister in Korea was abolished and a consul-general was established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Korea's resident minister became a consul-general.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔置學部，以國子監歸並之，調榮慶為尚書。

translations.literal: On day jimao, an edict established the Ministry of Education, merging the Directorate of Education into it, and Rongqing was transferred to serve as minister.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, the Ministry of Education was created with Rongqing as minister.

sentences.zh: 乙未，中日新約成。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the new Sino-Japanese treaty was concluded.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, a new China-Japan treaty was signed.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛亥，授那桐體仁閣大學士，榮慶協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinhai: Natong was made Grand Secretary of the Tiren Pavilion and Rongqing Assistant Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, xinhai, Natong became Tiren grand secretary and Rongqing assistant grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，置京師內外城巡警總厅。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Metropolitan Inner and Outer City Police General Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Beijing's inner and outer police headquarters were set up.

sentences.zh: 罷工巡局。

translations.literal: The patrol bureau of artisans was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The artisans' patrol bureau was cut.

sentences.zh: 命徐世昌、鐵良並為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: Xu Shichang and Tieliang were both appointed Grand Council ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Shichang and Tieliang joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 是月，免盛京各旗、陝西各屬被兵逋賦，安州積澇、韓城水沖地租。

translations.literal: That month, overdue levies from troops in the Shengjing banners and Shaanxi districts were remitted, as were rents on Anzhou flood land and Hancheng washaway fields.
translations.idiomatic: That month forgave Shengjing and Shaanxi war arrears and Anzhou-Hancheng land rents.

sentences.zh: 是冬，賑會澤潦災，荊州水災，英吉沙爾水災雹災。

translations.literal: That winter, flood relief was sent to Huize, Jingzhou flood disaster, and Yengisar flood and hail disaster.
translations.idiomatic: That winter brought relief for Huize, Jingzhou floods, and Yengisar flood-hail.

sentences.zh: 三十二年丙午春正月丙子，緩布特哈貢貂。

translations.literal: Thirty-second year, bingwu, spring, first month, day bingzi: tribute sable from Buteha was deferred.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 32, spring 1, bingzi, Buteha sable tribute was postponed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，見德、英、法、美、日本、荷、義、俄、奧、比、葡、墨諸使穆默等於乾清宮。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the ministers of Germany, Britain, France, the United States, Japan, the Netherlands, Italy, Russia, Austria, Belgium, Portugal, and Mexico, including Mumm, were received in the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Mumm and other foreign ministers were received in the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，漳浦匪首張嬰伏誅。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Zhang Ying, bandit chief of Zhangpu, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Zhangpu rebel Zhang Ying was executed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，徐郙以察典罷。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Xu Ye was dismissed for inspection failures.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Xu Ye lost office over inspection faults.

sentences.zh: 甲午，命瞿鴻禨協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Qu Hongji was appointed Assistant Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Qu Hongji became assistant grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰，詔各省保護教堂及外人身家。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuchen: an edict ordered the provinces to protect churches and foreigners' persons and property.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, wuchen, provinces were told to protect churches and foreigners.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，見德使穆默等於勤政殿。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Minister Mumm and others were received in the Hall of Diligent Government.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Minister Mumm and others were received.

sentences.zh: 是月，頒帑十萬助賑日本災。

translations.literal: That month, one hundred thousand taels from the treasury were issued to aid Japan's disaster relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month sent one hundred thousand taels to aid Japan's disaster victims.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰朔，以忠君、尊孔、尚公、尚武、尚實五大綱為教育宗旨，宣詔天下。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon on day wuchen: loyalty to the ruler, reverence for Confucius, esteem for public spirit, martial spirit, and practical learning were proclaimed as the five great aims of education throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, wuchen new moon, five education aims were proclaimed empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 庚午，罷選八旗秀女。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, selection of talented Manchu banner girls was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, banner maiden selection ended.

sentences.zh: 丙子，命汪大燮往賀日君婚禮。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Wang Daxie was ordered to attend the Japanese emperor's wedding.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Wang Daxie was sent to the Japanese imperial wedding.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，開江蘇通州商埠。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Jiangsu's Tongzhou treaty port was opened.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Tongzhou in Jiangsu became a treaty port.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，美國舊金山地震，頒帑十萬賑華民。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, an earthquake struck San Francisco in the United States; one hundred thousand taels were issued to relieve Chinese residents.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, San Francisco's earthquake drew one hundred thousand taels for Chinese relief.

sentences.zh: 是月，奧使顧新斯基、義使巴樂禮等、德使穆默等、法使呂班先後覲見。

translations.literal: That month, the Austrian minister Gierszewski, the Italian minister Baroli, the German minister Mumm, and the French minister Lépine were received in succession.
translations.idiomatic: That month Austria's, Italy's, Germany's, and France's ministers were received in turn.

sentences.zh: 是春，免浙江仁和等場與各州縣，杭、嚴、衢三所灶課及荒地山塘雜課，雲南、湖南、新疆災糧，陝西逋賦。

translations.literal: That spring, salt-field levies and miscellaneous taxes on wasteland, ponds, and hills in Renhe and other fields of Zhejiang and in the Hang, Yan, and Qu salt administrations and various prefectures and counties were remitted, together with disaster grain in Yunnan, Hunan, and Xinjiang and overdue levies in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: That spring forgave Zhejiang salt and miscellany taxes and disaster grain in Yunnan, Hunan, Xinjiang, and Shaanxi arrears.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌朔，命陸徵祥往瑞士議紅十字會公約。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, new moon on day wuxu: Lu Zhengxiang was ordered to go to Switzerland to negotiate the Red Cross convention.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month 4, wuxu new moon, Lu Zhengxiang went to Switzerland for the Red Cross treaty.

sentences.zh: 己亥，裁各省學政，改置提學使。

translations.literal: On day jihai, provincial education commissioners were cut and education supervisors were established.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, provincial education commissioners became education supervisors.

sentences.zh: 庚子，見日本公使內田康哉於勤政殿。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Japanese minister Uchida Kanzo was received in the Hall of Diligent Government.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Minister Uchida was received.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命鐵良充督辦稅務大臣，唐紹儀副之。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Tieliang was appointed Superintendent of Customs and Tang Shaoyi was made his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Tieliang headed customs with Tang Shaoyi as deputy.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，發湖南庫帑十萬賑水災。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, one hundred thousand taels from the Hunan treasury were issued for flood relief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, one hundred thousand Hunan taels went to flood victims.

sentences.zh: 閏四月丙戌，以暘雨失時，偏災屢告，懿旨飭君臣上下交儆。

translations.literal: Intercalary fourth month, day bingxu: because timely rain failed and partial disasters were repeatedly reported, an empress-dowager rescript admonished court and country to warn one another.
translations.idiomatic: On intercalary month 4, bingxu, drought and scattered disasters drew a dowager warning to the whole court.

sentences.zh: 戊子，唐炯以衰疾解雲南礦務。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Tang Jiong was released from Yunnan mining affairs because of age and illness.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, aged and ill Tang Jiong left Yunnan mining affairs.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌，發庫帑五萬賑廣東水澇災。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuxu: fifty thousand taels from the treasury were issued for Guangdong flood relief.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, wuxu, fifty thousand taels went to Guangdong flood victims.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，河南沁河溢，賑災民。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Qin River in Henan overflowed and disaster victims were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Henan's Qin River flooded and victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 是月，見法使巴思德、義親王費爾迪安德等於乾清宮。

translations.literal: That month, the French minister Bastard and Prince Ferdinand of Italy were received in the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: That month France's minister and Italy's Prince Ferdinand were received.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，德國減直隸駐兵，歸我廊坊、楊村、北戴河、秦王島、山海關地。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingmao: Germany reduced its garrison in Zhili and returned Langfang, Yangcun, Beidaihe, Qinhuang Island, and Shanhaiguan territory to China.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, dingmao, Germany cut its Zhili garrison and returned Langfang, Yangcun, Beidaihe, Qinhuang Island, and Shanhaiguan.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，沅陵匪首覃加位伏誅。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Tan Jiawei, bandit chief of Yuanling, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Yuanling rebel Tan Jiawei was executed.

sentences.zh: 是夏，免浪穹舊逋，莎車復荒額賦，甘肅、雲南被災逋賦。

translations.literal: That summer, old arrears at Langqiong were remitted, restored-wasteland quotas at Yarkand were forgiven, and overdue levies in Gansu and Yunnan districts hit by disaster were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That summer forgave Langqiong arrears, Yarkand wasteland quotas, and Gansu-Yunnan disaster taxes.

sentences.zh: 賑武陟水災，朝陽火災。

translations.literal: Flood relief was sent to Wuzhi and fire relief to Chaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzhi received flood relief and Chaoyang fire relief.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，置川滇邊務大臣，以趙爾豐任之，賞侍郎銜。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuxu: a Sichuan-Yunnan border affairs minister was established, with Zhao Erfeng appointed and given vice-minister rank.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, month 7, wuxu, Zhao Erfeng became Sichuan-Yunnan border minister with vice-minister rank.

sentences.zh: 沁河決口合龍。

translations.literal: The Qin River breach was closed.
translations.idiomatic: The Qin River breach was sealed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，江蘇水陸各營旗防軍改編巡防隊。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Jiangsu's land and water camps, banner defense forces, and garrison troops were reorganized into patrol defense corps.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Jiangsu's camps and banner forces became patrol defense corps.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，考察政治大臣載澤等還京，上封事。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the constitutional inspection ministers led by Zai Ze returned to the capital and submitted a sealed memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Zai Ze's inspection mission returned and filed a sealed report.

sentences.zh: 命醇親王、軍機政務處大臣、大學士、北洋大臣公閱，取進止。

translations.literal: The Prince Chun, Grand Council and Government Affairs ministers, grand secretaries, and the Beiyang minister were ordered jointly to read it and decide what to adopt.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Chun, the council, grand secretaries, and the Beiyang minister were told to review it.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，奉天開商埠大東溝，置海關，以東邊道兼監督。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Dadonggou in Fengtian was opened as a treaty port and a customs house was set up, supervised concurrently by the eastern border intendant.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Fengtian's Dadonggou opened as a port under the eastern border intendant.

sentences.zh: 戊申，諭曰：「載澤等陳奏，謂國勢不振，由上下相暌，內外隔閡。

translations.literal: On day wushen, an edict stated: "Zai Ze and the others memorialized that national strength fails to rise because superiors and inferiors are estranged and inner and outer circles are blocked off.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the court cited Zai Ze's report that China weakened through estrangement within and without.

sentences.zh: 官不知所以保民，民不知所以衛國。

translations.literal: Officials do not know how to protect the people, and the people do not know how to defend the state.
translations.idiomatic: Officials failed to protect the people and the people failed to defend the realm.

sentences.zh: 而各國所由富強，在實行憲法，取決公論。

translations.literal: The wealth and power of every country come from actually carrying out constitutional government and deciding matters by public discussion.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign strength, they said, came from real constitutional rule and public deliberation.

sentences.zh: 時處今日，惟有仿行憲政，大權統於朝廷，庶政公諸輿論。

translations.literal: At the present time there is nothing but to imitate constitutional government, concentrating great power in the court and placing routine administration before public opinion.
translations.idiomatic: China must imitate constitutionalism, keeping supreme power at court while routine policy followed public opinion.

sentences.zh: 預備立憲基礎，內外臣工切實振興。

translations.literal: Prepare the foundations of constitutional government and cause inner and outer officials truly to revive the state.
translations.idiomatic: The edict called for constitutional foundations and a real revival by all officials.

sentences.zh: 俟數年後規模粗具，參用各國成法，再定期限實行。

translations.literal: After several years, when the framework is roughly complete, draw on each country's established methods and again fix a term for actual implementation."
translations.idiomatic: After a few years China would borrow foreign models and set a date for full implementation."

sentences.zh: 」己酉，諭立憲預備，須先釐定官制，命大臣編纂，奕劻、孫家鼐、瞿鴻禨總司核定，取旨遵行。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, an edict on preparing constitutional government ordered that the official system first be clarified; ministers were commanded to compile it, with Yikuang, Sun Jianai, and Qu Hongji in overall charge of verification for imperial approval.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, constitutional preparation required fixing the official system under Yikuang, Sun Jianai, and Qu Hongji.

sentences.zh: 調端方為兩江總督兼南洋大臣。

translations.literal: Duanfang was transferred to governor-general of the Two Jiangs and concurrently Minister for the Southern Seas.
translations.idiomatic: Duanfang became Two Jiangs governor-general and Southern Seas minister.

sentences.zh: 甲子，發江蘇庫儲十萬賑徐、海、淮西水災。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, one hundred thousand taels from the Jiangsu treasury were issued to relieve flood disaster in Xu, Hai, and western Huai districts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, one hundred thousand Jiangsu taels went to Xu, Hai, and western Huai flood victims.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥，除臨川水沖地額賦。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dinghai: quota land taxes on Linchuan flood-washed fields were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, dinghai, Linchuan flood-washed quota taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，見日本王爵博恭、公使林權助於仁壽殿。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Japanese prince Bokō and Minister Lin Quanzhu were received at the Hall of Benevolent Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Japanese Prince Bokō and envoy Lin Quanzhu were received at Benevolent Longevity Hall.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑安徽水災，廣東風災，湖州澇災。

translations.literal: That month, relief was given for Anhui flood disaster, Guangdong wind disaster, and Huzhou flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Anhui floods, Guangdong wind damage, and Huzhou flooding were relieved.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，見各國公使等於仁壽殿。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guimao: foreign ministers and others were received at the Hall of Benevolent Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, guimao, foreign ministers were received at Benevolent Longevity Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙午，賜遊學畢業陳錦濤等各科進士、舉人出身有差。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Chen Jintao and other returned students were granted jinshi, juren, and other degrees with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, returned students including Chen Jintao received jinshi and juren degrees.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔更定官制。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, an edict ordered the official system to be revised.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the court ordered a new official system.

sentences.zh: 內閣、軍機處、外務、吏、禮、學部、宗人府、翰林院等仍舊。

translations.literal: The Grand Council, the Council of State, the Foreign, Personnel, Rites, and Education ministries, the Imperial Clan Court, the Hanlin Academy, and the like remained unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Council, State Council, foreign and civil ministries, Imperial Clan Court, and Hanlin Academy stayed as before.

sentences.zh: 改巡警部為民政部，戶部為度支部，兵部為陸軍部，刑部為法部，工部並入商部為農工商部，理籓院為理籓部。

translations.literal: The Patrol Police Board became the Ministry of Civil Affairs; the Board of Revenue became the Ministry of Finance; the Board of War became the Ministry of the Army; the Board of Punishments became the Ministry of Justice; the Board of Works was merged into the Board of Commerce as the Ministry of Agriculture, Industry, and Commerce; and the Court of Colonial Affairs became the Ministry of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Patrol Police became Civil Affairs; Revenue became Finance; War became Army; Punishments became Justice; Works merged into Commerce as Agriculture-Industry-Commerce; Colonial Affairs became a ministry.

sentences.zh: 各設尚書一人，侍郎二人，不分滿、漢。

translations.literal: Each was to have one minister and two vice-ministers, with no distinction between Manchu and Han.
translations.idiomatic: Each ministry got one minister and two vice-ministers, ending Manchu-Han division.

sentences.zh: 都察院都御史一人，副都御史二人。

translations.literal: The Censorate was to have one censor-in-chief and two deputy censors-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate was set at one chief and two deputy censors-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 改六科給事中為給事中，大理寺為大理院。

translations.literal: The six supervising censors were changed to censors, and the Court of Judicial Review became the Supreme Court.
translations.idiomatic: Six supervising censors became censors; the Court of Judicial Review became the Supreme Court.

sentences.zh: 增設郵傳部、海軍部、軍諮府、資政院、審計院。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Posts and Communications, the Ministry of the Navy, the General Staff, the Political Consultative Council, and the Audit Office were newly established.
translations.idiomatic: New bodies included Posts and Communications, Navy, General Staff, Political Consultative Council, and Audit Office.

sentences.zh: 以財政處歸度支部，太常、光祿、鴻臚三寺歸禮部。

translations.literal: The Finance Office was placed under the Ministry of Finance; the Temple of Imperial Ancestors, the Imperial Banqueting Court, and the Court of State Ceremonial were placed under the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: The Finance Office joined Finance; the Ancestor Temple, Banqueting Court, and State Ceremonial Court joined Rites.

sentences.zh: 太僕寺、練兵處歸陸軍部。

translations.literal: The Court of the Imperial Stud and the Army Training Office were placed under the Ministry of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Stud and Army Training Office were placed under the Army Ministry.

sentences.zh: 各部尚書俱充參預政務處大臣。

translations.literal: All ministry ministers were also to serve as ministers on the Council for Political Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Every ministry minister also sat on the Council for Political Affairs.

sentences.zh: 命世續為軍機大臣，林紹年軍機大臣上學習行走，鹿傳霖、榮慶、徐世昌、鐵良並罷軍機，專理部務。

translations.literal: Shixu was made a Grand Councilor; Lin Shaonian was to study while serving on the Grand Council; Lu Chuanlin, Rongqing, Xu Shichang, and Tieliang were all removed from the Grand Council and were to manage their ministries exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: Shixu joined the Grand Council; Lin Shaonian studied on the council; Lu Chuanlin, Rongqing, Xu Shichang, and Tieliang left the council for ministry posts.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，發廣東庫儲十萬賑香港及潮、高、雷、欽、廉屬風災。

translations.literal: On day yimao, 100,000 taels from the Guangdong treasury were issued to relieve Hong Kong and the Chao, Gao, Lei, Qin, and Lian districts from wind disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, 100,000 Guangdong taels relieved Hong Kong and coastal districts hit by wind.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，改政務處為會議政務處。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Council for Political Affairs was renamed the Council for Deliberation on Government Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, the political affairs council became the deliberative government council.

sentences.zh: 戊午，命曾廣銓以三品京堂充出使德國大臣。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Zeng Guangquan was ordered to serve as minister to Germany with third-rank capital official rank.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Zeng Guangquan was sent as minister to Germany.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉，皇太后聖壽節，停筵宴。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guiyou: the empress dowager's birthday; banquets were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, month 10, guiyou, the empress dowager's birthday banquets were stopped.

sentences.zh: 癸未，見英使硃邇典、比使柯霓雅於乾清宮。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, British Minister Zhu Erdian and Belgian Minister Ke Niya were received in the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, British Minister Zhu Erdian and Belgian Minister Ke Niya were received at Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，裁併廣東陸路、水路提督為廣東提督。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Guangdong land-route and water-route regional commanders were merged into one Guangdong regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Guangdong's land and water commanders were merged into one post.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，見日本公使林權助等於勤政殿。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Japanese Minister Lin Quanzhu and others were received at the Hall of Diligent Government.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Japanese Minister Lin Quanzhu and others were received at Diligent Government Hall.

sentences.zh: 戊子，瀏陽、醴陵匪巫王永求、陳顯龍倡亂，官軍擒斬之。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the sorcerer-rebels Wang Yongqiu and Chen Xianlong of Liuyang and Liling incited disorder; government troops captured and executed them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Liuyang and Liling sorcerer-leaders Wang Yongqiu and Chen Xianlong were captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 己丑，撥漕折三十萬備賑江蘇。

translations.literal: On day jichou, 300,000 taels of transport-tax conversion funds were allocated for Jiangsu relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, 300,000 taels of converted transport tax were set aside for Jiangsu relief.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，立官報局於京師。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, an official gazette office was established in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, an official gazette office was opened in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，留廣東京餉十萬備賑。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jihai: 100,000 taels of Guangdong annual funds were retained for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, jihai, 100,000 Guangdong annual funds were kept for relief.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，免廣西銻礦出井稅。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the antimony mine shaft tax in Guangxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Guangxi antimony mine shaft tax was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，撥陝西官帑八萬助賑江蘇。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, 80,000 taels from the Shaanxi official treasury were allocated to aid Jiangsu relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, 80,000 Shaanxi official taels aided Jiangsu relief.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔升孔子為大祀，所司議典禮以聞。

translations.literal: On day wushen, an edict raised Confucius to the rank of great sacrifice; the responsible offices were ordered to deliberate ritual and report.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Confucius was raised to great-sacrifice rank and ritual offices were told to report.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔各省議幣制。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the provinces were ordered to deliberate currency reform.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, provinces were ordered to debate currency reform.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，建曲阜學堂，發內帑十萬濟工。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, a school was built at Qufu and 100,000 taels from the inner treasury were issued to fund the work.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, a Qufu school was built with 100,000 inner-treasury taels.

sentences.zh: 是月，見墨使胡爾達於勤政殿，德使雷克司、法使巴思德、英使硃邇典於乾清宮。

translations.literal: That month, Mexican Minister Huerda was received at the Hall of Diligent Government; German Minister Leikesi, French Minister Baside, and British Minister Zhu Erdian were received in the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Mexican, German, French, and British ministers were received at court.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on day guihai: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: At the twelfth-month new moon, guihai, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，加京官養廉。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, stipends for integrity were increased for capital officials.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, capital officials' integrity stipends were raised.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，改駐各國公使為二品實官。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, ministers resident in foreign countries were changed to substantive second-rank posts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, resident foreign ministers became substantive second-rank officials.

sentences.zh: 是冬，賑普寧、趙州、羅平、師宗災，江寧、揚州水災。

translations.literal: That winter, relief was given for disasters in Puning, Zhaozhou, Luoping, and Shizong, and for flood disaster in Jiangning and Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, Puning, Zhaozhou, Luoping, Shizong, Jiangning, and Yangzhou disasters were relieved.

sentences.zh: 免灤平、安州澇災糧賦，永城額賦，陝西咸寧等處逋賦，永平、太和、昆明災地欠糧。

translations.literal: Quota grain taxes were remitted for flood disaster in Luanping and Anzhou; quota taxes in Yongcheng; overdue levies in Xianning and other places in Shaanxi; and owed grain on disaster land in Yongping, Taihe, and Kunming.
translations.idiomatic: Luanping, Anzhou, Yongcheng, Shaanxi arrears, and Yongping, Taihe, and Kunming disaster grain were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 三十三年丁未春正月甲辰，見各國公使於乾清宮。

translations.literal: Thirty-third year, dingwei, spring, first month, day jiachen: foreign ministers were received in the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: Year 33, spring 1, jiachen: foreign ministers were received at Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，裁各部小京官。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the minor capital officials of each ministry were cut.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, each ministry's minor capital posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子，有泰以貽誤藏事褫職，謫戍軍台。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiazi: You Tai was stripped of office for mishandling Tibetan affairs and was banished to the military garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, jiazi, You Tai lost office over Tibet and was banished to the garrisons.

sentences.zh: 壬申，留蘇漕十五萬備賑。

translations.literal: On day renshen, 150,000 taels of Jiangsu transport grain were retained for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, 150,000 taels of Jiangsu transport grain were kept for relief.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，見日本公使林權助等於勤政殿。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingshen: Japanese Minister Lin Quanzhu and others were received at the Hall of Diligent Government.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, bingshen, Japanese Minister Lin Quanzhu and others were received.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，長春、哈爾濱辟商埠。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, treaty ports were opened at Changchun and Harbin.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Changchun and Harbin were opened as treaty ports.

sentences.zh: 己亥，改盛京將軍為東三省總督，裁吉林、黑龍江將軍，改置奉、吉、黑三巡撫，授徐世昌欽差大臣，為東三省總督。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Shengjing general was changed to governor-general of the three eastern provinces; the Jilin and Heilongjiang generals were abolished and three governors were set up for Fengtian, Jilin, and Heilongjiang; Xu Shichang was made imperial commissioner and governor-general of the three eastern provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Shengjing became a three-province governor-generalship under Xu Shichang with three governors.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命府尹孫寶琦充出使德國大臣。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Prefect Sun Baoqi was ordered to serve as minister to Germany.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Sun Baoqi was sent as minister to Germany.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命天津道梁敦彥充出使美墨祕古大臣。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Tianjin Circuit Intendant Liang Dunyan was ordered to serve as minister to the United States, Mexico, and Peru.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Liang Dunyan was sent as minister to the United States, Mexico, and Peru.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命陸徵祥充保和會專使大臣，李經方充出使英國大臣，錢恂充出使荷國大臣。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Lu Zhengxiang was ordered to serve as special envoy to the Hague Peace Conference; Li Jingfang was ordered as minister to Britain; Qian Xun was ordered as minister to the Netherlands.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Lu Zhengxiang, Li Jingfang, and Qian Xun were assigned as ministers abroad.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，昆岡卒。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Kungang died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Kungang died.

sentences.zh: 是春，免中衛被水及榆林等屬逋賦，雲南旱災等州縣逋糧及額賦。

translations.literal: That spring, overdue levies were remitted for Zhongwei flood districts and Yulin and its subordinates; overdue grain and quota taxes were remitted for Yunnan drought districts.
translations.idiomatic: That spring, Zhongwei, Yulin, and Yunnan drought and flood arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 四月甲子，裁各省民壯捕役，改設巡警。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day jiazi: civil braves and constables in each province were cut and patrol police were established instead.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, jiazi, provincial braves and catchers were cut and patrol police set up.

sentences.zh: 綏來地震。

translations.literal: Suilai suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Suilai was hit by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，御史趙啟霖坐污衊親貴褫職。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Censor Zhao Qilin was stripped of office for slandering imperial relatives.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Zhao Qilin lost his post for slandering imperial kin.

sentences.zh: 辛未，更定東三省官制，奉天、吉林、黑龍江各設行省公署，以總督為長官，巡撫為次官，置左右參贊，分領承宣、諮議兩□，分設交涉、旗務、民政、提學、度支、勸業、蒙務七司，各置司使，及提法使、督練處等官。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the official system of the three eastern provinces was revised: Fengtian, Jilin, and Heilongjiang each set up provincial government offices with the governor-general as chief and the governor as deputy, with left and right counselors to head the Announcement and Deliberation offices, and seven departments for foreign affairs, banner affairs, civil administration, education, finance, industry promotion, and Mongol affairs, each with a commissioner, as well as a judicial commissioner, a training command, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, the three eastern provinces got provincial offices, counselors, seven departments, and judicial and training posts.

sentences.zh: 己卯，祈雨。

translations.literal: On day jimao, prayers were offered for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, the court prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以江北水災，嚴米糧出口禁。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, because of flood disaster north of the Yangtze, the export of grain was strictly forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, grain exports were banned because of Jiangbei flooding.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，定陸海軍官制，陸軍部設兩□十司，軍諮處五司，海軍部六司。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the army and navy official systems were fixed: the Army Ministry was to have two offices and ten departments, the General Staff five departments, and the Navy Ministry six departments.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, army and navy ministries were organized with two offices and ten, five, and six departments.

sentences.zh: 戊子，命衍聖公孔令貽稽察山東學務。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Duke of Yansheng Kong Lingyi was ordered to inspect Shandong educational affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Kong Lingyi, Duke of Yansheng, was told to inspect Shandong schools.

sentences.zh: 五月癸巳，巴塘等屬喇嘛脅河西蠻作亂，官軍討平之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guisi: lamas in Batang and its subordinates incited western barbarians on the Hexi frontier to rebel; government troops suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, guisi, Batang lamas stirred Hexi tribes; troops pacified them.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命王士珍以侍郎銜署江北提督。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Wang Shizhen was ordered to act as Jiangbei regional commander with vice-minister rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Wang Shizhen acted as Jiangbei commander with vice-minister rank.

sentences.zh: 丙申，西陵禁山火。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, fires were forbidden in the western tombs preserve.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, fires were banned in the western tombs preserve.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，瞿鴻禨罷。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Qu Hongji was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Qu Hongji was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，授鹿傳霖軍機大臣。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Lu Chuanlin was made a Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Lu Chuanlin joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 命醇親王直軍機。

translations.literal: Prince Chun was ordered to attend directly in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Chun was ordered to sit directly on the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，王文詔罷，命張之洞協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Wang Wenshao was dismissed and Zhang Zhidong was ordered to serve as assisting grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Wang Wenshao fell and Zhang Zhidong became assisting grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，崇禮卒。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Chongli died.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Chongli died.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，改按察使為提法使，置巡警、勸業道，裁分守、分巡各道，酌留兵備道，及分設審判□，備司法獨立，增易佐治員，備地方自治，期十五年內通行。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, provincial surveillance commissioners were changed to judicial commissioners; patrol and industry-promotion circuits were established; divisional and circuit-intendant posts were cut, military-preparedness circuits were retained as appropriate, trial offices were set up in preparation for judicial independence, and auxiliary local officials were increased and adjusted in preparation for local self-government, to be fully implemented within fifteen years.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, surveillance became judicial commissioners, trial offices and self-government reforms were planned within fifteen years.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔：「憲法，官民均有責任，凡知所以預備之方、施行之序者，許各條舉，主者甄采以聞。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, an edict said: \"Under a constitution, officials and people alike bear responsibility; those who know how to prepare and the order in which measures should be applied may submit items in detail for selection and report by the authorities.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, an edict said: \"Under a constitution officials and people share duty; those who know how to prepare may submit plans.\"

sentences.zh: 」安徽候補道徐錫麟刺殺巡撫恩銘，錫麟捕得伏誅。

translations.literal: \" Xu Xilin, an expectant circuit intendant in Anhui, assassinated Governor Enming; Xu was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Expectant intendant Xu Xilin assassinated Governor Enming in Anhui and was executed.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，命李家駒充出使日本大臣。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinyou: Li Jiaju was ordered to serve as minister to Japan.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, xinyou, Li Jiaju was sent as minister to Japan.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，復御史趙啟霖官。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Censor Zhao Qilin's office was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Zhao Qilin was restored as censor.

sentences.zh: 壬申，自四月不雨至於是日雨。

translations.literal: On day renshen, from the fourth month without rain until this day it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, rain ended a drought that had lasted since the fourth month.

sentences.zh: 授張之洞體仁閣大學士，鹿傳霖協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhidong was made grand secretary of the Hall of Esteeming Benevolence; Lu Chuanlin was made assisting grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong became a grand secretary and Lu Chuanlin assisting grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，停萬壽筵宴。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the longevity banquet was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, the longevity banquet was stopped.

sentences.zh: 永定河決。

translations.literal: The Yongding River burst its banks.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongding River broke.

sentences.zh: 是夏，免新化被水額賦，伊通被賊逋課，雲南旱災等州縣銀米。

translations.literal: That summer, quota taxes were remitted for flood at Xinhua; overdue levies for bandit damage at Yitong; and silver and grain for drought districts in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, Xinhua flood taxes, Yitong bandit arrears, and Yunnan drought grain were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 賑雲南饑及直隸水災。

translations.literal: Famine in Yunnan and flood disaster in Zhili were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan famine and Zhili flooding were relieved.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯，詔中外臣工議化除滿、漢。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinmao: Chinese and foreign officials were ordered to deliberate the abolition of Manchu-Han distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, month 7, xinmao, officials were told to debate ending Manchu-Han distinctions.

sentences.zh: 甲午，改考查政治館為憲政編查館。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the Bureau for the Investigation of Government was changed to the Bureau for the Compilation and Investigation of Constitutional Government.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, the political investigation bureau became the constitutional compilation bureau.

sentences.zh: 其軍機大臣、大學士、參預政務大臣會議事，於內閣行之。

translations.literal: Grand Councilors, grand secretaries, and ministers on the Council for Political Affairs were to deliberate matters in the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Councilors, grand secretaries, and political-affairs ministers were to meet in the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，懿旨遣楊士琦赴南洋各埠考察，獎勵華僑。

translations.literal: On day renyin, an empress dowager edict sent Yang Shiqi to inspect the various ports of Southeast Asia and encourage overseas Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Yang Shiqi was sent to Southeast Asian ports to encourage overseas Chinese.

sentences.zh: 免趙州、祿豐被災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota taxes were remitted for disaster in Zhaozhou and Lufeng.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaozhou and Lufeng disaster quota taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 賑順天等屬災民，及瀏陽、邵陽蛟災。

translations.literal: Disaster victims in Shuntian and its subordinates were relieved, as were those in the flood-dragon disasters at Liuyang and Shaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Shuntian victims and Liuyang and Shaoyang flood-dragon disasters were relieved.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔以匪徒謀逆，往往假革命名詞，巧為煽誘。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, an edict said that rebels often used the name of revolution to deceive and incite people.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, an edict said rebels often used revolution to incite people.

sentences.zh: 各督撫當設法解散。

translations.literal: Each governor and governor-general was to find means to disband them.
translations.idiomatic: Each governor was told to disband such groups.

sentences.zh: 獲犯擬罪，分別叛逆、盜匪科論，被脅及家屬不知情者勿株連。

translations.literal: Captured offenders were to be sentenced separately as rebels or bandits; those coerced and family members who did not know were not to be implicated.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels and bandits were to be sentenced separately; coerced followers and innocent kin were spared.

sentences.zh: 命張廕棠為全權大臣，與英人議藏約。

translations.literal: Zhang Yintang was ordered to serve as plenipotentiary to negotiate a Tibetan treaty with Britain.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yintang was made plenipotentiary to negotiate Tibet with Britain.

sentences.zh: 敬信卒。

translations.literal: Jingshin died.
translations.idiomatic: Jingshin died.

sentences.zh: 己酉，定限年編練陸軍三十六鎮。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, a time limit was set for organizing thirty-six army divisions.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, a schedule was fixed to organize thirty-six army divisions.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，命張之洞、袁世凱並為軍機大臣，以袁世凱為外務部尚書。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Zhang Zhidong and Yuan Shikai were both made Grand Councilors, with Yuan Shikai as minister of foreign affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Zhang Zhidong and Yuan Shikai joined the Grand Council and Yuan became foreign minister.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命楊士驤署直隸總督兼北洋大臣。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Yang Shixiang was ordered to act as Zhili governor-general and Beiyang commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Yang Shixiang acted as Zhili governor-general and Beiyang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊午，李經邁以母病免，命雷補同充出使奧國大臣。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Li Jingmai was excused because of his mother's illness; Lei Butong was ordered to serve as minister to Austria.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Li Jingmai left for his mother's illness and Lei Butong went to Austria.

sentences.zh: 己未，河決孟縣。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Yellow River burst its banks at Meng County.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, the Yellow River broke at Meng County.

sentences.zh: 八月辛酉，上不豫，詔各省薦精通醫理者。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinyou: the Emperor was unwell; the provinces were ordered to recommend men skilled in medicine.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, xinyou, the Emperor fell ill and provinces were told to recommend physicians.

sentences.zh: 命汪大燮使英國，達壽使日本，於式枚使德國，俱充考察憲政大臣。

translations.literal: Wang Daxi was sent to Britain, Dashou to Japan, and Yu Shimei to Germany, all as commissioners to investigate constitutional government.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Daxi, Dashou, and Yu Shimei were sent to Britain, Japan, and Germany to study constitutional government.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，置京師高等審判□。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the capital High Court of Justice was established.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, the capital High Court of Justice was set up.

sentences.zh: 己巳，置總檢察□。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Office of the Prosecutor General was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, the Prosecutor General's Office was established.

sentences.zh: 壬申，立資政院，以貝子溥倫、孫家鼐為總裁。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Political Consultative Council was established, with the prince Pulun and Sun Jianai as presidents.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the Political Consultative Council was opened under Pulun and Sun Jianai.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命伍廷芳充出使美國大臣，薩廕圖充出使俄國大臣。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Wu Tingfang was ordered to serve as minister to the United States and Sa Yintu as minister to Russia.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Wu Tingfang went to the United States and Sa Yintu to Russia.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔以各省駐防習為遊惰，命各將軍等授田督耕，歸農後，一切歸有司治理。

translations.literal: On day jimao, an edict said that garrison troops in the provinces had grown idle through habit; each general and the like was ordered to grant fields and supervise farming, and after they returned to agriculture all affairs were to pass to the civil authorities.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, idle provincial garrisons were ordered to farm and then yield civil authority to local officials.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，裁奉天驛站，設文報局。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Fengtian courier stations were abolished and a Document Dispatch Bureau was established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Fengtian courier posts were cut and a Document Dispatch Bureau was set up.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔中外臣工研究君主立憲政體。

translations.literal: On day renwu, an edict ordered Chinese and foreign officials to study constitutional monarchy.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the court ordered officials at home and abroad to study constitutional monarchy.

sentences.zh: 諭定自治章程。

translations.literal: Autonomy regulations were laid down.
translations.idiomatic: The court laid down regulations for local self-government.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，見德使雷克司、日使阿部守太郎於仁壽殿。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, the German envoy Rex and the Japanese envoy Abe Moritaro were received at Renshou Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the German envoy Rex and Japanese envoy Abe Moritaro were received at Renshou Hall.

sentences.zh: 諭神機營衛隊及官兵歸陸軍部管轄。

translations.literal: The Divine Engine Corps guards and all officers and soldiers were ordered placed under Army Ministry jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The court placed the Divine Engine Corps guards and troops under the Army Ministry.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，詔議定滿、漢禮制、刑律，考定度量權衡畫一制度章程。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinmao: an edict ordered deliberation on Manchu and Han ritual and penal codes and verification of unified weights and measures regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On month 9, xinmao, the court ordered debate on Manchu and Han ritual and law and unified weights and measures.

sentences.zh: 是日，以煙習未除，敕責莊親王載功、睿親王魁斌、都御史陸寶忠、副都御史陳名侃解職，迅速戒斷。

translations.literal: That day, because the opium habit had not been ended, an imperial reprimand dismissed Prince Zhuang Zaigong, Prince Rui Kuibin, Censor-in-chief Lu Baozhong, and Vice Censor-in-chief Chen Mingkan from office and ordered them to break the habit at once.
translations.idiomatic: That day, for lingering opium use, Zaigong, Kuibin, Lu Baozhong, and Chen Mingkan were dismissed and ordered to quit at once.

sentences.zh: 並諭內外文武，限三月淨盡，否即嚴懲。

translations.literal: All civil and military officials within and without were likewise ordered to quit completely within three months, on pain of severe punishment.
translations.idiomatic: All officials were told to quit within three months or face severe punishment.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命沈家本、俞廉三、英瑞充修訂法律大臣。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Shen Jiaben, Yu Liansan, and Ying Rui were appointed revision law ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Shen Jiaben, Yu Liansan, and Ying Rui became revision law ministers.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命各省立諮議局，公舉議員，並籌設州、縣議事會。

translations.literal: On day jihai, each province was ordered to establish provincial assemblies and publicly elect members, and to plan establishment of prefectural and county councils.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day provinces were told to set up assemblies, elect members, and plan prefectural and county councils.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，日本以水災來告糴，輸江、皖、浙、鄂諸省米糧六十萬石濟之。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Japan reported flood disaster and requested grain; 600,000 shi of rice from Jiangsu, Anhui, Zhejiang, and Hubei was sent as relief.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Japan asked for grain after floods; 600,000 shi from Jiangsu, Anhui, Zhejiang, and Hubei were sent.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命各省立調查局，各部、院設統計處。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, each province was ordered to establish investigation bureaus, and each ministry and court to set up statistical offices.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day provinces got investigation bureaus and ministries statistical offices.

sentences.zh: 予遊學畢業生章宗元等進士、舉人出身有差。

translations.literal: Returned students including Zhang Zongyuan were granted jinshi and juren status in varying ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Returned students including Zhang Zongyuan received jinshi and juren ranks in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 戊申，湖北按察使梁鼎芬言挽回時局，莫亟於禁賄賂，絕請託，劾奕劻、袁世凱等夤緣比附，貪私誤國。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Hubei Judicial Commissioner Liang Dingfen memorialized that to save the situation nothing was more urgent than banning bribery and cutting off solicitation; he impeached Yikuang, Yuan Shikai, and others for clinging to power and private greed harming the state.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Liang Dingfen urged banning bribery and impeached Yikuang and Yuan Shikai for clinging to power and harming the state.

sentences.zh: 廷旨以有意沽名，斥之。

translations.literal: The court edict held he was deliberately seeking reputation and rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: The court called it grandstanding and rebuked him.

sentences.zh: 是月，免雲南旱傷等州縣稅糧。

translations.literal: That month, grain taxes were remitted in Yunnan drought-stricken districts.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yunnan drought districts were forgiven grain taxes.

sentences.zh: 賑懷寧等縣水災。

translations.literal: Huaining and other counties received flood relief.
translations.idiomatic: Huaining and other counties received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙丑，命派孫家鼐、榮慶、陸潤庠、張英麟、唐景崇、寶熙、硃益籓進講經史及國朝掌故。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yichou: Sun Jianai, Rongqing, Lu Runxiang, Zhang Yinglin, Tang Jingchong, Baoxi, and Zhu Yifan were assigned to lecture on the classics and histories and Qing institutional precedents.
translations.idiomatic: On month 10, yichou, Sun Jianai, Rongqing, Lu Runxiang, Zhang Yinglin, Tang Jingchong, Baoxi, and Zhu Yifan were assigned to lecture on classics and Qing precedents.

sentences.zh: 永定河合龍。

translations.literal: The Yongding River works were joined.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongding River breach was closed.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，皇太后聖壽節，停筵宴。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Empress Dowager's birthday; banquets were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, the Empress Dowager's birthday; banquets were stopped.

sentences.zh: 壬申，見日使林權助等於勤政殿。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Japanese envoy Hayashi Gonsuke and others were received at Qinzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day the Japanese envoy Hayashi Gonsuke and others were received at Qinzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，哲布尊巴丹胡圖克圖進方物。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Jebtsundampa Khutuktu presented tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the Jebtsundampa Khutuktu presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚寅，廣西匪踞南關砲台，責張鳴岐督剿，尋復之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengyin: Guangxi bandits seized the Nan Pass batteries; Zhang Mingqi was charged to supervise suppression and soon recovered them.
translations.idiomatic: On month 11, gengyin, Guangxi bandits took Nan Pass batteries; Zhang Mingqi suppressed them and soon recovered the post.

sentences.zh: 戊申，嚴聚眾開會演說之禁。

translations.literal: On day wushen, assemblies and public speeches were strictly forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day mass meetings and public speeches were strictly banned.

sentences.zh: 諭各省整頓學堂，增訂考核勸戒法。

translations.literal: Provinces were instructed to rectify schools and revise examination and admonition regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Provinces were told to rectify schools and revise examination rules.

sentences.zh: 壬子，見俄使璞科第等於乾清宮。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the Russian envoy Pokotilov and others were received at the Qianqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the Russian envoy Pokotilov and others were received at the Qianqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 以內外臣工條議幣制，用兩用元，互有利害，諭各督撫體察籌議以聞。

translations.literal: Because officials debated currency using tael versus yuan with mutual pros and cons, governors-general and governors were instructed to investigate and report.
translations.idiomatic: As officials debated tael versus yuan coinage, governors-general and governors were told to investigate and report.

sentences.zh: 發帑五十萬濟廣西軍。

translations.literal: 500,000 taels were issued for the Guangxi army.
translations.idiomatic: 500,000 taels were issued for the Guangxi army.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午朔，復分置廣東陸路提督、水師提督。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on day wuwu: Guangdong Land and Naval commanders-in-chief posts were restored separately.
translations.idiomatic: On month 12's wuwu new moon, Guangdong land and naval commanders-in-chief were restored separately.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，裁吉林副都統，置交涉、民政、度支三司使暨提法使、勸業道。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Jilin deputy lieutenant-general was abolished; Foreign Affairs, Civil Affairs, and Revenue commissioners and a judicial commissioner and Industrial Promotion intendant were established.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Jilin's deputy lieutenant-general was cut; foreign affairs, civil affairs, revenue, judicial, and industrial promotion posts were added.

sentences.zh: 予進士館遊學畢業學員楊兆麟等進敘有差。

translations.literal: Jinshi Institute returned students including Yang Zhaolin received advancement in varying ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Jinshi Institute returned students including Yang Zhaolin were advanced in varying ranks.

sentences.zh: 壬申，裁山東糧道，置巡警、勸業二道。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Shandong grain intendant was abolished and Police and Industrial Promotion intendants established.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day the Shandong grain intendant was cut and police and industrial promotion intendants set up.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，諭熱河圍場辦屯墾，裁駐防官兵。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, farming colonization was ordered for the Rehe hunting preserves; garrison troops were cut.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Rehe hunting grounds were ordered colonized and garrison troops cut.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命呂海寰充督辦津浦鐵路大臣。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Lv Haihuan was appointed Commissioner for the Tianjin-Pukou Railway.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Lv Haihuan became commissioner for the Tianjin-Pukou Railway.

sentences.zh: 丙子，那桐兼督辦稅務大臣。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Natong was also made Commissioner for Customs Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Natong was also made customs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，賞總稅務司赫德尚書銜。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Inspector General of Customs Hart was granted Ministerial rank.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Inspector General Hart received brevet Minister rank.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，再停布特哈貢貂一年。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Buteha marten tribute was again suspended for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Buteha marten tribute was again suspended for one year.

sentences.zh: 是冬，免雲南被旱、直隸被潦暨陝西逋賦。

translations.literal: That winter, taxes were remitted for Yunnan drought, Zhili flood, and Shaanxi arrears.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Yunnan drought, Zhili flood, and Shaanxi arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 賑雲南等屬蛟災，四川水災，廣東風災水災。

translations.literal: Yunnan hail disasters, Sichuan floods, and Guangdong wind and flood disasters received relief.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan hail, Sichuan floods, and Guangdong wind and water disasters received relief.

sentences.zh: 三十四年戊申春正月丁亥朔，授醇親王載灃為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: Thirty-fourth year, wushen, spring, first month, new moon on day dinghai: Prince Chun Zaifeng was made Grand Council minister.
translations.idiomatic: Year 34, spring 1, dinghai new moon: Prince Chun Zaifeng joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，見各國公使於乾清宮。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the various envoys were received at the Qianqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the various envoys were received at the Qianqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以京師銀價驟高，物直踴貴，發帑五十萬，命順天府尹貶價收錢，並令各省廠鑄當十銅元，定額外加鑄三成一文新錢，以資補救。

translations.literal: On day jihai, because silver prices in the capital surged and goods soared, 500,000 taels were issued; the Shuntian prefect was ordered to buy up coin at reduced prices; provinces were ordered to cast ten-cash copper coins and additionally coin thirty percent more new cash per quota to remedy the situation.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, as capital silver soared and prices jumped, 500,000 taels were issued, Shuntian was told to buy coin cheaply, and provinces were told to cast ten-cash copper and extra new cash.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，建蘭州黃河鐵橋。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Lanzhou Yellow River iron bridge was built.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Lanzhou Yellow River iron bridge was built.

sentences.zh: 丙午，見奧使顧新斯基於勤政殿。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Austrian envoy Gratzmayr was received at Qinzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Austrian envoy Gratzmayr was received at Qinzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 是月，免雲南昆明等縣逋賦，浙江仁和等場灶課，湖南邵陽額賦。

translations.literal: That month, arrears were remitted in Yunnan Kunming and other counties, Zhejiang Renhe salt fields, and Hunan Shaoyang quotas.
translations.idiomatic: That month Kunming and other Yunnan counties, Zhejiang Renhe salt works, and Hunan Shaoyang quotas were forgiven arrears.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，祭大社、大稷，是後祀典不克親行，皆遣代。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuwu: sacrifice to the Altars of Soil and Grain; thereafter the emperor could not attend in person and always sent substitutes.
translations.idiomatic: On month 2, wuwu, the Soil and Grain altars were sacrificed to; thereafter the emperor always sent substitutes.

sentences.zh: 庚申，賞趙爾豐尚書銜，為駐藏大臣，仍兼邊務大臣。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Zhao Erfeng was granted Ministerial rank as Resident Minister in Tibet while retaining border affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Zhao Erfeng received Minister rank as Tibet resident minister while keeping border affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔增給滿大臣暨各旗官十成養廉，更定御前大臣以下等員津貼。

translations.literal: On day guihai, an edict increased stipend-in-lieu for Manchu ministers and banner officers by the full ten percent and revised allowances for imperial bodyguard ranks and below.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Manchu ministers and banner officers got a full ten-percent stipend increase and bodyguard allowances were revised.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，諭京、外清庶獄。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, prisons were ordered cleared in the capital and provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the capital and provinces were ordered to clear prisons.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，京師勸工陳列所災。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, the capital Labor Exhibition Hall burned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the capital Labor Exhibition Hall burned.

sentences.zh: 丙子，諭以「禁煙議成，英人許分年減運，見已實行遞減。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "The opium prohibition agreement has been concluded; the British have agreed to reduce imports year by year, and reduction is now being carried out in stages.
translations.idiomatic: The court said: "The opium ban treaty is done; Britain agreed to cut imports yearly and staged cuts are under way.

sentences.zh: 相約試行三年，限滿再為推減。

translations.literal: A trial period of three years was agreed, after which further reduction would be pushed.
translations.idiomatic: A three-year trial was agreed, then further cuts would follow.

sentences.zh: 轉瞬期至，其何以答友邦。

translations.literal: The term is about to expire—how shall we answer friendly powers?
translations.idiomatic: The term is nearly up—how shall we answer friendly powers.

sentences.zh: 民政、度支二部迅訂稽核章程，責成督撫飭屬將減種、減食，切實舉辦以聞」。

translations.literal: The Civil Affairs and Revenue ministries are to draw up audit regulations at once, and governors-general and governors are to instruct subordinates to report fully on reducing cultivation and consumption."
translations.idiomatic: Civil Affairs and Revenue must draft audits at once, and governors must report fully on cutting cultivation and use."

sentences.zh: 丁丑，召達壽還，命李家駒為考察憲政大臣，胡惟德充出使日本大臣。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Dashou was recalled; Li Jiaju was made constitutional inspection commissioner and Hu Weide envoy to Japan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Dashou was recalled; Li Jiaju inspected constitutional affairs and Hu Weide went to Japan.

sentences.zh: 壬午，黃誥罷，調錢恂為出使義國大臣，以陸徵祥為出使荷國大臣。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Huang Gao was dismissed; Qian Xun was transferred as envoy to Italy and Lu Zhengxiang as envoy to the Netherlands.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Huang Gao was dismissed; Qian Xun went to Italy and Lu Zhengxiang to the Netherlands.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰，命恭親王溥偉、鹿傳霖、景星、丁振鐸充禁煙大臣，立戒煙所，專司查驗。

translations.literal: Third month, day renchen: Prince Gong Pulun, Lu Chuanlin, Jing Xing, and Ding Zhenduo were made opium prohibition commissioners and an opium prohibition office was established for inspection.
translations.idiomatic: On month 3, renchen, Pulun, Lu Chuanlin, Jing Xing, and Ding Zhenduo became opium commissioners and an inspection office was set up.

sentences.zh: 丙午，廓爾喀貢方物。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Nepal presented tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Nepal presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以湛深經術，賜湘潭舉人王闓運檢討。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, for profound classical learning Xiangtan juren Wang Kaiyun was granted Compiler rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Wang Kaiyun of Xiangtan was made Compiler for classical learning.

sentences.zh: 是月，免雲南被災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: That month, old and new quota taxes were remitted for disaster areas in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yunnan disaster districts were forgiven old and new quota taxes.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙辰，見日使林權助等於勤政殿。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingchen: the Japanese envoy Hayashi Gonsuke and others were received at Qinzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On month 4, bingchen, the Japanese envoy Hayashi Gonsuke and others were received at Qinzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 綏遠城將軍貽穀有罪褫職，逮下刑部獄，尋籍其家。

translations.literal: Suiyuan General Yigu was found guilty, dismissed, and imprisoned in the Board of Punishments; soon his property was confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Suiyuan General Yigu was guilty, dismissed, jailed in the Board of Punishments, and soon his property was seized.

sentences.zh: 命信勤充墾務大臣，兼署綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: Xin Qin was made colonization commissioner and acting Suiyuan General.
translations.idiomatic: Xin Qin became colonization commissioner and acting Suiyuan general.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，裁安徽安廬滁和道。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Anlu-Chuhe-Heyang Circuit in Anhui was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Anhui's Anlu-Chuhe-Heyang Circuit was cut.

sentences.zh: 己未，越匪陷河口，命劉春霖以三品京堂幫辦雲南邊防，前敵諸軍歸節制。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Yunnan border: Vietnamese bandits took Hekou; Liu Chunlin was made third-rank capital official to assist border defense and all front-line armies were placed under his command.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Vietnamese bandits took Hekou; Liu Chunlin assisted Yunnan border defense and commanded all front armies.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，裁貴州糧道、貴西道。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Guizhou grain intendant and Guixi Circuit were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the Guizhou grain intendant and Guixi Circuit were cut.

sentences.zh: 己巳，見各國公使希特斯等於仁壽殿，賜宴。

translations.literal: On day jisi, envoys including Hertz and others were received at Renshou Hall and a banquet was given.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day envoys including Hertz and others were received at Renshou Hall and feasted.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，雲南官軍敗匪於田房，復四隘，旋克大小南溪及河口，發帑犒軍。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Yunnan government troops defeated bandits at Tianfang, recovered four passes, then took Greater and Lesser Nanxi and Hekou; treasury funds rewarded the army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Yunnan troops beat bandits at Tianfang, retook four passes, then Nanxi and Hekou; treasury funds rewarded the army.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉朔，滇匪平。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on day yiyou: Yunnan bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On month 5's yiyou new moon, Yunnan bandits were pacified.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，裁巴塘、裡塘土司，置流官。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Batang and Litang native chiefs were abolished and regular officials installed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Batang and Litang native chiefs were cut and regular officials installed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上疾復作，命直省薦精通醫理者。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the emperor's illness recurred; the provinces were ordered to recommend those skilled in medicine.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the emperor's illness returned; provinces were told to recommend skilled physicians.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，錄中興功臣多隆阿、向榮、江忠源、羅澤南、駱秉章、張國樑、李續賓、彭玉麟、楊岳斌、鮑超、李孟群、程學啟、劉松山、馮子材等後，升敘有差。

translations.literal: On day guisi, descendants of mid-dynasty meritorious servants Duolong'a, Xiang Rong, Jiang Zhongyuan, Luo Zexian, Luo Bingzhang, Zhang Guoliang, Li Xubin, Peng Yulin, Yang Yuebin, Bao Chao, Li Mengqun, Cheng Xueti, Liu Songshan, Feng Zicai, and others were enrolled for promotion in varying ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day descendants of meritorious servants including Duolong'a, Xiang Rong, and Feng Zicai were enrolled for promotion in varying ranks.

sentences.zh: 甲午，修曲阜孔子廟。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, repair of the Confucius Temple at Qufu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Confucius Temple at Qufu was repaired.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，襄河決，颶風為災。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Xiang River burst its banks and a hurricane brought disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the Xiang River burst and a hurricane brought disaster.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，郎中曹元弼進所著禮經校釋，賞編修。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, court gentleman Cao Yuanbi presented his Collated Ritual Classics and was granted Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Cao Yuanbi presented his Collated Ritual Classics and became Compiler.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，廣東大雨，東西北三江並溢，沖決圍堤。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Guangdong heavy rains; the East, North, and West rivers all overflowed and breached dikes.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Guangdong flooded; the East, North, and West rivers overflowed and breached dikes.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，前祭酒王先謙進所著尚書孔傳參正、漢書補注、荀子集解、日本源流考，賞內閣學士銜。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingsi: former Libationer Wang Xianqian presented his Corrected Commentary on the Documents, Supplements to the Han History, Collected Exegesis of the Xunzi, and Study of Japanese Origins and was granted Hanlin Academy scholar rank.
translations.idiomatic: On month 6, dingsi, Wang Xianqian presented his classical works and received Hanlin scholar rank.

sentences.zh: 甲子，免廣西礦地出井、出口兩稅五年。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Guangxi mine well and export taxes were remitted for five years.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Guangxi mine and export taxes were forgiven for five years.

sentences.zh: 庚午，予進士館游學畢業學員黎湛枝等進敘有差。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Jinshi Institute returned students including Li Zhanzhi received advancement in varying ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Jinshi Institute returned students including Li Zhanzhi were advanced in varying ranks.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命張之洞兼督辦粵漢鐵路。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Zhang Zhidong was also made Commissioner for the Canton-Hankou Railway.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Zhang Zhidong was also made Canton-Hankou Railway commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，允達賴喇嘛入覲。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the Dalai Lama's audience was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the Dalai Lama's audience was approved.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以美國減收賠款，命唐紹儀充專使致謝，兼赴東西洋考察財政。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, because America reduced indemnity payments, Tang Shaoyi was made special envoy to give thanks and also tour Western countries to study finance.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, as America cut indemnity payments, Tang Shaoyi thanked America and toured the West to study finance.

sentences.zh: 議免釐加稅。

translations.literal: Lijin surcharges were discussed for abolition.
translations.idiomatic: Lijin surcharges were discussed for abolition.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，授楊士驤直隸總督兼北洋大臣。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Yang Shixiang was made Governor-General of Zhili and Beiyang Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Yang Shixiang became Zhili governor-general and Beiyang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，法部主事陳景仁等請三年後開國會。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Ministry of Law official Chen Jingren and others asked to open a parliament in three years.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Chen Jingren and others asked to open parliament in three years.

sentences.zh: 詔以景仁倡率生事，褫職交管束。

translations.literal: An edict held Jingren was stirring trouble and stripped him of office for supervision.
translations.idiomatic: The court said Jingren was stirring trouble and stripped him for supervision.

sentences.zh: 是夏，免雲南水旱雹災，奉天水災荒地額賦。

translations.literal: That summer, quota taxes were remitted for Yunnan flood, drought, and hail and Gansu flood wasteland.
translations.idiomatic: That summer Yunnan flood, drought, and hail and Gansu flood wasteland were forgiven quota taxes.

sentences.zh: 賑江蘇風雹災，湖北水災。

translations.literal: Jiangsu wind and hail disasters and Hubei floods received relief.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu wind and hail and Hubei floods received relief.

sentences.zh: 發部帑五萬賑察哈爾蒙旗及兩翼牧群災，又部帑十萬賑廣東廣州、肇慶、陽江各屬水災。

translations.literal: 50,000 taels from the ministry treasury for Chahar banner and two-wing herd disasters; another 100,000 taels for Guangzhou, Zhaoqing, Yangjiang, and other Guangdong flood districts.
translations.idiomatic: 50,000 ministry taels for Chahar and herd disasters; another 100,000 for Guangzhou, Zhaoqing, Yangjiang, and other Guangdong floods.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，裁黑龍江愛琿等三副都統，增置□愛琿道、呼倫貝爾道。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renchen: three Heilongjiang deputy lieutenant-generals including Aihui were abolished; the Aihui Circuit and Hulunbuir Circuit were added.
translations.idiomatic: On month 7, renchen, three Heilongjiang deputy lieutenant-generals including Aihui were cut; the Aihui and Hulunbuir circuits were added.

sentences.zh: 丙申，釋蘇元春回。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Su Yuanchun was released and restored.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Su Yuanchun was released and restored.

sentences.zh: 己亥，免鐵路公私稅三年。

translations.literal: On day jihai, public and private railway taxes were remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day public and private railway taxes were forgiven for three years.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以各省設政聞社斂財結黨，陰擾治安，諭所在嚴禁。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, because provinces set up Political Association chapters to collect money and form factions disturbing order, the localities were ordered to prohibit them strictly.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, as provinces set up Political Association chapters that collected money and disturbed order, localities were told to ban them.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，修浙江海塘。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Zhejiang seawalls were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Zhejiang seawalls were repaired.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，廣西巡勇叛變，戕殺統將，張人駿督剿之。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Guangxi garrison troops mutinied and killed their commander; Zhang Renjun supervised suppression.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Guangxi garrison troops mutinied and killed their commander; Zhang Renjun suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命三品卿銜胡國廉總理瓊、崖墾礦事。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, third-rank Qing official Hu Guokui was put in charge of Qiong-Ya land reclamation and mining.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Hu Guokui took charge of Qiong-Ya reclamation and mining.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，置雲南交涉使。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, a Yunnan Foreign Affairs commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day a Yunnan foreign affairs commissioner was established.

sentences.zh: 是月，山東、安徽蝗。

translations.literal: That month, locusts in Shandong and Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: That month locusts struck Shandong and Anhui.

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅朔，憲政編查館、資政院上憲法、議院、選舉各綱要，暨逐年籌備事宜。

translations.literal: Eighth month, new moon on day jiayin: the Constitutional Compilation Bureau and Consultative Assembly submitted outlines for constitution, parliament, and elections with annual preparatory plans.
translations.idiomatic: On month 8's jiayin new moon, the Constitutional Compilation Bureau and Consultative Assembly submitted constitution, parliament, and election outlines with annual plans.

sentences.zh: 詔頒行京、外官署，依限舉辦，每六閱月，臚列成績以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered promulgation to capital and provincial offices to carry out within deadlines; every six months achievements were to be reported in full.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered promulgation to capital and provincial offices on deadlines; every six months achievements were to be reported.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命薑桂題總統武衛左軍。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Jiang Guiti was ordered to take overall command of the Left Guard Army of the Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Jiang Guiti was made commander of the Left Martial Guard Army.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，見俄使廓索維慈、荷使希特斯等於仁壽殿。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Russian envoy Korostovitz, the Dutch envoy Hitters, and others were received at Renshou Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Korostovitz of Russia, Hitters of the Netherlands, and others were received at Renshou Hall.

sentences.zh: 己卯，命廕昌、端方校閱秋操。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Yin Chang and Duan Fang were ordered to inspect the autumn maneuvers.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Yin Chang and Duan Fang were told to review autumn field exercises.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，馬玉昆卒，晉二等輕車都尉。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Ma Yukun died; he was posthumously promoted to second-class Commandant of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Ma Yukun died and was given second-class Commandant of Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命廕昌充出使德國大臣。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Yin Chang was appointed envoy minister to Germany.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Yin Chang was sent as minister to Germany.

sentences.zh: 壬午，遣御前大臣博迪蘇往保定迎勞達賴喇嘛。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Imperial Presence Minister Bodisu was dispatched to Baoding to welcome and entertain the Dalai Lama.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Bodisu went to Baoding to welcome the Dalai Lama.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未朔，予先儒顧炎武、王夫之、黃宗羲從祀文廟。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on guimao: the former scholars Gu Yanwu, Wang Fuzhi, and Huang Zongxi were granted posthumous worship in the Confucian temple.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, guimao new moon, Gu Yanwu, Wang Fuzhi, and Huang Zongxi were admitted to Confucian temple worship.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，美軍艦遊歷至廈門，遣貝勒毓朗、梁敦彥往勞問。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, American warships on a tour of inspection reached Xiamen; Prince Beile Yulang and Liang Dunyan were sent to extend greetings.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, U.S. warships called at Xiamen; Yulang and Liang Dunyan were sent to greet them.

sentences.zh: 己丑，開寧夏渠墾田。

translations.literal: On day jichou, land reclamation was opened along the Ningxia canal.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, canal land reclamation began in Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，達賴喇嘛至京，尋於仁壽殿覲見。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Dalai Lama arrived in the capital and was soon received in audience at Renshou Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the Dalai Lama reached Beijing and was soon received at Renshou Hall.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，頒畫一幣制。

translations.literal: On day guisi, a unified currency system was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, a unified currency system was issued.

sentences.zh: 丙申，允郵傳部請，試辦本國公債。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the Postal Ministry's request was approved to trial issue domestic government bonds.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, the court approved a trial issue of domestic government bonds.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，予進士館畢業陳雲誥等敘進有差。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Jinshi Hall graduates Chen Yunhao and others were granted differential promotions.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Chen Yunhao and other Jinshi Hall graduates received graded promotions.

sentences.zh: 庚子，見英使硃邇典等於仁壽殿。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the British envoy Jordan and others were received at Renshou Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Jordan of Britain and others were received at Renshou Hall.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，予遊學畢業陳振先等出身，進士館畢業葉光圻等敘進各有差。

translations.literal: On day guimao, study-abroad graduates Chen Zhenxian and others were granted official status; Jinshi Hall graduates Ye Guangqi and others received differential promotions.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Chen Zhenxian and other returned students were given rank, and Ye Guangqi and other Jinshi Hall graduates were promoted.

sentences.zh: 己酉，裁四川成釂龍茂道，增置巡警、勸業兩道。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the Chengyu Longmao circuit in Sichuan was abolished and patrol and encouragement-of-industry circuits were added.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Sichuan's Chengyu Longmao circuit was cut and patrol and industry-promotion circuits were added.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔以前籌備憲政事宜尚有未盡，諭各部院依前格式，各就職司所繫，分期臚列奏明，交編查館覆核，取旨遵行。
